Prior works typically address this problem by directly modeling images in pixel space, requiring modifications to the diffusion training objective or model architecture. In this work, we introduce a different paradigm: rather than modifying diffusion models, we construct a lossless transformation that maps pixels into a representation more amenable to diffusion modeling. We term our approach the Lossless Latent Diffusion Model (LLDM). We construct LLDM using residual latent transformation and uneven latent scaling, and explain its effectiveness through a proposed metric, semantic rank priority (SRP). Empirically, LLDM substantially outperforms prior pixel-space diffusion models in generation quality and even surpasses several widely used lossy VAEs. Furthermore, we show that SRP is strongly correlated with downstream generative performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出无损潜空间扩散模型LLDM，通过可逆潜空间变换保留像素级重建能力，同时提升扩散图像生成质量，并引入语义秩优先级SRP解释有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有图像扩散模型若要实现像素级精确重建，通常需要直接在像素空间建模，但这要求修改扩散训练目标或模型架构，往往影响生成质量并增加实现复杂度。
AI.method: 提出一种不修改扩散模型本身的范式：构造从像素到更适合扩散建模的潜表示的无损变换。具体采用残差潜变换和不均匀潜缩放构建Lossless Latent Diffusion Model，并提出语义秩优先级指标SRP来解释其有效性。
AI.result: 实验显示LLDM在生成质量上显著优于先前的像素空间扩散模型，甚至超过若干广泛使用的有损VAE；同时SRP与下游生成性能具有较强的相关性。
AI.conclusion: 通过无损潜空间变换而非直接修改扩散模型，可以在保持像素级重建的同时提升生成质量；SRP可作为衡量潜表示是否适合扩散建模的有效指标。

title: CANDOR: Contrastive Self-Denoising Rewards for Label-Free Text-to-Image Post-Training
summary: Post-training text-to-image generators with reinforcement learning usually relies on external reward models that need annotated preferences or auxiliary evaluators and are prone to reward hacking. We show that the generator's own denoising accuracy, used by a recent intrinsic reward, is a poor proxy for prompt fidelity. Within a same-prompt group, this absolute self-confidence is dominated by image complexity and ranks correct samples above incorrect ones near chance. We introduce CANDOR (Contrastive Alignment from Null-referenced Denoising lOg-Ratio), the log-ratio of unconditional to conditional denoising errors under shared noise probes, which measures how much the prompt helps the model denoise its own sample. It cancels prompt-independent difficulty that scales both errors and ranks the better of two same-prompt samples higher in 60% and 63% of pairs on compositional generation and text rendering. As the only Flow-GRPO reward for a flow-matching model, CANDOR improves text rendering, aesthetic and human-preference scores over the base model and a prior absolute self-confidence reward, with text-rendering and preference gains that stronger classifier-free guidance does not reproduce. On public Flow-GRPO adapters trained on external rewards, CANDOR further raises PickScore and ImageReward, so it can complement those rewards. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 提出CANDOR，通过无条件与条件去噪误差在共享噪声探测下的对数比值构建内在奖励，用于流匹配文生图模型强化学习后训练，可更准确衡量提示忠实度并提升文本渲染、美学与人类偏好指标。
AI.motivation: 文生图生成器的RL后训练通常依赖外部奖励模型，需要标注偏好或额外评估器，且易受奖励黑客影响；已有基于模型自身去噪准确率的内在奖励本质上是绝对自置信度，易受图像复杂度支配，与提示忠实度相关性差，正确与错误样本排序接近随机。
AI.method: 定义CANDOR奖励：在同一潜在样本上共享噪声探测，计算无条件与条件去噪误差的对数比值，估计提示对模型去噪该样本的增益；将该对比式内在奖励作为Flow-GRPO唯一奖励，并在公开外部奖励训练的适配器上作为补充奖励验证。
AI.result: CANDOR在同一提示的两样本对排序中达到60%和63%准确率，分别覆盖组合生成与文本渲染；作为Flow-GRPO唯一奖励，相对基线和绝对自置信度奖励提升文本渲染、美学及人类偏好，且更强分类器自由引导无法复现这些增益；在公开Flow-GRPO适配器上进一步提升PickScore和ImageReward。
AI.conclusion: 提示条件与无条件去噪误差的对比能够抵消与提示无关的样本难度，是比绝对去噪置信度更可靠的提示忠实度内在奖励代理；CANDOR既能作为单一奖励提升生成质量，也可与外部奖励互补，降低对标注偏好和外部评估器的依赖。

title: ActMem: From Latent Memory Reasoning to Grounded Robotic Action
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising results in real-world long-horizon manipulation, where memory plays a crucial role. However, existing memory-augmented VLAs either retrieve past observations without reasoning about what they imply, or reason over the full history in a shared context where it crowds out current perception. Cognitive science treats them as distinct systems: memory reconstructs past experience to decide what to do, while perception guides how to act. We therefore propose ActMem, an in-context memory framework that decouples memory reasoning from perceptual grounding within a single vision-language backbone. Built on a vision-language model with native video understanding, ActMem infers the current subtask from a timestamped interaction history and keeps the hidden states formed during this inference as a Latent Memory Chain-of-Thought (Memory CoT), which conditions a flow-matching action expert. Perception Attention further lets the expert attend directly to the current view. To keep inference fast under long histories, Efficient Memory CoT Inference reuses computation across consecutive decisions without changing the output. ActMem achieves 71.1% task success and 80.8% completion success on RoboMemArena, surpassing the strongest baseline by 7.5 and 8.7 percentage points, and 73.8% average success on MIKASA-Robo, the best among all compared methods. In the real world, it reaches 68.8% average success on exogenous, endogenous, and traceless memory tasks, 10.0 percentage points above the strongest memory-augmented VLA. Code and checkpoints will be released at this https URL and this https URL.
comment: 17 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables. Code and checkpoints: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ActMem，一种面向视觉-语言-动作模型的上下文记忆框架，通过将“记忆推理”与“当前感知接地”解耦，提升长程机器人操作中的记忆利用与动作执行能力。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强型VLA存在两类不足：一是只检索过去观察而不推理其含义；二是在共享上下文中对完整历史进行推理，导致当前感知信息被历史信息挤占。认知科学提示，记忆负责重建过去经验以决定“做什么”，感知负责指导当前动作“如何做”，因此二者应在架构上分离。
AI.method: ActMem基于具有原生视频理解能力的视觉-语言模型，利用带时间戳的交互历史推断当前子任务，并将推理过程中的隐状态保留为潜在记忆思维链（Memory CoT），用于条件化一个基于流匹配的动作专家。感知注意力机制使动作专家能够直接关注当前视觉输入；高效Memory CoT推理通过复用连续决策间的计算，在长历史场景下保持推理速度且不影响输出。
AI.result: 在RoboMemArena上，ActMem取得71.1%任务成功率和80.8%完成成功率，分别超过最强基线7.5和8.7个百分点；在MIKASA-Robo上取得73.8%平均成功率，为对比方法中最优。真实世界实验中，在外源性、内源性和无迹记忆任务上达到68.8%平均成功率，比最强记忆增强VLA高10.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ActMem通过显式分离记忆推理与感知接地，在长程机器人操作中同时改善了历史经验利用、当前感知准确性和推理效率，验证了认知启发的解耦架构对提升VLA记忆能力的有效性。

title: A Wolf in Sheep's Pixels: Visual Camouflage Attacks via HDR Gain Maps
summary: An image can pass automated safety checks while showing harmful content to its human viewer. We introduce DRJanus, a visual camouflage attack that exploits the gap between standard dynamic range (SDR) processing and high dynamic range (HDR) display. Automated systems often read only an image's SDR base, whereas HDR viewers reconstruct its appearance using an auxiliary gain map. DRJanus inverts this reconstruction to embed two independently chosen color images in a single JPEG, without querying or optimizing against the target model. It preserves the chosen SDR base exactly and reconstructs HDR targets at an average PSNR of 43.03 dB across 400 images. On a benchmark of 100 sexual-content images, DRJanus evades detection by all six tested commercial moderation services and nine vision-language models. Across five agents, each evaluated on 120 task cases per threat setting, attack success ranges from 31.67% to 100% for moderation evasion and from 95% to 100% for task manipulation. We also explore cross-view consistency checks as a mitigation. These findings expose a gap in visual trust: securing what a machine reads does not secure what a user sees. A demo is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 该研究提出 DRJanus，一种利用 SDR/HDR 显示处理差异的视觉伪装攻击，使同一图像在自动化检测中呈现安全内容，而在 HDR 人眼观看下呈现有害内容。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉安全检测通常只解析图像的 SDR 基础表示，而 HDR 显示会通过辅助增益图重建另一套视觉外观。研究旨在揭示“机器读取的内容”与“人类实际看到的内容”之间的不一致性所带来的安全漏洞。
AI.method: DRJanus 通过反转 HDR 重建过程，在单张 JPEG 中嵌入两个独立选择的色彩图像：攻击不依赖或查询目标模型，保留所选 SDR 基础图像不变，并利用辅助增益图使 HDR 视图重建目标图像。作者进一步评估其对内容审核服务、视觉语言模型和智能体任务的规避与操控效果，并探索跨视图一致性检测作为缓解方式。
AI.result: 实验显示，DRJanus 在 400 张图像上实现平均 43.03 dB 的 HDR 目标重建 PSNR。在 100 张涉性内容图像基准上，该方法可规避全部 6 种测试商业审核服务和 9 个视觉语言模型的检测。在 5 类智能体、每种威胁设置 120 个任务案例中，审核规避成功率为 31.67% 至 100%，任务操控成功率为 95% 至 100%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作暴露了视觉信任链中的关键缺口：仅保障机器读取的 SDR 内容并不能保障用户最终看到的 HDR 内容。跨视图一致性检查是潜在缓解方向，但 HDR/SDR 双表示带来的安全威胁仍需被纳入视觉内容审核与多模态系统防护设计。

title: TuringPAI: A Foundation for On-Device Physical AI
summary: Physical AI requires models that understand spatial relationships and dynamic environments and translate observations into actions under limited onboard compute. We present TuringPAI, a family of models for on-device Physical AI comprising TuringPAI-VL for shared vision-language understanding, TuringPAI-Drive for autonomous driving, and TuringPAI-Embodied for robotic manipulation. TuringPAI-VL is a 0.65B model built on HybridViT-MLQ, which combines convolutional local aggregation with Transformer-based global modeling. Multi-scale Latent Queries integrate spatial features and observation history within the same visual Transformer, providing a compact, structured interface to the language model. Training combines general vision-language data with geometric, cross-view, and temporal supervision. TuringPAI-VL supports general multimodal understanding and improves quantitative geometric perception over Qwen2-VL-2B, while providing a shared initialization for the two downstream VLA models. For autonomous driving, TuringPAI-Drive maintains all evaluated ADE/FDE metrics within 1.2\% of a full-token HybridViT baseline using the MLQ interface and achieves comparable aggregate scores in an in-house simulation evaluation. Using XPeng Native Runtime (XNRT) on a single NVIDIA Orin-X SoC, TuringPAI-Drive generates trajectories at 12\,Hz in on-vehicle operation. For robotic manipulation, TuringPAI-Embodied achieves a 96.8\% average success rate across the four LIBERO suites. These results demonstrate a shared vision-language foundation for driving and robotic manipulation under practical on-device constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TuringPAI 模型族，面向算力受限的车端/机器人端 Physical AI：以 0.65B 的 TuringPAI-VL 为共享视觉-语言基座，分别支撑自动驾驶（TuringPAI-Drive）和机器人操作（TuringPAI-Embodied），在保持较强空间与动态理解能力的同时实现低延迟、可部署的多模态行动预测。
AI.motivation: 物理世界智能体需要模型在有限机载算力下理解空间关系、融合历史观测，并将视觉语言观测转化为可执行动作。现有全 token 视觉-语言方法在自动驾驶和机器人等实时场景中往往计算开销较大、难以部署，因此需要一种紧凑、结构化且可共享基座的多模态表示接口。
AI.method: 作者提出 TuringPAI-VL：0.65B 视觉语言模型，基于 HybridViT-MLQ 架构。HybridViT 将卷积式局部聚合与 Transformer 全局建模结合；MLQ 使用多尺度潜在查询，在同一视觉 Transformer 中整合空间特征与历史观测，为语言模型提供紧凑、结构化的视觉接口。训练融合通用视觉-语言数据，并加入几何、跨视角和时序监督。下游包括 TuringPAI-Drive 用于自动驾驶轨迹预测，以及 TuringPAI-Embodied 用于机器人操作，二者共享 VL 初始化。
AI.result: TuringPAI-VL 支持通用多模态理解，并在量化几何感知任务上优于 Qwen2-VL-2B。TuringPAI-Drive 通过 MLQ 接口使 ADE/FDE 指标保持在完整 token HybridViT 基线的 1.2% 以内，在内部仿真评估中取得可比聚合分数；在单颗 NVIDIA Orin-X 上使用 XPeng Native Runtime 可实现 12 Hz 的车载轨迹生成。TuringPAI-Embodied 在 LIBERO 四个套件中取得 96.8% 的平均成功率。
AI.conclusion: TuringPAI 表明，通过卷积-Transformer 混合视觉编码与多尺度潜在查询接口，可以在保持几何、时序和动态理解能力的同时显著压缩视觉 token 表示，为自动驾驶和机器人操作提供共享的视觉语言基座，适合资源受限的端侧物理 AI 部署。

title: TAP: Tapping the Discriminative Potential of Frozen Representations for Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Pre-trained models provide transferable representations for class-incremental learning (CIL). However, sequentially adapting these representations introduces optimization costs and may disrupt old-class feature structure. This motivates us to explore whether the discriminative potential of these representations can be further exploited by continually accumulating class information while keeping the encoders frozen. To this end, we propose TAP, a new and novel framework for tapping the discriminative potential of frozen representations in class-incremental learning. It accumulates visual and semantic class information in the frozen CLIP embedding space with only lightweight optimization. TAP comprises three modules: class-conditional visual distribution modeling, class-adaptive semantic calibration, and visual-semantic posterior fusion. The first module retains class means and within-class scatters, combining class-specific and shared covariances to stabilize distribution estimation. The second module learns class-specific weights over text templates from current-task images, adapting text representations to downstream classes. The third module combines the visual and semantic posteriors through a weighted product of experts for prediction over all seen classes without retaining images from previous tasks. Across nine datasets under two incremental protocols, TAP achieves state-of-the-art performance, attaining the highest average incremental and final-stage accuracies among the compared methods. The code is provided as an ancillary file.
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Code is included as an ancillary file

AI.tldr: TAP在冻结CLIP编码器的前提下，通过累积视觉与语义类信息实现类增量学习，并用轻量级优化和专家加权乘积融合完成跨任务预测，在九个数据集上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 预训练模型可为类增量学习提供可迁移表示，但持续微调表示会引入优化成本并可能破坏旧类特征结构，因此需要探索如何在冻结编码器条件下进一步释放预训练表示的判别潜力。
AI.method: 提出TAP框架，在冻结CLIP嵌入空间中累积视觉与语义类信息，包含三个模块：1）类条件视觉分布建模，保留类均值和类内散度，并结合类特定协方差与共享协方差稳定分布估计；2）类自适应语义校准，利用当前任务图像学习文本模板上的类特定权重，使文本表示适配下游类别；3）视觉—语义后验融合，通过加权乘积专家结合视觉与语义后验，在所有已见类别上进行预测，且不保留历史任务图像。
AI.result: 在九个数据集和两种增量协议下进行实验，TAP平均增量准确率和最终阶段准确率均达到所比较方法中的最高水平，展现出先进性能。
AI.conclusion: TAP表明冻结预训练表示在类增量学习中仍具有较强判别潜力，通过轻量级类信息累积和视觉—语义后验融合，可在不更新大模型编码器、不存储历史图像的情况下实现高效且先进的类增量学习。

title: PRIO: Pre-trained Representation for Interactive Objects in 4D Worlds
summary: 3D worlds can now be captured, reconstructed, and generated at scale, yet the objects in them stay still: a pressed pillow does not compress, and a pulled door does not swing. Bringing these objects into interactive 4D world models requires a representation of how they can move, deform, and respond physically to user actions in real time. We present PRIO, a pre-trained representation for interactive objects. Given static geometry, PRIO predicts an object-specific configuration space in a single forward pass. This space provides generalized coordinates for Lagrangian mechanics, allowing physical laws and user actions to govern motion. Configurations are linear in these coordinates, allowing the quantities needed by the dynamics to be precomputed. Dynamics then run at interactive rates without further network inference. Pre-trained on diverse 4D trajectories, PRIO learns priors over object configurations that generalize to unseen shapes. It supports meshes, point clouds, and 3D Gaussians, bringing objects in reconstructed and generated scenes into interaction. We demonstrate its use in real-to-sim workflows and robot manipulation. In addition, compared with existing 4D generation methods, PRIO generates dynamics faster and follows user actions more faithfully.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PRIO，一种用于交互式物体的预训练表示方法，能够从静态几何一次性预测物体专属的配置空间，从而以拉格朗日力学驱动实时运动、形变和用户交互。
AI.motivation: 尽管 3D 世界可以被大规模捕获、重建和生成，但其中的物体通常是静态的，无法对按压、拉动、碰撞等用户动作产生真实物理响应。要构建可交互的 4D 世界模型，需要一种能够表示物体如何运动、形变并实时遵循物理规律的表征方法。
AI.method: PRIO 输入静态几何信息，在单次前向推理中预测物体专属的配置空间，该空间为拉格朗日力学提供广义坐标。由于配置在这些坐标上是线性的，动力学所需的量可以预先计算，因此后续模拟可在不依赖网络推理的情况下以交互式速度运行。该方法在多样化 4D 轨迹数据上预训练，学习物体配置的先验，可泛化到未见过的形状，并支持 mesh、point cloud 和 3D Gaussian 等表示。
AI.result: 实验表明，PRIO 可用于 real-to-sim 工作流和机器人操作，并在动态生成速度和对用户动作的遵循程度上优于现有 4D 生成方法。
AI.conclusion: PRIO 将静态 3D 几何转化为可交互、可物理模拟的物体表示，为 4D 世界模型中的实时物体运动和形变提供了通用、高效且可泛化的表征方案。

title: Carry the Fine Print: Budget-Aware Visual Token Compression for Document OCR
summary: Visual token compression often treats salience or similarity as a proxy for transcription importance. Complete document OCR breaks this assumption: small symbols and repeated entries can be indispensable to the transcript despite being visually inconspicuous. We present Select and Compensate, a two-stage framework built on a simple idea: choosing where to retain a token need not determine all the evidence it carries. Selection combines adaptive encoding resolution with global importance and local contrast to choose which tokens to retain as anchors. Compensation enriches these anchors with nearby discarded content and its relative position, without adding tokens. The OCR backbone remains frozen, and native coordinates and structural tokens are preserved. We evaluate complete page transcription across five backbones on OmniDocBench and document reconstruction on MPDocBench. With half the original visual tokens, our input-adapted configuration reaches 95.42 OmniDocBench Overall on Ovis versus 96.09 for the uncompressed model, and paired evaluations show gains over simply reducing the input resolution on both benchmarks. With the original input grid, our method stays within 0.17 points of the uncompressed model at 75% retention and exceeds a learned global selector by 4.70 points at 25%. On a fixed 200-page Ovis workload at the same 50% visual-token budget, only 3 of its outputs hit the length limit, versus 30-34 for the evaluated RTPrune, DivPrune, and HiPrune adaptations, and it finishes the batch 35-40% sooner. Code will be made publicly available.
comment: 11 pages; supplementary material is included as an ancillary file

AI.tldr: 论文提出“Select and Compensate”两阶段视觉 token 压缩框架，用于完整文档 OCR 转录；它不单纯保留显著视觉 token，而是用选择确定锚点，并通过局部补偿将丢弃区域的相对位置信息融入锚点，在保留结构与坐标信息的同时显著降低视觉 token 数量并保持高转录质量。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉 token 压缩方法常以显著性或相似性作为“对转录重要”的代理，但完整文档 OCR 中存在大量视觉上不起眼却语义关键的小符号、重复条目和结构信息，单纯压缩或降低输入分辨率容易破坏文档结构、导致漏识别或输出截断。
AI.method: 方法包含两阶段：（1）Select：结合自适应编码分辨率、全局重要性和局部对比度，选择少量视觉 token 作为锚点；（2）Compensate：在不增加 token 数量的前提下，将邻近被丢弃 token 的信息及其相对位置编码到锚点中。OCR 骨干保持冻结，并保留原生坐标与结构化 token。
AI.result: 在 OmniDocBench 完整页面转录和 MPDocBench 文档重建任务上，跨五种骨干网络进行评估。将视觉 token 减半时，Ovis 上的 OmniDocBench Overall 为 95.42，接近未压缩模型的 96.09；相对单纯降低输入分辨率有显著提升。在原始输入网格下，75% token 保留率时与未压缩模型差距仅 0.17 分，25% 保留率时优于学习式全局选择器 4.70 分。在 200 页固定工作负载、50% token 预算下，仅 3 个输出达到长度上限，而 RTPrune、DivPrune、HiPrune 适配为 30–34 个，并快 35–40%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，文档 OCR 中的视觉 token 压缩不能只依赖显著性选择，而需要将“保留哪些 token”与“保留哪些证据”解耦。通过选择锚点并补偿邻近丢弃内容及其位置，可在大幅降低视觉 token 的同时保持结构、坐标和转录完整性，具有更强低预算鲁棒性和实际效率。

title: Persona Lenses: What Makes a Vision-Language Model See Through Its Persona's Eyes?
summary: Vision-language models have been used to simulate where a user looks on a web page. However, a persona in the prompt reaches the simulated gaze only partly. We measure this reach as the difference in one model's gaze between two MatrAIx personas that differ in a single attribute. We introduce persona lenses, which place the persona between the model and the page: a text lens (a two-step prompt in which the model first writes what the persona would look at), a pixel lens (marks on the region matching the persona's interests) and a weight lens (a dwell reward gated to keep the scanpath natural). Using Qwen3-VL (4B and 32B) and Qwen3.5-9B on generated and live pages, we compare the lenses with one another and with scale, the 32B model with no lens. It has been confirmed that the text lens separates the personas strongly but is not robust to profile changes that should not move gaze. The pixel lens separates the personas less but is unaffected by attributes unrelated to gaze. At 4B and 9B, the weight lens separates the personas on interests held out from training, with no extra step on a new page. The 32B model separates the personas with the base prompt alone. Therefore, the choice of a lens depends on cost and model size.
comment: 29 pages, 9 figures, 14 tables, including supplementary material

AI.tldr: 该论文提出“persona lenses”方法，通过文本、像素和权重三种“透镜”增强视觉-语言模型对网页用户注视模拟中的 persona 控制能力，并在不同模型规模上评估其对 persona 差异的敏感度与对无关属性变化的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型可在提示中注入 persona 来模拟用户在网页上的注视位置，但 persona 往往只能部分影响模拟注视。论文需要一种可度量、可调节的框架，使模型生成的注视路径更准确地区分不同 persona，同时避免被无关画像属性错误地改变。
AI.method: 作者将 persona 差异定义为同一模型在两个 MatraIX persona 下生成注视之间的差异，这两个 persona 仅在一个属性上不同。进一步提出“persona lenses”，把 persona 放在模型与页面之间：1）text lens：两步提示，先让模型写出该 persona 会关注什么；2）pixel lens：在匹配 persona 兴趣的区域添加标记；3）weight lens：用受门控的 dwell reward 影响扫描路径，同时保持路径自然性。实验使用 Qwen3-VL 4B 和 32B、Qwen3.5-9B，在生成网页和真实网页上比较三种 lens，并与模型规模效应（32B 无 lens）对比。
AI.result: 结果显示：text lens 对 persona 差异最敏感，但对不应影响注视的画像属性变化不够鲁棒；pixel lens 的 persona 分离度较低，但更不受无关属性影响；在 4B 和 9B 模型上，weight lens 能在不新增页面处理步骤的情况下，对训练中未见的兴趣仍实现 persona 分离；32B 模型仅靠基础 prompt 就能较好分离 persona。
AI.conclusion: persona lenses 能有效控制视觉-语言模型的网页注视模拟，但不同 lens 在 persona 区分能力、鲁棒性和成本之间存在权衡。较小模型更适合依赖权重或文本增强，而更大模型可能仅靠基础 prompt 即可表现出较强 persona 敏感性；方法选择应取决于模型规模与应用成本。

title: Mesh-Free Keypoint Learning for Category-Level 6D Object Pose Estimation
summary: Category-level 6D pose estimation relates partial RGB-D observations of unseen instances to a canonical frame shared across a category. Object-aware reconstruction helps adaptive keypoints retain the geometry of the visible surface. Common reconstruction targets select observed points by their distance to a registered instance surface. We present MORSEPose, which derives this support directly from standard pose and metric-size annotations. We map observed 3D points to normalized object coordinates and retain those inside a tolerancedilated pose-and-size envelope. This construction is consistent across camera frames and metric scales. When the annotated extent bounds the object surface, the envelope conservatively contains the support of a conventional surface-distance selector. We integrate this target with multi-level RGB-D features, adaptive keypoints, and learnable category context. Experiments on REAL275 and HouseCat6D show that the envelope closely matches surface-based supervision at both point and task levels, remains stable under boundary perturbations and viewpoint changes, and supports competitive category-level pose accuracy across benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MORSEPose，利用标准位姿与度量尺寸标注构造物体包络作为重建目标，替代依赖注册表面的点到面距离选择，实现类别级6D位姿估计中的自适应关键点几何约束。
AI.motivation: 类别级6D位姿估计需从未见过实例的部分RGB-D观测中恢复其到类别规范坐标系的位姿。物体感知重建可帮助自适应关键点保持可见表面几何，但常见重建目标通常依据观测点到已注册实例表面的距离选择支持点，依赖表面配准且在不同相机视角和度量尺度下可能不稳定。
AI.method: 作者提出MORSEPose：将观测到的3D点映射到归一化物体坐标中，并依据由标准位姿标注和度量尺寸标注生成的、经容差膨胀的位姿与尺寸包络筛选可见支持点。该目标不直接依赖注册表面距离，而是从标注本身导出重建支持域。随后将其与多级RGB-D特征、自适应关键点和可学习的类别上下文整合。
AI.result: 在REAL275和HouseCat6D上的实验表明，该包络目标在点级和任务级上均接近传统基于表面距离的监督；在边界扰动和视角变化下保持稳定，并带来具有竞争力的类别级6D位姿估计精度。
AI.conclusion: MORSEPose通过位姿与尺寸标注构造保守且尺度一致的物体包络作为重建目标，能够替代表面距离选择器，为类别级6D位姿估计中的自适应关键点提供稳定、可泛化的几何监督。

title: Multi-View Relighting with Mergeable Radiance Fields
summary: We propose MergeableRF, a method for radiance field relighting through model parameter merging. Given multi-view images of a scene under known basis lights, our goal is to relight the scene by directly combining the parameters of radiance fields trained under these lights. This is motivated by the linearity of light transport: the image under a mixture of lights is the same weighted combination of the images under each light. However, combining the parameters of independently trained radiance fields does not produce the corresponding combination of images. To address this, we represent a scene with shared geometry and a separate appearance network for each basis light. We start these networks from the same initialization and introduce merge-aware training, which teaches their parameter combinations to reproduce the corresponding combinations of images. Given a target HDR environment map, we compute its basis-light coefficients and use them to merge the appearance networks into a single relit model. Our method supports both Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), without material estimation, additional relighting networks, or target-specific optimization. Unlike image-space blending, it requires only one rendering pass per viewpoint. Experiments on synthetic Neural Gaffer objects and real OLATverse captures demonstrate relighting quality competitive with methods trained on the same multi-light observations.

AI.tldr: MergeableRF 通过“合并感知的参数合并”实现辐射场重光照：为每个基光源训练可合并的外观网络，再利用目标环境光的基系数合并参数，得到单次渲染即可重照亮的 NeRF/3DGS 模型。
AI.motivation: 光传输具有线性性，混合光照图像理论上等于各基光源图像加权和。但独立训练得到的辐射场模型参数不能直接线性合并。本文旨在绕过材质估计、额外重光照网络和目标光优化，通过参数合并高效实现高质量场景重光照。
AI.method: 该方法使用共享几何表示，并为每个已知基光源设置单独的外观网络，且从相同初始化开始训练。训练阶段引入 merge-aware training，使外观网络参数的加权组合能够对应图像结果的加权组合。对于目标 HDR 环境图，先计算其相对基光源的系数，再用该系数合并外观网络，形成一个可直接渲染的重照辐射场模型。方法同时支持 NeRF 和 3DGS。
AI.result: 在合成的 Neural Gaffer 对象和真实的 OLATverse 多视角多光照数据上，MergeableRF 的重光照质量可与依赖相同多光照观测训练的重光照方法相竞争，同时每个视角只需一次渲染，避免图像空间合成所需的多次渲染。
AI.conclusion: MergeableRF 表明，通过设计可线性合并的辐射场外观表示和训练约束，可以在不进行材质估计、不增加额外网络、也不对目标光照重新优化的情况下，实现高效且可扩展的 NeRF/3DGS 场景重光照。

title: Contrast Where It Matters: Visual Evidence-Guided Decoding for Mitigating Hallucinations in LVLMs
summary: Despite strong multimodal capabilities, large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate when linguistic priors outweigh visual evidence or when predictions are grounded in irrelevant or misleading image regions. Training-free contrastive decoding mitigates hallucinations by contrasting the original prediction with an auxiliary one that exposes linguistic priors. Yet existing methods focus on altering the auxiliary input or computation and do not ensure that either branch uses query-relevant visual evidence during decoding. We propose Visual Evidence-Guided Decoding (VEGD), a training-free framework that identifies query-relevant visual evidence and guides its use throughout contrastive decoding. VEGD locates this evidence by aggregating localization heads with strong visual responses and coherent spatial structure, then selectively weakens it in the auxiliary image. During generation, VEGD directs visual-carrier heads in both branches toward the same evidence location, strengthening access to intact evidence in the main branch while anchoring the auxiliary branch to its weakened counterpart. An adaptive distribution fusion strategy then combines or contrasts their predictions according to distribution divergence. Experiments across diverse LVLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that VEGD consistently reduces hallucinations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VEGD，一种训练自由的视觉证据引导解码方法，通过在对比解码中定位、引导并选择性弱化查询相关视觉证据，降低大型视觉语言模型的幻觉。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型虽然具备较强多模态能力，但当语言先验压过视觉证据，或预测依据不相关、易误导的图像区域时容易产生幻觉；现有训练自由的对比解码主要通过改变辅助输入或计算来暴露语言先验，但未确保主分支和辅助分支在解码过程中都使用与查询相关的视觉证据。
AI.method: VEGD首先利用具有强视觉响应且空间结构一致的定位头聚合结果，识别与查询相关的视觉证据位置；随后在辅助图像中对该证据进行选择性弱化。在生成过程中，模型将主分支和辅助分支中的视觉承载头都导向同一证据位置：主分支保持访问完整视觉证据，辅助分支锚定弱化后的证据。最后，通过自适应分布融合策略，根据两个分支预测分布的差异程度决定融合或对比其输出。
AI.result: 在多种大型视觉语言模型和不同基准测试上，实验表明VEGD能够持续减少幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 对比解码的关键不仅在于构造辅助分支，更在于确保模型在解码期间利用查询相关的视觉证据；VEGD通过显式定位、引导和自适应融合视觉证据，实现了训练自由且有效的幻觉缓解。

title: Support-Guided Triadic Decoding for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Dialogue with LVLMs
summary: In multimodal multi-turn dialogue, dialogue history plays a dual role: reliable responses provide useful context for subsequent turns, whereas hallucinated responses can propagate errors across turns. Existing training-free methods globally adjust the effect of dialogue history on generation, making it difficult to suppress misleading information without weakening useful context. To address this trade-off, we introduce Support-Guided Triadic Decoding (SGTD), a training-free framework that selectively controls the influence of unreliable history and fuses complementary predictions during decoding. Specifically, Historical Answer Support Estimation measures the visual support of historical responses against type-matched alternatives and identifies low-support content that may mislead later generation. Support-Targeted Attention Intervention then weakens the influence of this content while preserving the surrounding dialogue, producing a support-refined prediction. Triadic Decoding combines this prediction with the full-history prediction and answer-free visual evidence, while the Support-Adaptive Plausibility Constraint filters implausible tokens using visual agreement and historical support. Experiments on MMHalSnowball and VisDiaHalBench across representative LVLMs show that SGTD consistently achieves the highest accuracy under hallucinated histories while preserving the benefits of factual context.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SGTD，一种无需训练的解码框架，通过估计历史回答的视觉支持度并选择性干预注意力，缓解多模态多轮对话中历史幻觉错误传播的问题。
AI.motivation: 多轮对话历史既能提供有用上下文，也可能因前轮幻觉回答导致错误跨轮传播；现有训练免费方法通常全局调整历史影响，难以在抑制误导信息的同时保留有用上下文。
AI.method: 提出Support-Guided Triadic Decoding：先进行历史回答支持估计，用视觉证据与类型匹配替代答案判断历史回答可靠性；再对低支持历史内容进行注意力干预，削弱其影响而保留周边对话；随后三元解码融合支持修正预测、全历史预测和无历史视觉证据预测，并用支持自适应合理性约束过滤不靠谱token。
AI.result: 在MMHalSnowball和VisDiaHalBench等基准上，针对代表性大视觉语言模型，SGTD在含幻觉历史条件下稳定获得最高准确率，同时保留事实性上下文带来的收益。
AI.conclusion: SGTD通过细粒度选择性地抑制不可靠历史并融合互补预测，有效缓解多模态多轮对话中的幻觉传播，且无需额外训练。

title: Query-Aware vs. Query-Agnostic Training-Free Video Token Pruning in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Video Large Language Models process large numbers of visual tokens, making token pruning important for efficient inference. Training-free pruning methods differ in whether and how they use the user query, and the value of query conditioning remains unclear. We present a controlled study of training-free, pre-LLM video token selection. Using a shared Qwen-3-VL backbone, token budgets, and decoding settings, we compare 21 pruning principles spanning query-agnostic, shallow query-conditioned, structured query-conditioned, and holistic strategies. To instantiate the last two categories, we introduce Structured Query Pruning, which decomposes the question into semantic anchors, and a Pareto variant, which combines anchor relevance with query-agnostic visual diversity. Across Video-MME, MVBench, and LongVideoBench, relevance computed from the raw question embedding is unreliable (8--16 points below the best methods), whereas anchors derived from query decomposition avoid this failure. However, query access is not inherently advantageous: strong query-agnostic coverage methods remain competitive or superior in the full-field comparison. Relative to a redundancy-only baseline, structured selection helps most on evidence-specific and long-context tasks at tight budgets; on broad tasks, the holistic selector improves over either relevance or redundancy alone. Further, pruning reduces cost and memory. These results support a practical design rule: preserve visual coverage by default, and add structured relevance when the task and token budget demand selective evidence retrieval.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统比较了多种无需训练的视觉令牌剪枝策略，发现默认保持视觉覆盖更稳健，仅在任务需要检索特定证据或令牌预算很紧时，结构化查询相关性才显著有益。
AI.motivation: 视频大语言模型需要处理大量视觉令牌，令牌剪枝可提升推理效率；但查询条件化剪枝究竟是否优于与查询无关的方法，其价值仍不明确，需要受控比较。
AI.method: 研究在统一 Qwen-3-VL 主干、令牌预算和解码设置下，比较了 21 种无需训练的视频令牌选择原则，包括查询无关、浅层查询条件化、结构化查询条件化和整体策略；并提出 Structured Query Pruning，将问题分解为语义锚点，同时构建将锚点相关性与视觉多样性结合的 Pareto 变体。
AI.result: 在 Video-MME、MVBench 和 LongVideoBench 上，直接使用原始问题嵌入计算相关性不可靠，比最佳方法低 8–16 分；基于查询分解得到的锚点可缓解该问题。查询访问本身并不天然占优，强查询无关覆盖方法在整体比较中仍具竞争力甚至更优。相对冗余基线，结构化选择主要在证据特定和长上下文、紧预算任务上有帮助；在宽泛任务上，整体选择器优于单独使用相关性或冗余。剪枝同时降低计算成本和内存占用。
AI.conclusion: 实用设计原则是：默认保留视觉覆盖；当任务和令牌预算要求选择性证据检索时，再引入结构化查询相关性。

title: Anchored Inertial Proposals with Objective Verification for Diffusion-Prior Inverse Problems
summary: Training-free diffusion priors are powerful for inverse problems, but measurement guidance during reverse sampling is local: aggressive updates can improve immediate data fit while disrupting later denoising. We introduce an anchored inertial correction rule that separates proposal generation from acceptance. At each corrected step, the denoiser prediction anchors a frozen clean-space objective combining measurement fit with a noise-level-dependent proximal term. Heavy-ball dynamics with step size and momentum computed from the measured curvature generate a clean-state candidate; a separate verifier evaluates it with the same objective, with the denoiser prediction retained as fallback; both stages are derived from one objective for the whole trajectory, considered one step at a time. The accepted clean state is re-noised to continue sampling. The rule applies to pixel and latent diffusion with differentiable measurement operators, requires no retraining, and adds no denoiser calls inside the correction loop. We analyze how objective verification yields local nonincrease and displacement control. Across natural-image benchmarks, the method achieves competitive reconstruction quality. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的“锚定惯性校正”规则，用于改善扩散先验在逆问题中的测量引导过程：通过分离候选生成与目标验证，在保持重建数据拟合的同时避免过激更新破坏后续去噪轨迹。
AI.motivation: 训练自由扩散先验在逆问题中表现强，但采样过程中的测量引导通常是局部更新。若步长过大或更新过激，虽然能立即提升测量项拟合，却可能偏离扩散模型的去噪轨迹，导致后续去噪不稳定、重建质量下降。因此需要在不重训模型的前提下，让测量约束更鲁棒地融入反向采样。
AI.method: 方法在每个校正步骤中以去噪器预测作为锚点，冻结一个干净空间目标函数，该目标结合测量拟合项与依赖噪声水平的近端项。随后使用 Heavy-ball 惯性动力学生成干净状态候选，其中步长和动量根据测量曲率计算。另设验证器基于同一目标评估候选；若候选不满足验证条件，则保留原去噪器预测作为回退方案。被接受的干净状态会被重新加噪以继续采样。整个过程不要求重训扩散模型，适用于像素扩散和潜空间扩散，并且校正循环内不需要额外的去噪器调用。
AI.result: 作者分析了目标验证带来的局部目标非增性和位移控制性质。在自然图像基准测试中，该方法取得了具有竞争力的重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 该研究说明：在逆问题扩散采样中，将测量引导从“直接更新”改为“候选生成加目标验证”的校正机制，可以在不重训、不增加去噪器调用的情况下提升轨迹稳定性，并使数据拟合与先验去噪之间形成更可控的平衡。

title: TwoPass: Draft-Guided Few-Step Video Prediction for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Action-conditioned video prediction lets robots anticipate the visual consequences of their actions for planning and policy evaluation. Existing predictors denoise each future from noise without using their own estimate of it, which limits the quality of the predicted future, in particular of the manipulated objects, and requires many network calls. We present TwoPass, a self-conditioned training-and-inference framework that keeps the standard flow-matching objective. Self-Generated Draft Training supplies a detached clean-video estimate from the shared network as conditioning at the same noisy state. A Refinement-Only Late Adapter applies a dedicated residual transformation when a draft is present. At inference, Draft-Reuse Iterative Refinement obtains both a solver update and the next draft from each velocity prediction, requiring as few as 4 function evaluations (NFE) per video chunk. Training samples discrete solver-query noise levels and updates the pretrained backbone. Extensive experiments on Bridge and Language Table show that TwoPass achieves state-of-the-art results with 4 NFE, far fewer than the 50-59 calls of existing predictors. Code: this https URL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TwoPass：一种自条件化（self-conditioned）的训练与推理框架，用于动作条件视频预测。它保留标准 flow-matching 目标，通过让模型使用自身生成的粗略预测作为额外条件，并用专用 late adapter 做精炼，从而在推理时大幅减少函数评估次数（最低约 4 NFE），同时在机器人视频预测上取得 state-of-the-art。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件视频预测模型通常仅从噪声中独立去噪，没有利用模型自身对未来视频的初步估计。这种“单次噪声去噪”范式限制了预测质量，尤其是对被操作物体状态和细节的建模，并且需要大量迭代网络调用（例如 50–59 NFE），不利于机器人规划与策略评估中的高效推理。
AI.method: TwoPass 包含三个核心设计。第一，Self-Generated Draft Training：在训练时从同一共享网络得到一个 detached 的 clean-video 估计作为 draft，并在相同 noisy state 下作为条件输入，使模型学习如何基于自身初步预测进行修正。第二，Refinement-Only Late Adapter：当存在 draft 时，仅用一个专门的 residual transformation 网络模块进行精炼，避免完全改变预训练 backbone 的去噪分布。第三，Draft-Reuse Iterative Refinement：推理时，每次速度预测同时提供 solver update 和下一步 draft，减少额外网络调用。训练中还采样离散 solver-query noise levels，并更新预训练 backbone，以适配带 draft 的自条件化预测流程。
AI.result: 在 Bridge 和 Language Table 基准上，TwoPass 取得了 state-of-the-art 的预测效果。其关键优势是推理效率：每个视频 chunk 最低仅需约 4 次 function evaluations（NFE），远低于现有预测模型通常需要的 50–59 次调用。代码开源。
AI.conclusion: TwoPass 表明，在 flow-matching 视频预测模型中引入自条件化 draft 和轻量 late refinement，可以显著提升被操作物体等细节的预测质量，同时大幅降低采样计算成本。该框架为机器人动作条件视频预测提供了更高质量、更低延迟的 few-step 生成方案。

title: UniReFP: Robust Unified Fingerprinting for Vision Models against Cross-Task Repurposing Attacks
summary: We identify, for the first time, a new model modification attack--the cross-task model repurposing attack--that can render fingerprints generated by existing model fingerprinting approaches inapplicable. To address this challenge, we propose UniReFP--a novel unified model fingerprinting framework applicable to diverse vision models across different tasks--that utilizes ownership evidence in a shared class-level semantic space rather than original task-specific output space, enabling effective ownership verification when a protected model is repurposed across tasks with heterogeneous output formats. Specifically, UniReFP constructs a surrogate classifier by repurposing the protected model, enabling fingerprints to be generated independently of the original task-dependent output space of the protected model. Moreover, it optimizes grouped fingerprints to encode ownership evidence: fingerprints within the same group are encouraged to induce consistent semantic responses and intermediate representations on the surrogate classifier, while producing dispersed responses on independently trained reference classifiers. During verification, UniReFP uses a task-aware semantic projection mechanism to map heterogeneous suspect-model outputs into unified semantic-presence vectors, and determines ownership by measuring inner-group consistency. Extensive experimental results validate the effectiveness of UniReFP, consistently showing superior performance under cross-task repurposing attacks, commonly studied model modification attacks, and even their combinations.

AI.tldr: 本文首次识别出“跨任务模型改造攻击”会破坏现有模型指纹验证，并提出 UniReFP：一种面向多种视觉任务和异构输出空间的统一模型指纹框架，通过在共享类级语义空间中构建和验证分组指纹，实现鲁棒的模型所有权确认。
AI.motivation: 现有模型指纹方法通常依赖原始模型的任务特定输出空间生成或验证指纹。当攻击者将被保护模型改造到其他视觉任务上，使其输出格式和语义空间发生异构变化时，原有指纹可能失效，难以证明模型所有权。
AI.method: UniReFP 首先通过改造被保护模型构建一个代理分类器，使指纹生成不依赖原任务输出空间。其次，它优化分组指纹：同一组指纹在代理分类器上产生一致的语义响应和中间表征，同时在独立训练的基础参考分类器上产生分散响应，以编码所有权证据。验证阶段，UniReFP 使用任务感知的语义投影机制，将不同任务的可疑模型输出映射到统一的语义存在向量，并通过组内一致性判断所有权。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，UniReFP 在跨任务改造攻击、常见模型改造攻击以及二者组合攻击下均保持优异性能，能够有效维持模型所有权验证的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了跨任务模型改造攻击对现有模型指纹机制的新威胁，并证明通过共享类级语义空间进行分组指纹构建与验证，可以为跨任务、异构输出格式的视觉模型提供统一且鲁棒的所有权保护方案。

title: Online Mistake Detection in Instruction-Conditioned Procedural Video
summary: An assistant monitoring a person performing a procedure is most useful when it can detect mistakes while there is still time to recover. This requires judging actions against task instructions as the video unfolds, identifying the attempted step, locating it in time, and assessing its execution. Existing online detectors do not use the instruction text, while instruction-conditioned methods operate offline. In this paper, we study online, instruction-conditioned mistake detection in egocentric videos. Using only observed video, task instructions, and prior predictions, our model identifies and localizes completed action attempts and classifies them as correct, modified, slip, corrections, or additions; omitted steps are determined after the video ends. We compare a modular pipeline, with separate step identification, temporal localization, and execution verification, to a joint model that predicts all outputs in a single step. To support supervised learning from mistakes, we repartition EgoPER to include erroneous videos in all splits. The approaches achieve similar step-segmentation F1@0.5 (93.6% and 92.1%), while the joint model achieves higher binary mistake-detection F1@0.5 (84.1% vs. 80.7%), with its largest gain on slips (56.4% vs. 37.5%). Component-level analysis suggests that error propagation between stages contributes to the modular approach's lower detection score. On test videos containing mistakes, both designs outperform released AEM and ESTANet checkpoints under our evaluation protocol.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出在线、指令条件下的第一视角视频错误检测，用于在执行流程中实时识别已完成动作步骤、定位其时间位置并判断其执行是否正确，并比较模块化流水线与联合模型两种方案。
AI.motivation: 助手式监控系统最有用的场景是在用户执行操作程序时尽早发现错误，以便及时纠正或挽回。现有在线检测器通常不利用任务说明文本，而基于指令条件的方法多为离线处理，难以满足实时、可恢复的纠错需求。
AI.method: 论文研究第一视角视频中的在线指令条件错误检测。模型仅使用已观测视频、任务指令和先前预测结果，识别并定位已完成的动作尝试，并将其分类为正确、修改、slip、纠正或添加；遗漏步骤则在视频结束后确定。作者比较两种架构：模块化流水线分别完成步骤识别、时间定位和执行验证；联合模型在单次预测中同时生成全部输出。为支持错误监督学习，作者重新划分 EgoPER 数据集，使每个 split 都包含错误视频。
AI.result: 两种方案在步骤分割 F1@0.5 上接近：模块化 93.6%，联合模型 92.1%；但联合模型在二元错误检测 F1@0.5 上更高：84.1% 对比 80.7%。联合模型在 slip 类错误上的提升最大：56.4% 对比 37.5%。组件级分析表明，模块化方法各阶段之间的误差传播导致其检测分数较低。在包含错误的测试视频上，两种设计均优于按该评测协议运行的已发布 AEM 和 ESTANet checkpoints。
AI.conclusion: 在线、指令条件下的错误检测可通过联合预测步骤识别、时间定位和执行验证来实现，并且联合模型在错误检测，尤其是 slip 识别方面优于模块化流水线。重新划分的 EgoPER 数据集为错误监督提供了支持。整体而言，联合建模减少了阶段间误差传播，更适合面向实时纠错的场景。

title: VidToC: Rethinking Video Token Compression for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Extending multimodal large language models (MLLMs) from images to videos faces substantial memory and latency challenges due to the massive number of visual tokens. These challenges have driven the development of numerous visual token compression methods and more efficient LLM architectures. However, existing compression methods are often evaluated with different training setups, tasks, and models, making fair comparison difficult. Meanwhile, the growing use of hybrid Mamba-Transformer architectures raises questions about whether compression strategies transfer across backbones. We present VidToC, a controlled evaluation framework for representative compression algorithms, LLM backbones, and time encoding strategies, covering training-free and fine-tuned settings on three complementary video understanding tasks. Our results reveal task-dependent compression behavior and characterize the effects of compression placement, time encoding, and backbone choice. These findings provide empirical guidance for designing and selecting video token compression strategies across tasks and training settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 VidToC：一种面向视频多模态大模型（MLLM）视觉 token 压缩方法的受控评估框架，用于在统一训练配置、骨干模型和任务设置下公平比较压缩策略。
AI.motivation: 将 MLLM 从图像扩展到视频会产生大量视觉 token，带来显存占用和推理延迟挑战。现有压缩方法虽然众多，但常在训练设置、任务、模型结构等方面不一致，难以公平比较；同时，随着 Mamba-Transformer 混合架构兴起，压缩策略是否能在不同 backbone 间迁移尚不清楚。
AI.method: VidToC 对代表性视觉 token 压缩算法、LLM backbone 以及时间编码策略进行受控评测，覆盖免训练和微调两类设置，并在三个互补的视频理解任务上分析压缩位置、时间编码方式和骨干模型选择的影响。
AI.result: 结果表明视频 token 压缩具有明显任务依赖性；压缩方法的效果不仅取决于算法本身，还受到压缩插入位置、时间编码策略以及模型 backbone 类型的影响，因此压缩策略不能简单跨任务或跨架构直接迁移。
AI.conclusion: VidToC 为视频 MLLM 中的 token 压缩提供了可复现、可比较的评估基础，并为不同任务和训练场景下如何选择压缩策略提供了实证指导。

title: QFT-Based Hybrid PointNet-Quantum Neural Networks for LiDAR Point-Cloud Classification
summary: Hybrid quantum-classical learning architectures provide a promising framework for integrating quantum feature transformations into complex data-processing tasks. Among these transformations, the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) offers a structured approach to feature processing, motivating an investigation of how its circuit configuration influences predictive performance, quantum resource requirements, and noise robustness. We present a hybrid PointNet-quantum neural network architecture for LiDAR point-cloud classification, combining classical feature extraction, amplitude encoding, and a variational quantum circuit. Five Fourier-processing configurations are systematically evaluated: No-QFT, Full-QFT-After, QFT-no-swap, IQFT-After, and Trainable-QFT. Experiments on KITTI, nuScenes, and PandaSet across three random seeds assess classification performance, class-level behavior, circuit complexity, and sensitivity to the IBM FakeManilaV2 noise model. Under ideal simulation, IQFT-After achieves the highest weighted F1-score on KITTI (0.857 $\pm$ 0.033), compared with 0.838 $\pm$ 0.023 for No-QFT. Removing the final SWAP gates in the QFT circuit reduces circuit complexity while preserving the Pauli-Z measurement features up to a fixed permutation that can be absorbed by the classification head. Under quantum noise, the circuit ranking changes, with IQFT-After exhibiting greater performance degradation and No-QFT and Trainable-QFT showing stronger robustness. Per-class analysis further identifies dataset-dependent differences in minority-class performance. These results demonstrate that Fourier-processing configuration influences both classification behavior and noise sensitivity, highlighting the role of circuit structure and hardware-aware evaluation in hybrid quantum learning for three-dimensional point-cloud data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合PointNet-量子神经网络架构，用于激光雷达点云分类，并系统比较不同量子傅里叶变换（QFT）电路配置对分类性能、电路复杂度和噪声鲁棒性的影响。
AI.motivation: 混合量子-经典学习架构有望将量子特征变换引入复杂数据处理任务，其中量子傅里叶变换为特征处理提供结构化方式。然而，其电路配置如何影响预测性能、量子资源需求以及噪声鲁棒性仍不明确，尤其在三维点云分类任务中需要进一步研究。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个融合经典特征提取、幅度编码和变分量子电路的PointNet-量子神经网络分类框架，并在KITTI、nuScenes和PandaSet数据集上，以三个随机种子评估五种傅里叶处理配置：无QFT、后置完整QFT、去交换门的QFT、后置逆QFT和可训练QFT。实验从分类指标、类别级别行为、电路复杂性和IBM FakeManilaV2噪声模型下的鲁棒性等方面进行分析。
AI.result: 在理想模拟条件下，后置逆QFT在KITTI上取得最高加权F1分数，为0.857 ± 0.033，高于无QFT配置的0.838 ± 0.023。去除QFT末尾交换门能够降低电路复杂度，同时保持Pauli-Z测量特征在固定置换下不变，该置换可由分类头吸收。在量子噪声条件下，电路性能排序发生变化，后置逆QFT性能下降更明显，而无QFT和可训练QFT表现出更强的鲁棒性。类别分析还显示少数类性能存在数据集依赖差异。
AI.conclusion: 傅里叶处理配置会显著影响混合量子学习系统的分类行为和噪声敏感性，说明电路结构设计在量子增强点云分类中具有关键作用。实际部署需要采用硬件感知的评估方式，在分类性能、量子资源消耗和噪声鲁棒性之间进行综合权衡。

title: LoopedWAM: Looped World Action Models for Elastic Inference
summary: World action models (WAMs) couple generative video modeling with robotic action prediction but typically require large video and action transformers, limiting deployment efficiency. We present LoopedWAM, a compact WAM that recurrently applies a shared six-block core in each expert, executing 30 transformer layers while storing only 12 blocks per expert. To account for their asymmetric inference costs, the video and action experts can operate at different depths: visual features are computed once per query, whereas action computation repeats at every sampling step. We further propose elastic self-distillation, which trains a single elastic checkpoint, LoopedWAM-E, across action-depth and sampling-step budgets. With only 0.58B policy parameters and no robot pretraining, LoopedWAM achieves 96.1% success on LIBERO, 91.9% on RoboTwin 2.0, and 52.2% on RoboCasaGR1, while using $7.4\times$ less peak GPU memory than Fast-WAM under matched inference measurements. On LIBERO, LoopedWAM-E achieves 96.0% success in 27.6 ms or 95.2% in 24.7 ms on an H100, providing multiple accuracy-latency operating points from a single checkpoint; with two sampling steps and four action loops, it stays within 0.5 points of LoopedWAM on all three benchmarks. Ablations demonstrate that weight-shared depth preserves competitive performance, while aggressive action-depth reduction requires explicit budget-aware training. On a real AgileX PiPER arm, LoopedWAM succeeds in 71.3% of 80 trials across four tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LoopedWAM 与 LoopedWAM-E，一种面向世界-动作模型的高效紧凑架构：通过权重共享的循环 Transformer 核心降低显存与参数需求，并利用弹性自蒸馏支持推理深度和采样步数的灵活权衡，在保持高成功率的同时显著降低部署成本。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型通常同时依赖大规模视频 Transformer 和动作 Transformer，导致参数、显存和推理延迟过高，难以实际部署；同时，视频编码与动作推理的计算成本高度不对称，因此需要一种更紧凑、可弹性调节深度的模型设计。
AI.method: LoopedWAM 在每个专家模块中循环复用同一个六层共享 Transformer core，从而在执行约 30 层计算效果的同时仅保存约 12 个模块，实现深度循环的权重共享。针对视频专家与动作专家推理频率不同的特点，模型允许两者采用不同有效深度：视频特征每次查询只计算一次，而动作模块在每个采样步重复执行。进一步提出弹性自蒸馏（elastic self-distillation），训练单一弹性检查点 LoopedWAM-E，使其能够适应不同的动作循环深度和采样步数预算。
AI.result: 在仅 0.58B 策略参数且不使用机器人预训练的条件下，LoopedWAM 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 和 RoboCasaGR1 上分别取得 96.1%、91.9% 和 52.2% 的成功率；在匹配推理配置下，峰值 GPU 显存较 Fast-WAM 降低 7.4 倍。在 LIBERO 上，LoopedWAM-E 可在 H100 上以 27.6 ms 达到 96.0% 成功率，或以 24.7 ms 达到 95.2%；当仅使用 2 个采样步和 4 次动作循环时，三项基准上的表现与完整 LoopedWAM 差距保持在 0.5 个百分点以内。真实 AgileX PiPER 机械臂在四项任务的 80 次试验中达到 71.3% 成功率。
AI.conclusion: LoopedWAM 表明，世界-动作模型并不必然依赖大规模独立 Transformer；通过循环权重共享和针对视频/动作不对称推理成本的弹性设计，可以大幅压缩部署开销，同时保持较强的机器人操作性能。消融结果进一步说明，权重共享足以维持主要性能，但若激进削减动作深度，则需要显式的预算感知训练来保证稳定性。

title: CaT-Movie: Balancing Global Planning and Local Rendering for Long Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: Current multi-shot video generators render only limited durations per pass, requiring long movies to be stitched from local segments across which narrative progression and visual identity drift. To synthesize long-horizon movies with Coherence across Time, we present CaT-Movie, a multi-shot generation system consisting of a global story planner and a local window renderer. The planner expands user requests via a large language model to preserve, infer, and complete story details, while deterministic code maintains the resulting storyboard across shots to compile self-contained shot prompts and index reference frames from generated history. To execute this guidance, the renderer applies reference-routed sparse self-attention and shot-wise cross-attention to route identities from the indexed frames while isolating per-shot textual conditions. Given the scarcity of high-quality open-source multi-shot data, we construct a dataset of over 350K film shots annotated with semantic state transitions, entity grounding, and multi-granularity requests. We further build CaT-MBench, a benchmark on held-out films with the same annotations. It gives every baseline its native format and counts cross-shot consistency only when a cut opens a new camera setup, preventing repeated framing from passing as consistency. On CaT-MBench, CaT-Movie attains the highest average score and the most consistent characters among all methods. The project page is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CaT-Movie，一个由全局故事规划器和局部窗口渲染器组成的多镜头长视频生成系统，通过 LLM 扩充故事细节、确定性代码维护分镜，并以引用帧路由注意力机制保持跨镜头的叙事连贯与角色一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有多数视频生成模型每次只能生成较短片段，长视频需要拼接局部镜头，导致跨镜头的叙事推进不连贯、视觉身份漂移，难以稳定合成长时序、多镜头电影式视频。
AI.method: CaT-Movie 包括两个核心模块：一是全局故事规划器，利用大语言模型扩展用户请求，保留、推断并补全故事细节，并通过确定性代码维护跨镜头故事板，生成自包含的镜头提示并从历史生成结果中索引参考帧；二是局部窗口渲染器，采用引用帧路由稀疏自注意力和镜头级跨注意力，将已生成角色身份从参考帧路由到当前镜头，同时隔离各镜头的文本条件。团队还构建了包含 35 万多个电影镜头并标注语义状态转换、实体定位和多粒度请求的数据集，以及 CaT-MBench 基准，用于评估真实电影留出的跨镜头一致性。
AI.result: 在 CaT-MBench 上，CaT-Movie 取得所有方法中最高的平均分数，并展现出最一致的角色生成效果。
AI.conclusion: CaT-Movie 通过“全局规划 + 局部受控渲染”的设计，有效缓解了长视频多镜头生成中的叙事漂移和角色身份不一致问题，为长时序电影式视频生成提供了可行方案。

title: DAWN: Robust Neural Blind Deconvolution via Alternating Wiener Guidance
summary: Blind image deconvolution (BID) is an ill-posed inverse problem that aims to jointly recover a sharp image and blur kernel from a single degraded observation. Under nontrivial and high noise, which is common in photography and scientific imaging such as microscopy, BID remains particularly challenging, as existing methods suffer from noise overfitting and inaccurate kernel estimation. Existing training-data-free learning methods for BID, such as those based on the deep image prior (DIP), often utilize external guidance by including model-based estimates as additional loss terms, which underexploits the information these estimates carry especially under nontrivial noise. To address these challenges, we propose DAWN, a training-data-free DIP framework that alternates between injecting model-based estimates directly into the model input and refining this imperfect estimate with the network's own prior. To provide more reliable kernel estimates for these injections, we apply autoencoding regularization to both the image and kernel networks. On natural and scientific images under varying levels of Gaussian and Poisson noise, DAWN outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both image and kernel quality (achieving up to +4.5 dB over the next best baseline on the Levin dataset at $\sigma = 0.1$). Without any training images, DAWN remains highly competitive with a state-of-the-art diffusion model on FFHQ, despite the latter being trained on a massive number of in-distribution images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DAWN，一种无需训练数据的盲图像去卷积框架，通过深度图像先验交替注入并精修模型估计结果，并引入自编码正则提升图像与模糊核估计质量，在高噪声条件下取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 盲图像去卷积本身是病态逆问题，在强噪声下尤其困难，现有方法易过拟合噪声并导致模糊核估计不准确。已有无需训练数据的方法通常将模型估计仅作为额外损失项，未能充分利用这些估计中的有效信息。
AI.method: DAWN 基于深度图像先验构建 training-data-free 框架，核心是在两个过程间交替：一方面将基于模型得到的初步估计直接注入网络输入，另一方面利用网络自身先验对这些不完美估计进行精修。同时，对图像网络和模糊核网络施加自编码正则，以获得更可靠的核估计和更稳定的去卷积结果。
AI.result: 在自然图像和科学图像上、不同高斯噪声与泊松噪声条件下，DAWN 在图像质量和模糊核估计质量上均优于现有最先进方法，在 Levin 数据集 σ=0.1 时相对次优基线提升最高达 4.5 dB。并且在不使用任何训练图像的情况下，DAWN 在 FFHQ 上仍与依赖大规模分布内图像训练的扩散模型保持较强竞争力。
AI.conclusion: DAWN 通过将模型估计纳入网络输入并与深度图像先验交替优化，有效缓解高噪声盲去卷积中的噪声过拟合与核估计偏差问题，证明了无需训练数据的方法在复杂噪声场景下也能达到甚至接近大型监督生成模型的性能。

title: Physical Laws without Physics Loss? Probing Learned Dynamics in Video World Models through Forced Response
summary: Do video world models learn physical laws without a physics loss, or merely imitate motion? Overall motion and appearance scores cannot settle it. We investigate this through nonlinear forced response: an excitation shakes the support of a suspended object. We introduce dual visual-numeric conditioning and adapt six image-to-video backbones to predict this motion using only the flow-matching loss. Wan predicts motion accurately and generalizes to unseen excitations, objects, poses, and scenes. Counterfactual tests suggest capabilities beyond replaying training videos. But what laws have they learned? We design three tiers of tests using Taylor expansions of the dynamics and geometry. All six reproduce the linear response, including resonance; five capture higher-order dynamics, including nonlinear softening. Remarkably, softening is barely present in training: only 0.74% of the swing's squared displacement. Extensions to a double pendulum and a rocking block show sustained dynamics are learned more faithfully than brief impacts. Yet learned dynamics may fail to appear when state estimation or propagation goes wrong. We turn these tests and findings into strategies to improve video training and generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套以非线性受迫响应为核心的评估框架，用于判断视频世界模型是否真正学习物理规律，而非仅模仿训练视频中的运动外观；实验表明主流模型能在无显式物理损失下再现共振与高阶非线性软化等动力学。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型常以整体运动或外观评分衡量，但这些指标难以区分“真正掌握物理规律”与“记住并复现训练视频”；需要更有判别力的物理测试来检验世界模型是否理解动力学因果结构。
AI.method: 作者设计悬挂物体支撑点受激振动的非线性受迫响应实验，引入视觉与数值双条件控制，并将六种图像转视频骨干适配到仅使用流匹配损失的视频世界模型设置中；进一步依据动力学和几何的泰勒展开构建三层次测试，以分离线性响应、共振及高阶非线性效应，并扩展至双摆和摇摆方块。
AI.result: 六种模型均能复现线性响应与共振，五种能捕捉高阶非线性动力学；即使训练数据中非线性软化现象仅占摆动位移平方的约0.74%，模型仍表现出泛化能力。双摆与摇摆方块实验显示持续运动比短暂冲击更易被学习，但状态估计或动力学传播错误可能导致学到的规律无法显现。
AI.conclusion: 视频世界模型可在不依赖显式物理损失的情况下学习相当深层的物理规律，但现有评估容易高估其能力；作者将测试和发现转化为改进视频训练与生成的策略，并为构建真正物理一致的世界模型提供诊断依据。

title: RelGeo: Pair-Conditioned Relational Calibration for Frozen Diffusion Correspondence
summary: Frozen diffusion descriptors retrieve strong semantic correspondence candidates, yet cosine nearest-neighbor matching can select incorrect locations despite valid high-ranking alternatives. Across DIFT-SD2.1 and DiTF-FLUX on SPair-71k, AP-10K, and SOCO (CC, SOC, Cross-SOC), 41-69% of Top-1 errors retain a PCK@0.10-valid match among the original Top-5 spatial peaks, revealing a persistent candidate-selection bottleneck. We find that descriptor rankings and current-pair relational evidence can favor different candidates: reciprocal diffusion Query/Key associations and pretrained RoMa transport exhibit distinct, partly complementary preferences. To incorporate this evidence into matching decisions, we introduce RelGeo, a Pair-Conditioned Relational Calibration framework expressing heterogeneous relations as shared source-target coordinates. Spectral Relational Coordinates (SRC) encode reciprocal diffusion affinities, while Warp Identity Coordinates (WIC) encode reliability-weighted bidirectional transport endpoints. Their inner products augment frozen descriptor similarity while preserving full-domain cosine nearest-neighbor matching without additional semantic-correspondence training. RelGeo improves all ten evaluations by an average of 5.51 PCK@0.10 points; fixed-candidate reranking and pair-misalignment controls corroborate improved selection and dependence on current-pair relational alignment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RelGeo：一种无需额外语义对应训练的成对条件关系校准方法，通过将扩散 Query/Key 互惠关联和 RoMa 传输端点编码为共享源-目标坐标，并以其内积修正冻结扩散描述子的余弦相似度，显著缓解 Top-1 候选选择错误问题，平均提升 PCK@0.10 约 5.51 个点。
AI.motivation: 冻结扩散描述子虽然能检索到较强的语义对应候选，但直接采用余弦最近邻匹配时仍常选错位置；作者发现 Top-1 错误中有 41%-69% 在原始 Top-5 空间峰值内仍包含 PCK@0.10 有效的正确匹配，说明存在稳定的候选选择瓶颈。同时，描述子排序与当前图像对内部的关系证据可能偏好不同候选，因此需要把这些异构关系证据引入匹配决策。
AI.method: 作者提出 RelGeo，一个 Pair-Conditioned Relational Calibration 框架，把多种关系证据表达为共享的 source-target 坐标空间：1）Spectral Relational Coordinates 编码互惠扩散 Query/Key 关联；2）Warp Identity Coordinates 编码由可靠度加权的 RoMa 双向传输端点。这些关系坐标的内积被用来增强冻结描述子的相似性，同时保持全领域余弦最近邻匹配流程，不需要额外的语义对应训练。
AI.result: 在 DIFT-SD2.1 和 DiTF-FLUX 上，于 SPair-71k、AP-10K 以及 SOCO（CC、SOC、Cross-SOC）的十项评测中，RelGeo 全部取得提升，平均提高 5.51 个 PCK@0.10 点。固定候选重排序实验和配对错位控制实验进一步表明，性能提升主要来自候选选择改善，并依赖于当前图像对的关系对齐信息。
AI.conclusion: Frozen diffusion descriptor matching 的主要瓶颈之一不是候选检索不足，而是 Top-1 选择不可靠；RelGeo 通过训练无关的成对关系校准，将扩散注意关联和光流传输端点转化为可融合坐标证据，有效提升了语义对应匹配精度，说明当前图像对内部的关系证据对候选选择具有重要价值。

title: What One Sample Cannot See: Why Fewer Denoising Steps Can Score Higher on Physics Benchmarks
summary: When a storm can head north or south, a forecast down the middle may score better under squared error than either plausible path. The same paradox appears when video generators are tested as world models: fewer denoising steps can raise physics scores even as videos blur or stop moving early. Why? Physics-IQ compares each generated video with one recording, although a scene can have multiple valid futures. An exact decomposition shows its scores can reward reduced variation among generated futures, even when their distribution becomes less accurate. We introduce Kernel Physics-IQ to remove this incentive in expectation, needing only two independent samples per condition. Two-step sampling lowers Kernel Physics-IQ in all five image-to-video models. For CogVideoX, the official score rises by 0.055 while ours falls by 0.131. Changing the sampling schedule reveals further differences official scores miss. In controlled physical systems with known outcome probabilities, our metric favors the true distribution over collapsed predictions. In short, a world model should be judged not only by how closely one video matches what happened, but by how faithfully its predictions represent what could have happened.

AI.tldr: 该摘要指出 Physics-IQ 在评估视频生成世界模型时可能奖励预测分布坍缩：减少生成未来之间的多样性反而可能提高分数，即使分布更不准确；作者提出只需每条件两个独立样本的 Kernel Physics-IQ，以去除这种激励，并证明其能更好识别真实物理分布。
AI.motivation: 当物理场景存在多个合理未来时，传统“与单段真实录像比较”的评分方式可能像平均风暴路径一样产生悖论：更少的去噪步骤或更模糊、运动提前停止的视频反而可能获得更高物理分数。其根本原因是 Physics-IQ 将每个生成视频与一条真实记录比较，隐含奖励生成结果之间变异降低，而非奖励对可能未来分布的忠实建模。
AI.method: 作者首先对 Physics-IQ 的评分行为进行精确分解，说明它可能因降低生成样本之间的多样性而获益。随后提出 Kernel Physics-IQ，用基于核的分布比较思想，在期望意义上消除这种“坍缩奖励”。该指标只需每个条件下两个独立采样结果，即可对生成预测分布进行评估；并在多个 image-to-video 模型和已知结果概率的受控物理系统中验证。
AI.result: 两步采样在全部五个 image-to-video 模型中都降低了 Kernel Physics-IQ，说明更少去噪步骤并不必然代表更好的世界模型物理理解。对于 CogVideoX，官方 Physics-IQ 分数上升 0.055，而 Kernel Physics-IQ 下降 0.131，表明两者对采样质量变化的判断相反。改变采样时间表还能暴露官方分数未能捕捉到的差异；在受控物理系统中，Kernel Physics-IQ 更偏好真实结果分布，而非坍缩预测。
AI.conclusion: 评估视频世界模型时，不能只看单段生成视频是否与已发生录像相似，还必须考察模型是否忠实表征“可能发生的未来”的分布。Physics-IQ 可能被分布坍缩误导，而 Kernel Physics-IQ 提供了更稳健、少样本且能抑制虚假奖励的替代评估方式。

title: LG-FiLM: Local-Global Mixture-of-Experts Modulation for RAW-to-RGB Reconstruction
summary: An image signal processor does more than reconstruct an image. It also has to decide how strongly to denoise, how to balance color, and which tone curve maps the scene onto the display, and these settings depend on the scene itself, the curve that suits a backlit sky is not the one that suits an indoor portrait. Most neural ISPs learn a single fixed transformation and apply it to every scene. We instead make the adaptation an explicit part of the network. Our model, LG FiLM, keeps one shared encoder decoder and places a small mixture of affine experts at its bottleneck; the experts scales, shifts, and mixing weights are predicted from local neighborhood evidence together with a global scene descriptor. Reconstruction stays in a single shared pathway and only the processing mode is switched. We evaluate LG FiLM on three datasets, Fujifilm UltraISP, Zurich RAW to RGB, and a COCO derived benchmark built with an inverse ISP. The model reaches the best reconstruction fidelity of the compared entries on the primary benchmark and transfers to the other two.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 LG FiLM，一种面向神经 ISP 的场景自适应图像信号处理网络，通过在共享 encoder-decoder 的 bottleneck 中引入由局部与全局信息预测的仿射专家混合，使去噪、色彩平衡和色调映射等处理模式能够根据场景动态切换，同时在三个 RAW-to-RGB 基准上验证了其重建保真度与跨数据集迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 传统或多数神经图像信号处理器（ISP）往往学习一个固定映射函数，对所有输入图像施加相同处理策略。但真实图像 ISP 不仅需要重建图像，还必须根据场景内容判断去噪强度、色彩平衡方式以及适用色调曲线，例如逆光天空与室内人像需要不同的处理模式。因此，将场景自适应作为显式建模对象是提升神经 ISP 实用性的关键。
AI.method: 论文提出 LG FiLM 模型，其核心是在单一共享 encoder-decoder 重建路径中，把场景自适应显式加入网络。具体地，模型在网络 bottleneck 处放置一个小型混合仿射专家模块（mixture of affine experts），其中每个专家对特征执行 FiLM 式的 scale 与 shift 操作，并通过混合权重组合。这些 scale、shift 和权重由两部分信息共同预测：局部邻域证据与全局场景描述符。由于特征调制只改变处理模式，像素级图像重建仍保持在共享主干网络中，从而兼顾自适应性与稳定性。模型在 Fujifilm UltraISP、Zurich RAW to RGB 以及基于 inverse ISP 构造的 COCO 派生基准上进行评估。
AI.result: LG FiLM 在主基准上达到所比较神经 ISP 方法中最好的重建保真度，并且在另外两个数据集上也表现出良好的迁移能力，说明该自适应机制具有跨数据集和跨场景适用性。
AI.conclusion: 将场景自适应作为神经 ISP 的显式网络结构，比使用单一固定映射更适合真实 RAW 图像处理任务。LG FiLM 通过局部与全局联合预测的仿射专家混合，在不破坏共享重建路径的前提下实现了按场景切换处理模式，为神经 ISP 从静态映射向动态、场景自适应处理演进提供了一种有效方案。

title: TRACE: Attribute Execution for Sequential Image Editing
summary: Given an image and successive user instructions, sequential image editing should return an updated image that satisfies each new request and preserves earlier requirements that remain active. This lets users develop a result without repeatedly restating or repairing their decisions. The difficulty is that a retrieved image can contain a valid color on an obsolete surface, while the current image may lack the newly requested material. Neither reference selection nor a precise object mask alone specifies how to reconcile attributes occupying the same region. We present TRACE, which separates the continuing attribute from its visual carrier and prioritizes local appearance operations under complete-request checks. Active-goal binding identifies what should persist, carrier selection supplies suitable current or newly generated pixels, and tonal calibration reduces tinting near highlights and shadows. Experiments across frozen editors, independent visual readers, new source images, and complete sequential benchmarks support joint color-material recovery and show how local execution preserves the surrounding scene.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE方法，用于顺序图像编辑中同时满足新指令并保留仍然有效的历史要求。其核心是将“持续属性”与其“视觉载体”解耦，通过目标绑定、载体选择和色调校准，实现局部、可靠的外观编辑。
AI.motivation: 在连续图像编辑中，用户不应反复重述或修补早期决策。然而，检索到的参考图像可能在已失效表面上包含正确颜色，而当前图像又可能缺少新请求的材质；仅靠参考选择或对象掩码难以解决同一区域中多个属性的协调问题。
AI.method: TRACE将持续存在的编辑目标与承载该目标的像素区分开。方法包括：Active-goal binding识别应保留的当前要求；carrier selection选择或生成合适的当前/新像素作为外观载体；tonal calibration校正高光与阴影附近的串色问题；并在完整请求检查下优先执行局部外观操作。
AI.result: 在冻结编辑器、独立视觉读者评估、新源图像和完整顺序编辑基准上的实验表明，该方法能够联合恢复颜色与材质需求，并通过局部执行保持周围场景不变。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过分离属性与载体、约束局部编辑和校准色调，提升了顺序图像编辑中历史需求与新需求同时满足的能力，为复杂多轮图像编辑提供了更一致、可控的方案。

title: SEAF: Selective Semantic Enrichment and Visual Evidence Fusion for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection
summary: Multimodal sarcasm detection requires textual, visual, and contextual evidence, particularly when multiple images provide complementary cues. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate auxiliary information from a post's text and images, but their outputs may mix useful background knowledge with redundant visual descriptions. We propose SEAF, a dual-branch framework for selective semantic enrichment and visual evidence fusion. SEAF assigns generated fields to distinct roles: entity background enriches semantic input, while image descriptions supply alignment statistics. The semantic branch combines the original post text, background from a frozen MLLM, and optical character recognition (OCR) text. The aligned visual branch combines global and local visual features with statistics of cross-modal and inter-image similarity. Text-Anchored Smoothed Aggregation (TASA) weights images by their similarity to the original post text while preserving contributions from images with low literal similarity. Summing the branch classification scores integrates contextual semantics with visual evidence. Experiments on the multi-image MMSD3.0 benchmark show that SEAF outperforms all compared methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SEAF双分支框架，用于多模态（文本、图像、上下文）讽刺检测。它利用多模态大语言模型生成的信息，并将实体背景知识与图像描述分配给不同角色，从而在减少冗余的同时增强语义理解与视觉证据融合。
AI.motivation: 多模态讽刺检测尤其涉及多图场景时，需要同时整合文本、视觉和上下文证据。现有多模态大语言模型虽能生成辅助信息，但输出中常混杂有用背景知识与冗余图像描述，直接影响讽刺判断效果。
AI.method: 论文提出双分支框架SEAF，其核心是选择性语义增强与视觉证据融合。语义分支结合原始帖子文本、冻结的MLLM生成的实体背景知识以及OCR文本。对齐的视觉分支结合全局与局部视觉特征，并引入跨模态和图间相似度统计。此外，提出Text-Anchored Smoothed Aggregation（TASA）方法，根据图像与原始文本的相似度对图像进行加权，同时保留字面相似度较低的图像贡献。最终通过相加两个分支的分类得分，整合上下文语义与视觉证据。
AI.result: 在多图MMSD3.0基准上的实验表明，SEAF优于所有对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 将MLLM生成的不同类型信息赋予明确角色、避免冗余，并结合TASA进行图像选择性聚合，能够更有效地融合多模态讽刺检测所需的语义与视觉证据，提升模型性能。

title: Minimal Memory for Correctable Visual Continuation
summary: Given past images and known actions, visual continuation generates future frames from one evolving scene state. Keeping this state revisable matters when an object reappears or a later view changes an earlier interpretation. Once past images cannot be replayed, a summary sufficient for current rendering can lose candidates needed after correction. We establish matching sparse and dense bounds on the bits needed for later correction under stable observations and bounded disagreement. For static streams at the stated smoothness and margin scales, correction incurs at least logarithmic overhead in one dimension and polynomial overhead in higher dimensions. Coherent Archive Memory (CAM) stores geometric summaries with exact updates under clipped expansion and coordinate assignments, then uses historical existence constraints to select one state for all requested frames. Exhaustive photographic tests show strict worst-truth image-risk gains from joint witnesses, while controlled neural continuations recover positions hidden in the current view.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对“视觉续写”中可修正的场景状态表示问题，给出纠错所需信息量的稀疏/稠密下界，并提出基于几何摘要与历史一致性约束的记忆机制 CAM。
AI.motivation: 视觉续写需要基于过去图像和已知动作生成同一场景的未来画面。当后续新视角改变先前解释、且旧图像无法重放时，只保留“当前渲染足够”的场景摘要可能导致纠错候选丢失，因此需要可修正状态及其记忆开销分析。
AI.method: 在稳定观测和有界分歧假设下，建立后续纠错所需比特数的稀疏与稠密界；对于静态图像流，在给定平滑度和 margin 尺度下，一维纠错至少产生对数级开销，高维产生多项式级开销。随后提出 Coherent Archive Memory (CAM)：存储几何摘要、通过 clipped expansion 和 coordinate assignments 实现精确更新，并利用历史存在约束为所有请求帧选择统一场景状态。
AI.result: 实验显示：在摄影测试中，CAM 利用联合见证带来严格的最坏真值图像风险改善；在受控神经续写任务中，该方法能够恢复当前视图中被隐藏的位置。
AI.conclusion: 可修正视觉状态记忆存在信息论下限；CAM 通过几何摘要、精确更新和历史一致性约束，在维持可纠错场景状态的同时改善后续画面生成与隐藏位置恢复。

title: Beyond Entity Recognition: Vision-Centric Knowledge Visual Question Answering
summary: We propose VC-VQA, a large-scale benchmark for vision-centric knowledge reasoning, aiming to systematically evaluate the capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in fine-grained visual knowledge acquisition and complex multi-stage reasoning. Unlike existing benchmarks that primarily treat visual information as entity recognition and rely on text-based external knowledge, VC-VQA explicitly models the role of visual information by considering both its source (internal vs. external images) and stage of involvement (pre-retrieval vs. post-retrieval). Specifically, VC-VQA requires models to retrieve external visual evidence, identify visual clues before retrieval, and localize, verify, or match retrieved knowledge against the internal image. We further construct a controlled multimodal knowledge base with traceable textual and visual evidence for each sample. We evaluate 21 representative MLLMs under four settings: no external knowledge, with provided evidence, knowledge base retrieval, and open-web search. Experimental results lead to three key findings: current models still struggle with vision-centric knowledge reasoning; fine-grained visual knowledge acquisition remains the primary bottleneck; and agentic retrieval highlights the value of multi-step planning and cross-modal knowledge integration. Overall, VC-VQA provides a more challenging benchmark for evaluating vision-centric knowledge reasoning in MLLMs. Our code and dataset are available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VC-VQA：一个面向视觉中心知识推理的大规模基准，用于系统评估多模态大模型在细粒度视觉知识获取与复杂多阶段推理上的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉问答或知识推理基准大多将视觉信息简化为实体识别，并主要依赖文本外部知识，较少显式建模视觉证据在知识检索前、检索中及检索后的不同作用。因此，需要更严格地评估多模态大模型在真实、细粒度、视觉中心的知识推理能力。
AI.method: 作者构建 VC-VQA 基准，显式区分视觉信息的来源（内部图像与外部图像）和参与阶段（检索前与检索后），要求模型检索外部视觉证据、在检索前识别视觉线索，并对检索到的知识与内部图像进行定位、验证或匹配。同时，构造带有可追溯文本和视觉证据的受控多模态知识库。进一步在四种设置下评估 21 个代表性多模态大模型：无外部知识、提供证据、基于知识库检索、开放网页搜索。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前多模态大模型在视觉中心知识推理方面仍存在明显不足，细粒度视觉知识获取是主要瓶颈。代理式检索实验进一步说明多步规划和跨模态知识整合的重要性。
AI.conclusion: VC-VQA 为评估多模态大模型的视觉中心知识推理能力提供了更具挑战性的基准，揭示了视觉证据获取、验证与多阶段推理仍是当前模型的关键短板。

title: D3-Cache: Accelerating Diffusion Models with Dynamic Mode Decomposition
summary: Diffusion Transformers generate high-quality images and videos, but every sampling step requires a full network evaluation. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reusing or forecasting network outputs across steps, but common approaches use per-model calibrated skip criteria or maintain per-layer prediction histories. We present D3-Cache, which applies Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to Diffusion sampling: it fits DMD to a short history of exact velocities and forecasts only the velocity that the scheduler consumes. A horizon-aware gate decides when to skip: whenever the network is evaluated, its output is compared with the forecast for that step, and the larger the error, the sooner the network is evaluated again, up to a cap on consecutive skipped steps. D3-Cache requires no training or per-model offline calibration curve and adds negligible memory. It shares one history length and risk tolerance across the four evaluated models. On four state-of-the-art image and video models, D3-Cache achieves speedups of 2.6-3.8x with high fidelity to the base model output.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 D3-Cache，一种免训练的扩散 Transformer 推理加速缓存方法。它利用动态模态分解（DMD）对扩散采样中调度器使用的速度输出进行预测，并通过误差驱动的跳步门控机制减少完整网络前向计算，在图像与视频生成模型上实现 2.6–3.8 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散 Transformer 生成高质量图像和视频，但每个采样步骤都需要完整的网络评估，导致推理成本高。现有免训练缓存方法通常依赖为每个模型离线校准的跳步标准，或维护逐层预测历史，限制了通用性和实用性。因此，需要一种无需训练、无需逐模型校准、低内存开销且能在不同模型间共享配置的推理加速方法。
AI.method: D3-Cache 将动态模态分解（DMD）应用于扩散采样过程：首先收集一段较短的精确速度输出历史，然后用 DMD 拟合这些历史并预测后续采样步骤中调度器所消费的velocity。随后引入具有时间范围感知能力的门控机制决定何时跳过网络评估：每当进行一次真实网络评估时，将网络输出与当前步骤的预测值比较，预测误差越大，下一次恢复网络评估的时间越早；同时设置连续跳步的上限，以控制加速风险。
AI.result: 在四个先进的图像和视频扩散模型上，D3-Cache 在不进行训练且不需要逐模型离线校准曲线的前提下，实现了 2.6–3.8 倍推理加速，并保持与基础模型输出较高的保真度。该方法只需一个共享的历史长度和风险容忍度设置，且几乎不增加内存开销。
AI.conclusion: D3-Cache 表明，DMD 可以在扩散采样的速度空间中进行有效外推，从而为扩散 Transformer 提供实用的免训练缓存加速。该方法通过预测误差动态控制跳步行为，在加速与生成质量之间取得良好平衡，适合跨模型部署。

title: LIFT: Lifting Language-Controlled Image Fusion to Free-Viewpoint 3D Scenes
summary: Multimodal image fusion traditionally generates a single fused image from paired observations at a specific viewpoint, limiting comprehensive scene perception and adaptability to diverse perceptual objectives. To overcome these limitations, we present LIFT, a novel framework for our proposed language-controlled 3D image fusion (L3D-IF) paradigm that extends multimodal image fusion from 2D images to free-viewpoint 3D scenes, enabling language-guided fusion tailored to diverse perceptual objectives. First, LIFT formulates Semantic Modality Binding (SMB), which interprets language instructions to identify semantic targets and their associated modality preferences and grounds these targets in corresponding regions of a shared Gaussian scene, establishing persistent semantic-to-spatial correspondences for consistent fusion control across viewpoints. Second, Language-Conditioned Gaussian Appearance (LCGA) is developed to achieve scene-wide multimodal appearance modeling by combining adaptive multimodal blending with language- and viewpoint-conditioned appearance refinement, enabling spatially adaptive realization of diverse fusion appearances while preserving source fidelity at pure-modality endpoints. Finally, we construct a Multi-View Language-Supervision (MVLS) dataset that associates language instructions and calibrated viewpoints with modulated fused images, providing effective supervision for learning instruction-dependent fusion from finite multi-view observations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LIFT achieves coherent multimodal fusion across continuous viewpoints, accurate semantic target localization, and consistent regional fusion control under diverse language instructions.

AI.tldr: 提出LIFT框架，面向语言控制的3D图像融合，将传统成对2D模态融合扩展为可在自由视角3D场景中按语言指令调节的多模态融合。
AI.motivation: 传统多模态图像融合通常只针对特定视角的成对观测生成单一融合图像，难以全面感知场景，也难以适应不同感知目标。需要一种能够结合语言指令、在连续视角下对3D场景进行可控多模态融合的方法。
AI.method: LIFT通过三个核心组件实现语言控制的3D图像融合：Semantic Modality Binding（SMB）将语言指令解析为语义目标及模态偏好，并绑定到高斯场景中的对应区域，以建立跨视角一致的语义到空间对应关系；Language-Conditioned Gaussian Appearance（LCGA）结合自适应多模态混合以及语言与视角条件下的外观细化，实现场景级、空间自适应的多模态外观建模，同时保持纯模态端点的源保真度；Multi-View Language-Supervision（MVLS）数据集将语言指令、标定视角与受控融合图像关联，为从有限多视角观测中学习指令依赖融合提供监督。
AI.result: 实验表明，LIFT能够在连续视角间实现一致的多模态融合，准确定位语义目标，并在不同语言指令下保持区域化融合控制的一致性。
AI.conclusion: LIFT将多模态图像融合从固定视角2D融合推进到语言可控的自由视角3D场景融合，为面向不同感知目标的多模态场景理解与渲染提供了新的框架和数据监督方式。

title: Slide2PPT: Native PowerPoint Reconstruction with Localization-Guided Refinement
summary: Image-to-slide reconstruction must recover both visual appearance and native object structure for subsequent editing. Yet visually faithful charts and tables may lack editable series and cells, and direct code generation couples content prediction to rendering implementation. We present Slide2PPT, a model-agnostic, training-free framework that equips both open- and closed-source vision-language models with native PowerPoint reconstruction capabilities. Through a unified typed interface, the model predicts object records while a fixed renderer materializes their native properties, enabling integration with different backbones without task-specific training or architectural changes. Localization-guided refinement then connects visual discrepancies to object records for correction. Regional updates preserve unselected records, while whole-slide updates address cross-region relationships. Record refinement and targeted object editing support structural and attribute-level changes, with rendered feedback governing iterative acceptance. To evaluate this framework across diverse reconstruction demands, we introduce Slide2PPT-Bench, covering controlled elements, real slides, and scientific figures. Evaluation separately measures file production, rendered agreement, and native-object availability. Experiments across open- and closed-source backbones demonstrate substantially more reliable PPTX generation than direct code generation, improved layout and text recovery on scientific figures, and native chart and table interfaces beyond geometric primitives.

AI.tldr: 提出 Slide2PPT：一种免训练、模型无关的图像转原生 PowerPoint 重建框架，通过“类型化对象记录 + 固定渲染器 + 定位引导迭代修正”实现可编辑、视觉一致的 PPTX 生成，并构建 Slide2PPT-Bench 进行多维评测。
AI.motivation: 图像到幻灯片的重建不仅要还原视觉外观，还要恢复原生对象结构（如图表系列、表格单元格、文本框等）以便后续编辑。但现有视觉重建可能只生成不可编辑的几何图元，直接代码生成又会把内容预测与渲染实现耦合，导致跨模型集成困难、可编辑性和稳定性不足。
AI.method: Slide2PPT 将 VLM 与原生 PowerPoint 生成解耦：模型仅预测统一类型化接口下的“对象记录”，由固定渲染器把这些记录实例化为 PPTX 原生对象属性，从而无需任务特定训练或架构改动即可接入开源/闭源模型。框架进一步利用渲染结果与输入图像之间的视觉差异进行定位引导修正，支持区域级更新、整页级更新、记录细化和目标对象编辑，并以渲染反馈控制迭代接受，最终生成可编辑的 PPTX。同时提出 Slide2PPT-Bench，覆盖受控元素、真实幻灯片和科学图表，分别评估文件生成、渲染一致性和原生对象可用性。
AI.result: 在开源和闭源视觉语言模型骨干上，Slide2PPT 相比直接代码生成能够更可靠地生成 PPTX；在科学图表上 improves 版式与文本恢复；并且原生图表和表格接口优于仅输出几何图元的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过把内容预测从渲染实现中解耦，并引入定位引导的对象级迭代修正，Slide2PPT 为不同 VLM 提供了一套实用、免训练且模型无关的原生 PowerPoint 重建方案，兼顾视觉还原与可编辑性。

title: Calibrate in Context: Efficient Data-Free Quantization from Small Synthetic Pools
summary: We enable accurate low-bit recovery from small synthetic pools by improving both image synthesis and student preparation. A grid with lower local response error can incur greater error in the student's block context. Functional Grid Calibration (FGC) selects activation scales and integer offsets against full-precision responses constructed from the student's current block input. With weights fixed during calibration, FGC evaluates candidates only at their consuming operators, bringing block context to calibration at nearly local-scoring cost. For DeiT and ViT, progressive inversion updates the same images through increasingly deep teacher prefixes. With 1,000 images, the complete pipeline exceeds MimiQ's reported accuracy in all 18 W4A4/W5A5 settings across nine backbones. With 256 images, DeiT-S and ViT-S reach 68.20% and 66.90% ImageNet top-1 accuracy at W4A4 in 26-27 minutes on one RTX 5090. The pipeline outperforms strengthened 1K-image MimiQ by 13.03 and 24.36 percentage points at lower preparation cost and the same recovery-update count. The same low-budget checkpoints retain their advantage on ImageNetV2.
comment: 21 pages, 5 main figures. Supplementary material included

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种低比特模型恢复流程，通过“块上下文感知”的功能网格校准和渐进式图像反演合成，在仅有小规模合成样本池的情况下显著提升W4A4/W5A5量化恢复精度，并降低准备成本。
AI.motivation: 在低比特量化恢复中，仅依赖局部响应误差校准可能忽视量化学生在真实块级上下文中的误差放大；同时，小规模合成数据池的数据质量和样本准备效率会显著影响恢复精度与成本。因此需要同时改进图像合成与学生模型校准。
AI.method: 核心包括两点。第一，Functional Grid Calibration（FGC）在选择激活尺度和整数偏移时，不再只依据局部响应误差，而是利用由学生当前块输入构造的全精度响应进行校准。校准过程中冻结权重，只在消耗该激活的算子处评估候选网格，从而以接近局部评分的成本引入块级上下文。第二，针对DeiT和ViT，采用渐进式反演，使同一组图像在越来越深的teacher前缀中持续更新，提高合成样本对后续层和块上下文的代表性。完整流程用于低比特模型恢复，并重点比较W4A4和W5A5设置。
AI.result: 在1000张图像设置下，完整流程在9个骨干网络的18个W4A4/W5A5场景中均超过MimiQ报告的精度。在256张图像的低预算设置下，DeiT-S和ViT-S在ImageNet上的W4A4 top-1准确率分别达到68.20%和66.90%，单卡RTX 5090仅需26-27分钟。与增强版使用1000张图像的MimiQ相比，该方法在恢复更新次数相同、准备成本更低的情况下，分别取得13.03和24.36个百分点的精度提升，并在ImageNetV2上保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，低比特模型恢复的关键不仅在于校准目标误差，还在于让校准和合成样本反映学生模型的真实块级上下文。FGC与渐进式图像反演相结合，可以在极小规模数据预算和较低训练准备成本下实现更强精度，尤其适合DeiT、ViT等Transformer模型的低比特恢复场景。

title: SkillLens: Action-Guided Dense Visual Dynamics for Proficiency Estimation
summary: Human proficiency estimation is challenging because skill is a high-level and often subjective property that is not captured by action identity alone. Existing approaches leverage multimodal observations such as ego-exo video, gaze, pose, and inertial signals, but the gap between sensor-level evidence and abstract proficiency labels remains difficult to bridge. We present SkillLens, a proficiency estimation framework that uses atomic action descriptions as temporal guidance, rather than direct semantic supervision, to localize proficiency-relevant windows for dense visual-dynamics extraction. Each window is summarized into an action-dynamics feature and scored by a high-low prototype margin against higher- and lower-proficiency executions from the same activity-action category. Fusing these ego/exo PDM cues with a global ego-exo-gaze baseline through CORAL ordinal calibration, our method achieves 0.542 accuracy on Ego-Exo4D. Our project page is available at this https URL
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables, Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SkillLens，一种利用原子动作描述进行时序定位并提取密集视觉动态特征的人类技能熟练度估计框架，在 Ego-Exo4D 上达到 0.542 准确率。
AI.motivation: 技能熟练度是高层且主观的属性，难以仅由动作类别识别；现有方法虽融合多模态信号，但传感器层面的证据与抽象熟练度标签之间仍存在显著鸿沟。
AI.method: SkillLens 将原子动作描述作为时序引导（而非直接语义监督），定位与熟练度相关的动作窗口；对每个窗口提取动作动态特征，并通过与同类活动中高低熟练度执行的原型差距进行打分；最后将 ego/exo 的 PDM 线索与全局 ego-exo-gaze 基线融合，并使用 CORAL 进行序数校准。
AI.result: 在 Ego-Exo4D 数据集上取得 0.542 的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过动作描述引导的窗口定位、密集视觉动态建模、原型差距打分以及序数校准融合，SkillLens 能在一定程度上弥合低层观测与高层技能评估之间的差距。

title: SteerTrace: Tracing How Target Attacks Steer World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict future videos and actions with one backbone, and their imagined future is often seen as a safety signal. We introduce SteerTrace, a targeted universal attack on WAMs that also traces its effect inside the model. One $\ell_\infty$-bounded (4/255) perturbation per model, shared across frames, tasks, and camera views, pushes the executed action toward an attacker-chosen target. On eight WAMs from four families (FastWAM, Faster-WAM, OpenWAM and LingBot-VA) on LIBERO and RoboTwin, it drives task success close to zero and moves the attacked action toward the target. Same-budget noise and BadWAM produce little action shift in the target direction. We use the signed targeted effect to measure how much of the effect each intervention removes or reproduces. Under the standard attack, restoring future tokens removes 61-94% of the targeted effect in the five models whose action experts attend to them. When the attack is constrained to keep the predicted future close to the clean prediction, the targeted effect can become more dependent on current-frame tokens. In three of these five models, restoring current-frame tokens removes 87-99% of the effect, compared with 9-15% for future tokens. In six models, restoring just 0.36% of the FFN neurons in layers 10-29 of the video expert removes 72-96% of the targeted effect. Residual directions 2-16 hold only 11-18% of the shift energy, yet removing them cancels most of the targeted effect.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SteerTrace：一种针对世界行动模型（WAM）的通用、目标导向攻击与效应追踪方法。每个模型仅用一个共享的 ℓ∞ 受限（4/255）扰动即可在多个帧、任务和相机视角下把执行动作推向攻击者指定目标，并使任务成功率接近零；同时通过“恢复”不同内部成分来量化攻击效应在模型内部的来源。
AI.motivation: 世界行动模型能够同时预测未来视频和动作，其“想象的未来”常被认为可作为安全信号。但现有研究缺少对 WAM 是否真正可被鲁棒扰动操纵、以及这种操纵在模型内部如何产生和传播的系统分析。该论文旨在验证 WAM 的安全信号依赖可能被攻击削弱，并追溯攻击效应背后的关键机制。
AI.method:
1. 构造 SteerTrace：针对单个模型生成一个 ℓ∞ 幅度为 4/255 的通用扰动，该扰动跨帧、跨任务、跨相机视角共享，并引导模型输出动作朝向攻击者指定的目标。
2. 在 8 个 WAM 上评测，来自 FastWAM、Faster-WAM、OpenWAM、LingBot-VA 四个家族；基准为 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin。
3. 与同预算随机噪声和 BadWAM 基线比较，评估攻击是否真正推动动作向目标偏移、是否显著降低任务成功率。
4. 提出“有符号目标效应”（signed targeted effect）度量干预措施能移除或再现多少攻击效应。
5. 通过恢复内部表示成分进行机制分析：包括恢复未来 token、当前帧 token、视频专家中特定 FFN 神经元，以及移除残差方向中的低能量成分。
AI.result:
1. SteerTrace 在 8 个 WAM 上均显著降低任务成功率并推动动作接近攻击目标；同预算噪声与 BadWAM 在目标方向上几乎不产生动作偏移。
2. 对 5 个动作专家会关注未来 token 的模型，标准攻击下恢复未来 token 可移除 61%–94% 的目标效应，说明未来预测 token 是攻击效应的重要传播路径。
