3. 当攻击被约束为使预测未来接近干净预测时，目标效应可更多依赖当前帧 token；在其中 3 个模型中，恢复当前帧 token 可移除 87%–99% 的效应，而恢复未来 token 仅移除 9%–15%。
4. 在 6 个模型中，仅恢复视频专家第 10–29 层中 0.36% 的 FFN 神经元，就能移除 72%–96% 的目标效应，说明少数中间 FFN 神经元承载了关键攻击路径。
5. 残差方向 2–16 仅包含 11%–18% 的偏移能量，但移除它们会抵消大部分目标效应，说明攻击效应可能依赖低能量但高杠杆的残差子空间。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明 WAM 所依赖的“想象未来”安全信号并非可靠防线：一个跨任务、跨视角共享的小幅通用扰动即可稳定操纵动作输出。SteerTrace 不仅展示攻击有效性，还揭示了模型内部效应分布：未来 token、当前帧 token、视频专家 FFN 神经元以及低能量残差方向都可能成为关键控制点。结果提醒研究者需要更谨慎评估世界模型作为安全机制的可攻击性，并探索对内部敏感通路进行鲁棒化或可解释防护。

title: DACA: Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
summary: 3D visual grounding (3D-VG) is a task that bridges the natural language and 3D space, serving as a foundational capability for embodied intelligence and human-computer interaction. Although recent 3D-VG agents overcome the reliance on pre-processed 3D point clouds, they essentially employ a unidirectional, pipeline-style tool-calling architecture. This architecture separates semantic understanding from geometric reconstruction, leading to error accumulation and an inability to autonomously recover from failures. To address this flaw, this paper proposes the Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent (DACA), which reinterprets 3D-VG as a semantic-geometric dual-anchor collaborative reasoning paradigm. DACA comprises two complementary specialized tools: the semantic anchor tool holds the visual semantic features of the target and achieves efficient target tracking via optical flow and VLM local verification; the geometric anchor tool holds the 3D spatial geometric features of the target and performs global spatial reasoning via voxelization and multi-keypoint projection. The two components exchange information bidirectionally via a standardized tool call protocol, autonomously deciding on the next perception-action step to form a closed-loop optimization. Experiments on the ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that zero-shot DACA achieves an overall Acc@0.25 of 73.6\% on ScanRefer and 70.4\% overall accuracy on Nr3D, far surpassing the latest zero-shot 3D-VG methods. The code and models are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent（DACA），用“语义锚点 + 几何锚点”的双向协作智能体范式替代单向流水线式 3D-VG 工具调用，提升零样本 3D 视觉定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 视觉定位智能体虽减少对预处理点云的依赖，但通常采用单向、流水线式工具调用，导致语义理解与几何重建割裂，误差累积且难以自主纠错。
AI.method: DACA 将 3D-VG 重构为语义-几何双锚点协同推理：语义锚点工具通过光流和 VLM 局部验证保持目标视觉语义特征并跟踪目标；几何锚点工具通过体素化和多关键点投影进行全局 3D 空间推理；二者经标准化工具调用协议双向交换信息，自主决定下一步感知-动作，形成闭环优化。
AI.result: 在 ScanRefer 和 Nr3D 基准上，零样本 DACA 取得 ScanRefer 总体 Acc@0.25 73.6%，Nr3D 总体准确率 70.4%，显著优于最新零样本 3D-VG 方法。
AI.conclusion: 双向语义-几何协同架构能有效缓解传统单向流水线的误差累积问题，提升零样本 3D 视觉定位的鲁棒性和性能，为具身智能和人机交互中的 3D-VG 提供了更可行的闭环推理框架。

title: What's in the box? Revealing Object Layouts Inside Opaque Boxes via Contactless Vibration Excitation and Sensing
summary: Can we reveal what is inside an opaque box by observing its surface vibrations? Objects inside a box alter its mechanical response, providing cues about their hidden locations. We introduce a method that uses these cues to predict a box's 2D occupancy layout entirely remotely. A nearby speaker excites vibrations, which we measure on one visible wall using a grid of laser points and a camera measuring each point's speckle-pattern shifts. Our model, WhisperBox, learns to encode these vibrations into a latent representation and decode it into an occupancy map of the box's contents. The method requires no physical contact to excite or sense vibrations. We demonstrate layout recovery across various boxes and single- and multiple-object scenes, with generalization to unseen object instances, positions, orientations, and weights, as well as changes in laser placement and excitation source. Our analysis reveals that informative frequency bands need not coincide with the box's resonances and that the learned latent space captures object placement and supports arithmetic operations. These results demonstrate the potential of remote vibration sensing to infer spatial layouts hidden from view.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 WhisperBox：通过扬声器远程激发不透明箱体的表面振动，并用激光散斑相机测量振动信号，学习从振动到内部二维占据布局的映射，从而无需接触即可推断箱内物体的空间分布。
AI.motivation: 不透明容器内部的物体位置无法直接观察，但内部物体会改变箱体的机械响应并留下可感知的振动线索。作者希望探索：能否仅通过远程观察箱体表面振动来推断隐藏物体的空间布局，从而实现对封闭物体状态的非接触感知。
AI.method: 使用附近扬声器激发箱体振动，通过一束激光照射可见表面的网格点，并用相机捕捉每个点的散斑图案位移以获取振动信号。WhisperBox 模型将这些振动编码为潜在表示，再解码为箱内物体的二维占据图。整个过程无需接触激发或传感，并可泛化到不同箱体、单物体/多物体场景，以及未见过的物体实例、位置、朝向、重量、激光布置和激发源。
AI.result: 实验显示该方法能够恢复多种箱子及其内部物体的二维布局，并对新物体、位置、朝向、重量和传感器设置变化具有泛化能力。分析表明：有用频带不一定对应箱体自身共振频率；学习到的潜在空间不仅编码了物体摆放信息，还表现出支持算术运算的语义结构。
AI.conclusion: 远程振动传感能够作为推断不透明物体内部空间布局的有效模态。WhisperBox 证明了从表面振动中非接触地恢复隐藏物体占据信息的可行性，为机器人感知、透视成像、仓储与安全检查等场景提供了新方向。

title: CGM: Chaos-Guided Graph Attention and Expert Routing for Autism Stereotypy Detection
summary: Skeleton graph attention for autism video analysis weights joints by content alone, giving an erratic wrist the same standing as a still one. Stereotypy, however, is defined by how unpredictably movement unfolds rather than how much of it occurs: in our cohort, every amplitude-based kinematic descriptor falls in stereotyped clips, while windowed Sample Entropy of angular velocity alone rises (Hedges' g = +1.05). We compute this irregularity as a per-joint, per-frame tensor that structurally drives computation. The proposed chaos-guided graph attention and mixture-of-experts model (CGM) couples two mechanisms. First, a learned pairwise term added to the graph-attention logit concentrates attention on irregular joints and re-ranks the remaining edge weight toward jointly irregular pairs; its unconstrained coefficient neither vanishes nor inverts, and zeroing the tensor realigns attention in 94% of clips. Second, a gate conditioned on the same signal routes each frame to two of four experts, whose weights track frame-level irregularity. Under subject-grouped five-fold cross-validation on 116 clips, CGM reaches 0.930 balanced accuracy, exceeding the graph-attention baseline by +0.187; the component ordering replicates on the public MMASD dataset, and on held-out Panoptic Studio sessions, CGM keeps 0.86 specificity without retraining, against at most 0.35 for chaos-free baselines. In ablation, routing without irregularity yields no reliable gain, whereas chaos modulation alone contributes +0.132. A severity index from the same tensor reaches 0.87 split-half reliability, separates the cohorts with Hedges' g = +1.08, and stays consistent within children across therapy recordings, supporting video-only monitoring of stereotypy during intervention.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出CGM（chaos-guided graph attention and mixture-of-experts）模型，利用关节角速度的样本熵所刻画的运动不规则性来引导骨架图注意力和专家路由，用于孤独症视频中刻板行为的自动识别，并显著提升识别与跨场景泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 传统骨架图注意力方法通常按内容权重分配节点重要性，难以区分“幅度大但不异常”与“幅度小但高度不规则”的运动；而孤独症刻板行为的核心特征之一并非运动幅度，而是运动在时间上的不可预测性和不规则性。因此，需要一种能够将关节级运动混沌特征显式纳入模型计算机制的方法。
AI.method: 作者首先计算每帧、每关节角速度的窗口化Sample Entropy，形成关节级不规则性张量，作为模型的结构化输入。提出CGM，包含两个机制：第一，在图注意力的logit中加入学习到的成对不规则性项，使注意力集中于不规则关节，并优先重排同时不规则的关节对；第二，利用同一不规则性信号作为门控条件，对每帧样本路由到四个专家中的两个，使专家权重响应帧级混沌程度。实验采用受试者分组的五折交叉验证，并在公开MMASD数据集和Panoptic Studio保留会话上进行验证与消融分析。
AI.result: 在116个视频片段上，CGM取得0.930的平衡准确率，较图注意力基线提升0.187。去除不规则性张量后，94%的片段注意力重新对齐，说明该信号对模型注意机制有直接结构影响。消融显示，仅进行专家路由而不利用不规则性不能带来可靠提升，而混沌调制单独贡献0.132。在Panoptic Studio保留会话上无需重训，CGM保持0.86特异性，而不含混沌信息的基线最多仅0.35。基于同一不规则性张量构建的严重性指数具有0.87的折半信度，能够区分队列（Hedges’ g = +1.08），并在儿童治疗录制间保持一致性。
AI.conclusion: 运动不规则性，而非单纯运动幅度，是孤独症刻板行为视频识别中的关键计算信号。CGM通过将关节级混沌特征同时注入图注意力和混合专家路由，实现更可解释、更稳健的刻板行为识别，并支持仅依赖视频的干预过程监测。

title: Towards High-Fidelity Learned Video Compression
summary: Professional video workflows operate at qualities that learned video codecs do not reach. We measure how much of a professional quality range a codec covers, from the lowest quality of the standard test conditions, VVC at QP 37, to the highest 4:2:2 grade of the production codec ProRes. To compare inter-frame coding alone, every codec receives original frames as references at the intra positions. On 10-bit YCbCr 4:2:2 test sequences, four recent learned codecs cover 24 to 38% of this range. Their encoders are feed-forward networks with a fixed latent capacity, the number of latent values per sample, of at most 0.25, and removing their quantization raises the quality by at most 1 dB. We propose a learned inter-frame codec whose encoder searches, as the encoders of conventional codecs do. It searches block motion, which a learned network refines, and it searches among learned block transforms whose latent capacity ranges up to 1, selecting the partition, the skip decisions, and the quantized coefficients by a rate-distortion cost. Our codec reaches the upper end of the range on all six sequences. With all residual blocks fixed to 16x16, whose latent capacity is 0.25, the same codec covers 55% of the range, with or without quantization.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向帧间编码的学习型视频编解码器，通过块运动搜索、可学习块变换和率失真代价选择，显著提升对专业视频质量范围的覆盖能力。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型视频编解码器在高质量专业工作流范围内覆盖不足；其编码器多为前馈网络且潜在容量较低，量化并非主要性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 在所有测试中仅比较帧间编码，帧内位置使用原始帧作为参考。编码器先搜索块运动并由网络细化，再在潜容量最高达1的可学习块变换中，根据率失真代价选择编码划分、skip决策和量化系数。
AI.result: 四个近期学习型编解码器仅覆盖24%至38%的专业质量范围，且去量化最多仅提升1 dB；本文方法在六个序列上达到该范围高端，即使固定16x16残差块仍覆盖55%。
AI.conclusion: 提高潜在编码容量并引入类似传统编解码器的搜索机制，是提升学习型帧间编解码器高质量覆盖能力的关键因素。

title: SAM 3 Sees More Than It Detects: Promptable Concept Maps Beyond Categories
summary: Promptable segmenters answer what a thing is. Dense prediction tasks also ask class-agnostic questions, such as what stands out or hides, how light is blocked, transmitted or reflected, and where structure lies. Robots, surveillance systems and image editors build on their answers. We study promptable concept maps (PCM), which extend SAM 3's promptable concept segmentation from noun instances to maps of concepts named by short noun phrases such as `"transparent object", with "none" as an answer. PCM-Bench groups the standard test sets of seven such tasks by the question they ask. On it, we find that SAM 3 sees more than it detects. Its semantic path responds to many of these concepts, yet a low image-level presence score can block every detection of its instance path. We present UNVEIL, which trains a copy of SAM 3's semantic path for these maps, with LoRA on copies of its last blocks. A separate presence decoder learns from verified negatives whether a concept occurs. With one text phrase per query, UNVEIL maps region concepts such as salient and camouflaged objects, shadows, transparent objects and mirrors. The same weights map thin structures such as edges and skeletons as well as object categories. Run next to SAM 3, it leaves SAM 3's own outputs unchanged. On each of the seven tasks, UNVEIL reaches the highest score among the compared promptable models, including SAM 3's official fine-tuning and pipelines built on multimodal LLMs. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出“可提示概念图”（Promptable Concept Maps, PCM）任务，并介绍UNVEIL模型：通过复用并微调SAM 3的语义路径，结合独立的存在性解码器，使单个文本短语即可预测多种密集概念图，包括显著/伪装物体、阴影、透明物体、镜面、边缘和骨架等。
AI.motivation: 现有可提示分割模型（如SAM 3）主要回答“某个事物实例是什么”，偏向名词性、实例级检测；但许多密集预测任务需要回答类别无关的语义问题，例如“什么突出/隐藏”“光如何被遮挡、透射或反射”“结构在哪里”。机器人、监控和图像编辑等系统依赖这些更细粒度的场景理解能力，因此需要扩展可提示分割到概念图层面。
AI.method: 作者将SAM 3的“可提示概念分割”从名词实例扩展到由简短名词短语命名的概念图，例如“transparent object”，并允许“none”作为答案。为评估该任务，提出PCM-Bench，将七类标准密集预测测试集按“所问问题”组织。模型方面，提出UNVEIL：训练SAM 3语义路径的一个副本以生成概念图，并对其最后若干块使用LoRA进行参数高效微调；同时训练一个独立的存在性解码器，从经过验证的负样本中学习判断概念是否存在。查询只需一个文本短语即可输出对应概念区域或结构。
AI.result: 在PCM-Bench的七项任务上，UNVEIL取得所比较可提示模型中的最高分数，包括SAM 3官方微调版本以及基于多模态大语言模型的流程。论文还指出SAM 3的语义路径能感知这些概念，但实例路径可能因图像级存在性得分过低而阻断检测；UNVEIL通过独立存在性解码器缓解该问题。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，可提示分割可以从“识别实例”扩展到“生成开放文本短语驱动的概念图”，并以统一权重覆盖多种密集预测任务。UNVEIL在不改变SAM 3原始输出的前提下，为透明、阴影、伪装、边缘等类别无关语义问题提供了更强且更通用的预测能力。

title: Driver Gaze Target Identification via Gaze Estimation and Structured Driving Scene Understanding
summary: Identifying a driver's gaze target provides object-level information for visual attention monitoring in intelligent vehicles. Gaze-zone classification and continuous attention localization provide limited information about the identity of the attended scene target. This paper proposes a modular framework that identifies object- or region-level gaze targets from synchronized in-cabin driver images and forward-view road images. The framework comprises four components: MFGaze, which combines a Vision Transformer pretrained with a masked autoencoder (MAE) and head-pose conditioning through feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM); panoptic scene understanding, which constructs a structured candidate set; polynomial ridge regression, which maps gaze features to 2D scene-image coordinates through individualized calibration; and entropy-driven target inference, which adaptively fuses boundary-distance geometry with class-level semantic priors. Experiments evaluate the framework using three public gaze datasets, a laboratory test using Cityscapes road scenes and self-collected gaze data, and the Look Both Ways (LBW) dataset. The complete framework achieves an overall Top-1 gaze target identification accuracy of 96.27% in the laboratory experiment. After sequence-specific calibration, it achieves Top-1 accuracies of 79.92% for task-relevant objects and 85.58% for the road class on LBW. MFGaze achieves the lowest mean angular errors among the compared methods, with 4.06$^\circ$, 4.23$^\circ$, and 10.52$^\circ$ on MPIIFaceGaze, ETH-XGaze, and Gaze360, respectively, and demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization. Sensitivity analyses show stable performance under hyperparameter perturbations. These results support the framework as a source of object-level gaze information for driver monitoring.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个用于智能车辆驾驶员注视目标识别的模块化框架，融合眼部/头部图像、场景全景理解和个体化校准，从而给出物体或区域级别的注视目标信息。
AI.motivation: 现有注视区分类和连续注意力定位只能提供有限的场景目标身份信息，难以直接说明驾驶员正在看哪个具体物体或语义区域；而智能车辆视觉注意力监控需要物体级注视目标识别。
AI.method: 框架包括四个模块：MFGaze 使用 MAE 预训练的 Vision Transformer，并通过 FiLM 注入头部姿态条件；全景场景理解构建结构化候选目标集合；多项式岭回归进行个体化校准，将注视特征映射到场景图像二维坐标；熵驱动目标推断自适应融合边界距离几何信息与类别语义先验。
AI.result: 在实验室 Cityscapes 道路场景与自采注视数据上，整体框架 Top-1 注视目标识别准确率达到 96.27%；在 LBW 数据集经序列特定校准后，任务相关物体 Top-1 为 79.92%，道路类为 85.58%。MFGaze 在 MPIIFaceGaze、ETH-XGaze 和 Gaze360 上的平均角度误差分别为 4.06°、4.23° 和 10.52°，优于比较方法，并表现出较强的跨数据集泛化能力和超参数敏感性稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够将驾驶员注视信息从区域级或连续定位提升到物体/区域级语义识别，可为智能车辆中的驾驶员视觉注意力监控提供更丰富的注视目标依据。

title: Suppressing the Shortcut Hidden Behind the Gains of VideoLLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the stage in which Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) advance their capability to reason over video. However, the VideoLLM also learns to answer from textual regularities of its training data, a shortcut that bypasses the video. The regularities behind the shortcut are hard to define at the data level, and the shortcut forms regardless of training epoch, data size, or backbone. The shortcut is hidden behind a rise in accuracy within the training distribution, yet it is not required for the rise and even costs SFT the gain the video offers under distribution shift. We therefore propose Video-Evidence Training via Orthogonal projection (VETO), which intervenes on the fine-tuning update where the shortcut is written rather than on the data. VETO calibrates the subspace that the text alone occupies in the activations of the base model and projects the update onto its orthogonal complement. The VideoLLM is thus left to ground its answer in the full input, with the shortcut suppressed as it forms and never defined. Across seven VideoLLMs, VETO preserves the gain of SFT on the training distribution and suppresses the shortcut. On six benchmarks under shift it gains more than SFT and answers from the full input rather than the shortcut. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VETO方法，在视频大语言模型的监督微调更新过程中投影掉“仅依赖文本规律”的捷径方向，迫使模型更多利用视频证据，从而提升分布外鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 视频大语言模型在监督微调后虽然训练分布内准确率上升，但可能学到只依赖文本先验的捷径，绕过视频内容。这种捷径难以在数据层面明确定义，也不随训练轮数、数据规模或主干模型简单消失，会损害分布偏移下模型真正利用视频的能力。
AI.method: 作者提出Video-Evidence Training via Orthogonal projection（VETO），不从数据层面消除捷径，而是在微调参数更新阶段干预：校准基础模型激活中“仅由文本输入所占用的子空间”，并将微调更新投影到该文本捷径子空间的正交补空间，从而抑制模型形成“忽略视频、只靠文本规律答题”的捷径，使其基于完整多模态输入作答。
AI.result: 在七个视频大语言模型上，VETO能够保留监督微调在训练分布内带来的性能提升，同时抑制文本捷径；在六个存在分布偏移的基准上，VETO相比普通SFT获得更高性能，并表现出更依赖完整输入而非纯文本捷径的问答行为。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，视频大语言模型监督微调中的“文本捷径”问题可通过微调更新空间的正交投影有效缓解。VETO提供了一种数据定义之外的训练阶段干预机制，在不牺牲分布内收益的情况下提升分布外鲁棒性，使模型更可靠地基于视频证据推理。

title: GeoPillars: A Large-Kernel Pillar Detector for Single-Sweep LiDAR Under Point Sparsity, and a Decomposition of Its Gain
summary: GeoPillars is a pillar-based 3D detector for single-sweep LiDAR under a hard budget of eight points per 0.4 m pillar, a budget that discards 46.6% of in-range points. It adds geometric pillar features, grouped vector attention within each pillar, a learned absolute positional prior on the bird's-eye-view (BEV) grid, a large-kernel backbone, auxiliary surface-normal supervision and a full-resolution detection head. Trained on 123k synthetic CARLA scans and evaluated on cars, it reaches 81.33 BEV AP@0.7, 13.76 points above CenterPoint at the same input budget and 1.91 points above CenterPoint at its native, denser budget. These are in-distribution figures, because the validation split is per-frame rather than scene-disjoint. A rung-by-rung decomposition shows that the new components explain little of the gain. Raising the detection-head resolution alone recovers 10.19 of the 13.76 points, the joint change of encoder, backbone, neck and positional prior adds 3.37, and the normal-supervision branch adds 0.20, which is within run-to-run variation. With heading reversals folded out, orientation error is similar for all seven models, although GeoPillars reverses headings about half as often as a resolution-matched baseline. It is also the slowest of the seven models. Evaluated zero-shot on 6,743 real nuScenes keyframes, no model transfers, and each retains 3.7% to 12.2% of its CARLA accuracy. A collection defect left LiDAR intensity constant, so every model learned from geometry alone. Code and checkpoints are publicly available.

AI.tldr: GeoPillars 是一种面向单次扫描 LiDAR 的点云 3D 检测器，在极低 pillar 点预算下通过几何特征、分组注意力、BEV 位置先验、大卷积核 backbone、法线辅助监督和高分辨率检测头获得较高 CARLA 域内精度，但消融表明收益主要来自检测头分辨率，且真实域迁移几乎失效。
AI.motivation: 研究在严苛稀疏化条件下（每个 0.4 m pillar 仅保留 8 个点、丢弃大量原始点）能否构建高效、准确的单次扫描 LiDAR 检测器，并厘清各模块对性能提升的真实贡献及其跨域泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出 GeoPillars：在 pillar-based 3D 检测框架中引入几何 pillar 特征、pillar 内分组向量注意力、BEV 网格上的学习式绝对位置先验、大卷积核 backbone、表面法线辅助监督和全分辨率检测头；在 123k CARLA 合成扫描上训练，并在 cars 类别上评测，同时与 CenterPoint 等基线进行预算对齐、分辨率对齐和逐组件分解实验。
AI.result: 在 CARLA 域内，GeoPillars 对 cars 达到 81.33 BEV AP@0.7，比同稀疏输入预算下的 CenterPoint 高 13.76 点，甚至比 CenterPoint 原生更密输入设置高 1.91 点；但组件分解显示，仅提高检测头分辨率即可解释其中 10.19 点，encoder/backbone/neck/位置先验联合变化仅贡献 3.37 点，法线监督贡献 0.20 点且在运行噪声范围内；模型推理速度最慢，且在真实 nuScenes 零样本评测中所有模型均几乎不能迁移，仅保留原 CARLA 精度的 3.7%–12.2%。
AI.conclusion: GeoPillars 的主要增益并非来自新增几何/注意力/位置/监督等模块本身，而主要来自更高分辨率检测头；同时，CARLA 域内高指标不能代表真实世界泛化能力，且由于 LiDAR 强度被固定，所有模型只学习了纯几何表征，限制了零样本迁移效果。

title: Fast and Accurate Body Estimation in Pixels, World Space and Scenes
summary: We present FAB (Fast and Accurate Body estimation), a human body estimator that jointly improves inference efficiency and body-recovery fidelity. Rather than predicting only parametric mesh-model parameters, FAB directly predicts human skeleton joints and dense surface points. In images, it predicts dense 2D and 3D body points alongside a parametric Momentum Human Rig (MHR) head, then fits SMPL in one learned pass followed by two Gauss-Newton steps. Its ViT-L student, FAB-L, distilled from a fine-tuned SAM 3D Body, runs in real time for one person on an RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, from detection to a fitted body, at 4.6x the speed of SAM 3D Body's eager-PyTorch body-only path, while improving accuracy on most camera-space benchmarks. The same network predicts heel, toe, hand, and knee contacts, which connect the body to the scene. FAB also estimates world-space motion, fuses static-scene depth around the visible person, and aligns body and scene using predicted contacts. For human-to-humanoid real-to-sim transfer, an in-model G1 head and FAB-Retarget, a motion-level retargeter that reads dense points or the fitted mesh, map motion to a Unitree G1. FAB-Retarget produces references that follow the person more closely than specialized retargeters including SOMA, GMR, UMR, and OmniRetarget, and substantially more closely than Fast SAM 3D Body retargeted with our sequence IK. Project page: this https URL.
comment: 28 pages, 9 pages of main text. 16 figures

AI.tldr: FAB是一个人体姿态与网格联合估计器，直接预测密集二维/三维身体点和骨架关节，并以高效流程拟合SMPL，同时支持场景接触、世界运动及人形机器人重定向。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常只预测参数化人体模型参数，推理效率与重建精度之间存在权衡，且难以将人体估计与场景接触、机器人运动迁移统一建模。
AI.method: 方法核心是在图像中同时预测密集2D和3D身体点、MHR头部以及脚跟、脚尖、手、膝等接触点；通过一次学习式SMPL初始化和两步Gauss-Newton优化得到拟合人体；采用从微调SAM 3D Body蒸馏得到的ViT-L学生模型FAB-L实现实时推理；进一步融合静态场景深度，利用接触预测对齐人体与场景，并通过内置G1头部和FAB-Retarget将动作迁移到Unitree G1。
AI.result: FAB-L在单个人体输入上可实现实时运行，相比SAM 3D Body的eager-PyTorch身体路径约快4.6倍，并在多数相机空间基准上提升精度；其接触预测有助于连接人体与场景；在人到仿人机器人迁移中，FAB-Retarget生成的参考动作比SOMA、GMR、UMR、OmniRetarget以及经序列IK处理的Fast SAM 3D Body更接近原始人体运动。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接预测密集身体点和骨架关节并结合轻量化蒸馏与优化拟合，FAB能够同时提升人体估计的推理效率、重建保真度以及场景感知能力，并在真实人体到Unitree G1的动作重定向中表现优于现有专用方法。

title: World-delta: Continually Integrating Observations for Incremental 3D Scene Generation
summary: Existing 3D generation methods synthesize visually compelling scenes from fixed inputs, yet struggle to continually expand and revise a 3D world as new observations arrive. Iterative approaches often fuse real observations and generated content into a single representation, treating generated content as established structure rather than revisable predictions. Consequently, early generation errors can persist and accumulate despite new evidence. We propose World-delta, an incremental 3D scene generation framework combining uncertainty-aware persistent world modeling with delta-guided diffusion for continual scene expansion and correction. Our framework comprises three components: 1) Visual Evidence Encoding integrates geometric and semantic cues from incoming images into unified world tokens. 2) Observation-Calibrated World Modeling maintains a persistent latent world state that distinguishes observation-supported content from provisional completion hypotheses. New evidence drives selective world deltas to revise conflicting hypotheses while preserving well-supported content. 3) Incremental World Diffusion Generation uses delta-derived masks to restrict diffusion to regions requiring updates, freezing unchanged regions. Only affected 3D chunks are decoded and integrated into the existing scene. Together, these components enable continual world expansion and revision while reducing redundant generation and preserving scene consistency. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of World-delta in incremental 3D scene generation, observation-driven correction, scene consistency, and update efficiency over successive scene updates.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 World-delta，一种增量式 3D 场景生成框架，通过不确定性感知的持久世界建模与 delta 引导的扩散生成，实现新观测驱动下的持续场景扩展与修正。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 生成方法多基于固定输入一次性合成场景，难以随着新观测不断扩展和修正 3D 世界。迭代式方法常将真实观测与生成内容融合到同一表示中，把生成内容当作既成结构而非可修订假设，导致早期生成误差持续累积，即使出现新的证据也难以纠正。
AI.method: World-delta 包含三个核心模块。第一，视觉证据编码：将输入图像中的几何与语义线索整合为统一的世界 token，以形成可融合的多模态观测表示。第二，观测校准的世界建模：维护一个持久的潜在世界状态，区分由观测支持的内容和临时性的补全假设；当新证据到达时，通过选择性的 world delta 修正相互冲突的假设，同时保留已有充分支持的内容。第三，增量式世界扩散生成：利用 delta 导出的掩码，将扩散更新限制在需要改变的区域，冻结未变化区域，并只解码和集成受影响的 3D 分块，从而减少重复生成并保持场景一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明，World-delta 在增量式 3D 场景生成、基于观测的误差纠正、场景一致性维持以及连续场景更新效率方面均表现出有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将 3D 场景生成从一次性静态合成转变为可持续扩展和可修正的增量式世界建模过程，通过区分观测事实与生成假设，使模型能够利用新证据进行局部更新，从而提高长期场景一致性和更新效率。

title: What Does Anti-Hallucination Training Buy? Saying Less, Cheap Pruning, and the Rest
summary: Preference training is the standard recipe for reducing object hallucination in vision-language models, and each new method reports a lower CHAIR score. We ask what that reduction consists of. Every trained system is compared with its base model's caption truncated to the same object recall, which removes the part of the gain that comes from saying less; the remainder is compared with what a deliberately weak, frozen, eleven-feature post-hoc probe fitted on 500 annotated images can reproduce. All criteria were specified in the analysis code and frozen before the outputs they judge existed. For eight public methods on LLaVA-1.5-7B, the probe reproduces at least two thirds of what training removes beyond saying less for 7 of 8 methods on COCO, 8 of 8 on AMBER and 6 of 8 on Object HalBench, with RLAIF-V the consistent exception; a later public method released for both LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL (SENTINEL) meets the same bar on both. On our own DPO checkpoints the accounting holds on Qwen2.5-VL but fails on InternVL2.5 on COCO (2 of 4 training designs). At matched recall, the base model plus the probe beats truncation for 8 of 9 LLaVA-1.5 systems on COCO and 9 of 9 on AMBER, on the two newer backbones, and when realized as actual sentence deletion. The same measure prices training signals: DPO on the model's own samples labelled by the probe or by an object-level CLIP score recovers 0.70 and 0.87 of the beyond-brevity gain of ground-truth-labelled DPO on Qwen2.5-VL (the probe 0.73 on InternVL2.5), both beat length-matched random labels, and CLIP labels buy more than probe labels on COCO. Human judgements show that the sentences the probe deletes are wrong more often than those truncation would delete; a human check of the CHAIR evaluator's precision falls below our pre-set bar, which we report as a limitation.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑视觉语言模型偏好训练降低 CHAIR 幻觉分数的来源：许多收益在控制“少说”后，仍能被一个极弱的 11 特征事后探针复现，说明所谓“减少幻觉”在很大程度上可能只是可预测的错误句子被删除或避免，而非模型内部产生了更可靠的视觉推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有偏好训练方法普遍通过降低 CHAIR 分数声称减少物体幻觉，但分数下降可能混杂了模型生成更少内容、说更少物体等“简洁性收益”。作者希望回答：去除“少说”因素后，训练带来的真正幻觉减少有多少？这些减少是否是模型能力改进，还是可被简单后处理规则替代的表面对策？
AI.method: 作者将每个偏好训练模型与其基础模型在相同物体召回率下比较，以剥离“说得更少”带来的分数提升；再将剩余增益与一个故意设计得很弱的冻结式 11 特征事后探针比较，该探针仅在 500 张标注图像上拟合。所有判断标准在分析代码中预先指定并冻结。实验覆盖 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上 8 个公开方法、Qwen2.5-VL 与 InternVL2.5 上的 DPO 检查点、以及 SENTINEL 等方法，并使用 COCO、AMBER、Object HalBench 评估；还检验探针标签和 CLIP 标签作为 DPO 信号的效果，以及人工对删除句子错误率的判断。
AI.result: 在多数设定下，该弱探针能复现训练方法在“除简洁性外”增益的至少三分之二：LLaVA-1.5 上 COCO 为 7/8、AMBER 为 8/8、Object HalBench 为 6/8；RLAIF-V 是主要例外。SENTINEL 在两种骨干上均达到同样标准。在自有 DPO 检查点中，该结论在 Qwen2.5-VL 上成立，但在 InternVL2.5 的 COCO 上仅部分成立。在匹配召回率条件下，“基础模型 + 探针”优于简单截断；实际句子删除时也有效。用探针或物体级 CLIP 标签自采样本做 DPO，可恢复基于真值标签 DPO 的大部分超简洁性增益，且优于随机标签，但效果因骨干和数据集而异。人工评估显示，探针删除的句子往往更错误；但 CHAIR 自动评估器的精确度未达预设阈值，构成局限。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，偏好训练带来的 CHAIR 幻觉分数下降并不能直接等同于模型真正增强了去幻觉能力，其中很大一部分可被简单的事后句子级探针复现或替代。因此，未来评估物体幻觉下降时应控制输出简洁性，并加入与弱后处理基线的比较；同时，CHAIR 等自动指标本身需要更严格的可靠性检验。

title: SCCV-6D: Sparse Canonical Coordinate Voting for Holistic Multi-View RGB-D 6D Pose Estimation in Robotic Bin Picking
summary: Industrial bin picking requires pose estimates that are accurate under clutter, partial occlusion, and the reflective, texture-less nature of manufactured parts. Most recent approaches to 6D pose estimation follow multi-stage pipelines. These achieve high accuracy, but incur memory and runtime footprints that do not cope with the operational constraints of many real-world industrial deployments. Holistic pipelines estimate poses in a single pass, with cost controlled through indiscriminate subsampling or lowered resolution. Continuing this line, we present SCCV-6D, a fully sparse multi-view RGB-D estimator. We reconstruct the 3D space at millimeter precision, prune background via a staged heatmap mechanism, and predict class, translation offset and rotation at highest resolution for an arbitrary number of objects simultaneously. Rotation is formulated as canonical coordinate voting. Points vote for their canonical object coordinates with an associated confidence, enabling closed-form pose recovery with a symmetry-aware weighted Procrustes solve. Along an in-cluster point recovery induced by offset votes, this removes time-consuming post-processing stages. We reuse the task-supervised attention priors from the heatmap formulation for a novel attention-gated distillation objective that reweights teacher-student feature alignment. On the IPD test split we report competitive 0.826 AP at 1.13 s per scene, significantly faster than the leading entries. On MV-YCB our approach reaches 96.1 ADD-S, and remains competitive even on the densely packed bins of ROBI.
comment: to appear in Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV), 2027

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SCCV-6D，一种面向工业拣选场景的全稀疏多视角 RGB-D 六维位姿估计框架，通过高分辨率 3D 重建、分阶段热图剪枝、偏移投票恢复点集以及基于规范坐标投票和加权 Procrustes 求解的对称感知旋转估计，实现准确、快速且避免繁琐后处理的位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 工业料箱拣选要求六维位姿估计能够应对杂乱堆叠、部分遮挡、高反光和无纹理零件等挑战。多阶段位姿估计方法虽然精度高，但内存和运行时开销大，难以满足实际部署限制；整体式单通过方法则常通过无差别下采样或降低分辨率控制成本。因此，需要在保持高分辨率与精度的同时，设计更高效、可直接部署的稀疏多视角 RGB-D 位姿估计方法。
AI.method: 方法包括：1）在全稀疏设置下以毫米级精度重建 3D 空间；2）采用分阶段热图机制剪除背景区域，在最高分辨率下同时预测类别、平移偏移和旋转；3）将旋转估计建模为规范坐标投票，每个点以置信度投票到目标物体的规范坐标，并通过对称感知的加权 Procrustes 求解获得位姿；4）利用偏移投票诱导簇内点恢复，去除耗时后处理阶段；5）将热图公式中的任务监督注意力先验用于新的注意力门控蒸馏目标，以重加权教师—学生特征对齐。
AI.result: 在 IPD 测试划分上，SCCV-6D 取得 0.826 AP，每场景耗时 1.13 秒，相比当前领先方法显著更快。在 MV-YCB 上达到 96.1 ADD-S，并在密集堆叠的 ROBI 数据集上仍保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SCCV-6D 展示了在高要求工业拣选场景中，用全稀疏多视角 RGB-D 估计实现高精度、低运行时开销和简化后处理流水线的可行性。其核心贡献在于高分辨率预测、高效背景剪枝、对称感知旋转恢复和注意力门控蒸馏，为实际部署提供了一种兼具准确性与效率的六维位姿估计方案。

title: Limits of local curvature for constructing search subspaces in segmentation models
summary: We examine how well subspaces constructed from local curvature represent the change in the gradient update field after a finite step in semantic segmentation models. The local response is the action of the curvature operator on the actual input displacement. In a study of 50 images and two models, we measure the ratio of the loss increase attained in a fixed subspace to that attained in the full space. This ratio decreases as the search radius increases. On ten images from the same sample, we compare the one-dimensional subspace spanned by the initial gradient with two rank-16 subspaces for both models. The two equal-rank subspaces are assessed at the same initial states, using the same actual steps and measured vectors. Adding generalised Gauss-Newton directions to the initial gradient reduces the mean relative error in representing the field change from 0.922 to 0.874 for the first model and from 0.819 to 0.763 for the second. At the same rank, including the response direction for the initial gradient nearly eliminates the error in representing the local response. The mean error in representing the field change does not decrease. A decomposition with fixed pixel weights shows that the finite-step remainder is comparable in norm to the field change and makes the largest diagonal contribution to the squared projection error of the field after the step. Evaluation of a search subspace should measure how accurately it represents the field change and the local response.
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Includes an appendix

AI.tldr: 本文研究语义分割模型中，由局部曲率构造的低维子空间能否有效表征有限步长下的梯度更新场变化；发现这类子空间能较好近似“局部响应”，但对完整“场变化”的误差仍较大，主要源于有限步长余项。
AI.motivation: 在深度语义分割模型中，优化过程常涉及梯度方向、曲率近似和线搜索子空间。若曲率算子作用在真实输入位移上得到的“局部响应”只在线性近似范围内成立，则需要判断：由该局部曲率信息构造的固定子空间，能否在有限步长、非线性较强的场景中准确表示梯度更新场的整体变化，从而评估其在实际优化中的有效性。
AI.method: 作者在一个包含50张图像和两个语义分割模型的实验样本中测量：在固定子空间内可实现的损失增长与全空间中可实现的损失增长之比，并观察该比值随搜索半径的变化。随后在同一样本的10张图像上，比较初始梯度张成的一维子空间与两个秩为16的子空间；这些等秩子空间在相同初始状态、相同实际步长和相同测度向量下评估。具体地，向初始梯度中加入广义Gauss–Newton方向，并比较包含初始梯度对应响应方向的子空间，计算表示“场变化”和“局部响应”的平均相对误差。此外，通过固定像素权重的分解，分析有限步长余项对步后场投影误差平方的贡献。
AI.result: 随着搜索半径增大，固定子空间中的损失增长与全空间中的损失增长之比下降，说明子空间近似效果随步长增大而减弱。在两个模型上，将广义Gauss–Newton方向加入初始梯度后，表示场变化的平均相对误差从0.922降至0.874，并从0.819降至0.763，改善有限。相同秩条件下，加入初始梯度的响应方向几乎消除了局部响应的表示误差，但并没有降低场变化的平均表示误差。固定像素权重分解显示，有限步长余项的范数与场变化相当，并对步后场的平方投影误差产生最大的对角贡献。
AI.conclusion: 由局部曲率构造的搜索子空间能够准确捕捉线性化或局部意义下的响应，但难以充分表示有限步长下的完整梯度场变化；非线性/高阶有限步长余项是主要误差来源。因此，评价搜索子空间时不应只看局部曲率响应或损失增长比例，而应分别测量其对“场变化”和“局部响应”的表示准确性。

title: Rank2Replace: VLM-Ranked Slot Replacement for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
summary: Spurious correlations can give image predictors high in-distribution accuracy but poor generalization under distribution shift. We introduce $\textbf{Rank2Replace}$, which transfers knowledge of task-relevant evidence from pretrained vision--language models (VLMs) to small predictors through training-time augmentation for out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. The VLM ranks object-centric slots by task relevance and guides rank-dependent replacement with same-rank slot embeddings from another image. This augmentation retains the original image's label, encouraging reliance on preserved task evidence as incidental cues change, and supports combination with existing OOD methods. Across four datasets and six splits under shared frozen slot embeddings, the default cross-entropy configuration reaches macro-averaged average-group and worst-group accuracies of $80.43\%$ and $65.28\%$ without environment labels or dataset-specific replacement tuning. Slot corruption improves both macro-averaged metrics for all fourteen OOD training methods. Combining it with slot ranking and IRM reaches $81.96\%$ and $72.68\%$. Controlled ablations support the ranking and replacement design, with gains across five ranking VLMs and six extractor--predictor combinations. Permutation-invariant predictors further improve both macro-averaged metrics over their unaugmented counterparts while using VLM guidance only during training for efficient inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Rank2Replace：利用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）对物体中心槽位进行任务相关性排序，并在训练时进行同等级槽位替换，使小型预测模型更依赖任务相关证据，从而提升分布外（OOD）泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 图像预测模型常依赖训练数据中的虚假相关性，导致分布内准确率高但在分布偏移下泛化差。因此，需要一种方法将预训练视觉语言模型中蕴含的“哪些证据与任务相关”的知识迁移到小型模型中，使其在无关线索变化时仍能保持稳健判断。
AI.method: Rank2Replace 使用共享且冻结的物体中心槽位嵌入，让 VLM 根据任务相关性对槽位排序，并依据排序等级从另一图像中替换相同等级的相关度槽位。该训练时增强保留原图像标签，使模型必须依赖被保留的任务相关证据。方法可与现有 OOD 训练算法结合，并支持槽位扰动、IRM 等组件；推理阶段无需 VLM，训练更高效。
AI.result: 在四个数据集、六个 OOD 划分下，默认交叉熵设置无需环境标签或按数据集调参，即达到宏平均平均组准确率 80.43% 和最差组准确率 65.28%。槽位扰动提升了全部十四种 OOD 训练方法的宏平均指标；进一步结合槽位排序与 IRM 时，平均组准确率达 81.96%，最差组准确率达 72.68%。消融实验支持排序与替换设计的有效性，并验证了多种 VLM 排序器、多种抽取器—预测器组合以及置换不变预测模型的增益。
AI.conclusion: Rank2Replace 通过训练时 VLM 引导的等级匹配槽位替换，有效将任务相关证据知识迁移到小型预测模型，显著缓解虚假相关性问题并提升 OOD 泛化；同时推理阶段不依赖 VLM，兼顾性能与效率。

title: ContextRenderer: Dynamic-Context Video Generation for Interactive Game Worlds
summary: Interactive game world models separate executable world evolution from visual generation, using video models to render engine-provided scene representations into detailed observations. During sustained gameplay, however, existing generative renderers struggle to follow changing conditions while preserving visual continuity across diverse proxies and target styles. We therefore introduce ContextRenderer, an autoregressive video diffusion framework designed for both dynamic conditioning and cross-proxy generalization. It couples Dynamic-Context Learning (DCL) for chunk-level interaction supervision with Recurrent History Compression (RHC) to follow condition updates while preserving visual continuity within a bounded token budget. Across proxy representations, Cross-Representation Flow Alignment (CRFA) connects proxy reconstruction with appearance and interaction variation through a shared high-fidelity reconstruction. WorldPrism, our interaction-centric dataset constructed from agent-built worlds, AAA gameplay, and open-source videos, supplies the corresponding renderings and chunk-level annotations for these learning tasks. Experiments on GWM-Bench and Solar-Bench show improved reconstruction and visual quality, while qualitative results demonstrate minute-long interactive rendering under changing prompts and subject references. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: ContextRenderer 是一种面向交互式游戏世界模型的自回归视频扩散渲染框架，能够在长时间游戏中跟随变化的场景条件和代理表示，同时保持视觉连续性，并支持跨多种 scene representation 与目标风格的泛化。
AI.motivation: 交互式游戏世界模型通常将可执行世界状态更新与视觉渲染分离：引擎提供场景表示，视频模型负责生成观感。然而，在持续游戏过程中，现有生成式渲染器难以在动态变化的条件（如提示、角色、风格和场景代理）下稳定跟随条件更新，同时在多种代理表示之间保持视觉连续性和高保真生成质量。
AI.method: 论文提出 ContextRenderer，其核心包括三部分：1）Dynamic-Context Learning（DCL）在 chunk 级别进行交互监督，使模型能够响应不断变化的场景条件；2）Recurrent History Compression（RHC）在有限 token 预算下递归压缩历史帧，从而保持视觉连续性并支持动态条件更新；3）Cross-Representation Flow Alignment（CRFA）通过共享的高保真重建路径，将不同代理表示、外观变化和交互变化进行流形对齐，以实现跨代理泛化。此外，作者构建了以交互为中心的 WorldPrism 数据集，包含 agent-built worlds、AAA 游戏画面和开放视频，并提供相应渲染结果与 chunk 级标注。
AI.result: 在 GWM-Bench 和 Solar-Bench 上，ContextRenderer 在重建质量和视觉质量方面均取得提升。定性结果显示，该方法能够在分钟级交互场景中随变化的提示和主体参考进行连续渲染，并处理多种代理表示。
AI.conclusion: ContextRenderer 表明，通过动态上下文监督、历史压缩和跨表示对齐，视频生成模型可以在交互式世界模型中更好地承担“可执行状态到视觉观测”的渲染角色，提升长时间交互、动态条件跟随和跨代理泛化能力。

title: TrajCal: Trajectory-Calibrated Time Schedules for Few-Step Flow Sampling
summary: Flow matching enables high-quality image and video generation, but its iterative sampling process requires repeated evaluations of large neural networks. Existing few-step methods can distort the output and reduce its agreement with a many-step reference. We propose TrajCal, a training-free calibration framework for few-step sampling. Based on scatter search, a well-established metaheuristic for difficult optimization problems, TrajCal starts with diverse seed schedules, deforms and combines these candidates, and selects one fixed schedule by final output fidelity for reuse on new inputs. For both image and video generation, TrajCal achieves higher reference fidelity than all compared baselines at low evaluation budgets while maintaining competitive visual quality. The search is effective even with randomly generated seeds, while trajectory-based seeds further improve fidelity. For cross-style generalization, photography-calibrated schedules also improve fidelity on unseen image styles.

AI.tldr: TrajCal是一种无需训练的流匹配少步采样校准框架，通过基于scatter search的轨迹调度优化，在低计算预算下提升图像和视频生成与多步参考输出的一致性。
AI.motivation: 流匹配在图像和视频生成中质量较高，但迭代采样需要反复调用大型神经网络，计算成本大。已有少步方法虽能加速采样，但容易扭曲输出，降低与多步参考结果的一致性，因此需要在少步、高效采样的同时保持较高保真度。
AI.method: TrajCal是一种training-free校准方法，核心思想是搜索一种固定的少步采样调度。方法基于scatter search这一元启发式优化算法：首先生成多样化的候选seed schedules，并对候选方案进行形变、组合和筛选；随后根据最终输出保真度选择最优固定调度，用于新输入。也可利用轨迹相关seed进一步提升搜索效果。
AI.result: 在图像和视频生成任务中，TrajCal在低模型评估预算下相比所有比较基线取得了更高的多步参考保真度，并保持有竞争力的视觉质量。即使在随机生成seed schedule的情况下，搜索仍有效；使用基于轨迹的seed可进一步提高保真度。此外，经过摄影风格校准得到的调度也能提升未见图像风格上的保真度，表现出一定跨风格泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TrajCal通过无需训练的采样调度优化，为流匹配少步采样提供了有效的校准机制。它能够在显著降低计算成本的同时，提高少步生成结果与高质量多步参考之间的一致性，并具备一定跨输入、跨风格泛化能力。

title: EgoWitness: Benchmarking Instance-Level Spatial Memory and Reasoning in Egocentric Video Streams
summary: Recalling where and when an object was last seen and who saw it requires recognizing it across days and people. Existing long-video benchmarks focus on events, object categories, or relative locations, leaving instance-level spatial memory largely untested in multimodal models. To address this gap, we present EgoWitness, a benchmark for instance-level spatial memory and reasoning in egocentric video. Its 8,453 human-verified questions span approximately 324 hours of week-long and short-horizon recordings and test seven abilities, from recognizing an object or room to recalling who saw it and reasoning about room visits. Over one million reviewed masks of 34 registered landmarks and 21 movable-object labels are linked through room timelines. Among twelve direct vision-language models (VLMs), open-weight models reach at most 46.97% accuracy, and none exceeds 35% on identifying who saw an object last. We therefore propose EgoClue, a spatial-memory agent that retrieves candidate intervals, verifies instance identity, and computes spatial and temporal relations with five tools. Two-stage training with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) raises its 4B controller from 23.64% to 72.65% accuracy on 1,320 held-out questions. Evidence-trace synthesis matches the best direct VLM at 74.85% on week-long questions and achieves 80.56% in environments excluded from training.
comment: 43 pages, including supplementary material. Zhengru Fang and Zehao Liu contributed equally. Project page: this https URL ; Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文提出面向第一人称视频的实例级空间记忆基准EgoWitness，并设计EgoClue空间记忆智能体，通过证据检索、实例身份验证和时空关系推理，在长视频问答任务中显著优于直接使用的视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频基准多关注事件、对象类别或相对位置，缺乏对实例级空间记忆的评估。在多模态模型中，准确回忆“某个具体物体在哪里、何时出现、最后被谁看到”等问题，需要跨时间、跨空间和跨人物进行细粒度识别与推理，因此需要新的基准和方法。
AI.method: 作者构建EgoWitness基准，包含8453个人工校验问题，覆盖约324小时的第一人称视频，评估七类能力，并利用34个注册地标和21类可移动物体的百万级审查掩码以及房间时间线关联信息。随后提出EgoClue智能体，通过检索候选片段、验证实例身份、计算时空关系等五个工具完成任务，并采用监督微调和Group Relative Policy Optimization两阶段训练提升控制器能力。
AI.result: 实验显示，12个直接使用的视觉语言模型中，开源模型准确率最高仅为46.97%，在“识别最后看到某物体的人”任务上均未超过35%，说明现有模型在该任务上存在明显不足。经过两阶段训练后，4B参数的EgoClue控制器在1320个保留问题上的准确率从23.64%提升至72.65%。证据轨迹合成方法在整周问题上的准确率达到74.85%，与最佳直接VLM相当，并在训练环境之外的环境中达到80.56%。
AI.conclusion: 该论文揭示了现有视觉语言模型在实例级空间记忆和跨人推理上的不足，并提出一个有效的工具增强型空间记忆智能体框架。EgoWitness为长视频实例级空间记忆提供了系统评测基准，EgoClue则通过检索、验证和时空关系计算显著提升了模型在相关任务上的表现。

title: Thinking in Streams: Proactive Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models
summary: Recognizing when a requested spatial condition holds in streaming video can require maintaining and updating spatial knowledge across changing viewpoints. We study this capability through proactive spatial reasoning, where a model receives a query in advance and determines whether and when to respond as the stream unfolds. We introduce ProSpace-Bench, comprising nine tasks across object, camera, and scene reasoning, and ProSpace-Train for supervised training. To support spatial decisions, we propose ProSpace-VLM, which injects explicit geometric encodings estimated causally from incoming frames into intermediate VLM layers, using the existing KV cache as spatial memory and spatial token selection for efficient streaming. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between VLMs and humans, while ProSpace-VLM improves timely responses and correct abstention over fine-tuned baselines. Analyses examine how ProSpace-VLM represents previously observed spatial information across changing viewpoints.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究流式视频中的主动空间推理：模型需提前接收问题，并在视频流不断展开时判断是否以及何时响应。作者提出ProSpace-Bench和ProSpace-Train，并设计ProSpace-VLM，通过因果估计的显式几何编码、KV缓存空间记忆和空间token选择来提升流式视频空间理解能力。
AI.motivation: 在流式视频中判断空间条件是否成立，往往不能只依赖当前帧，而需要跨视角、跨时间地维护和更新空间知识。现有多模态大模型缺乏对这种持续性空间记忆和时机判断的系统性评测与建模方法，因此需要构建流式空间推理基准并探索更有效的架构。
AI.method: 作者从任务、训练和模型三方面展开：1）提出ProSpace-Bench，覆盖物体、相机和场景层面的九类主动空间推理任务；2）提出ProSpace-Train用于监督训练；3）提出ProSpace-VLM，将从输入帧因果估计出的显式几何编码注入VLM中间层，将现有KV缓存用作空间记忆，并采用空间token选择以实现高效流式推理。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有VLM在流式主动空间推理任务上与人类存在显著差距。相比微调基线，ProSpace-VLM能够更准确地判断响应时机，提高及时回答能力，并增强在不确定或条件不成立时的正确弃权/放弃回答能力。进一步分析显示该模型能够更好地表征和复用此前观测到的空间信息，以应对视角变化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了当前VLM在持续流式视频空间推理中的不足，并证明显式几何表示与KV缓存空间记忆相结合是提升主动空间问答有效性的可行路径。ProSpace-Bench为该方向提供了评测基准，ProSpace-VLM为跨视角空间知识维护提供了新的模型设计思路。

title: WHU-Road3D: A dataset and benchmark towards fine-grained road surface mapping
summary: Accurately extracting and mapping road surface elements is crucial for applications such as high-definition maps, road asset management, and intelligent transportation systems. This study first provides a comprehensive review of the benchmark datasets for extracting and mapping road elements, encompassing overhead-to-perspective data, large-to-local scales, and coarse-to-fine details. Subsequently, we thoroughly review the relevant approaches for extracting road surface elements. However, we argue that existing datasets still require enhancements in semantic richness, data modality diversity, and scenario complexity. To bridge these gaps, this paper presents WHU-Road3D, a large-scale multimodal dataset for fine-grained road surface mapping to address these shortcomings. WHU-Road3D provides approximately 100 km of diverse Chinese highways and urban streets. It features a rich combination of MLS point clouds, associated panoramic images, vehicle trajectories, detailed vectorized annotations, and pointwise instance annotations for road surface elements. The dataset carefully annotates 15 distinct categories of road elements, including common markings like road boundaries, zebra crossings, lane dividers, stop lines, as well as 10 types of direction symbols. To our knowledge, WHU-Road3D stands as the first multimodal dataset for mapping such a comprehensive range of road surface elements, designed to facilitate cutting-edge research in instance segmentation, full-element extraction and mapping on road surfaces. Beyond these immediate applications, WHU-Road3D also provides a valuable source for hierarchical road topology reasoning, map updating, and street scene generation. The dataset, along with the code for our benchmark methods, will be made publicly available at \href{this https URL}{this https URL}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WHU-Road3D，一个约 100 km、多模态、细粒度的道路面元素建图数据集，并综述现有数据集与方法以指出语义、模态和场景不足。
AI.motivation: 道路面元素（如车道线、人行横道、停止线、导向箭头等）的精确提取与建图对高精地图、道路资产管理和智能交通系统至关重要；现有数据集在语义丰富性、多模态数据、场景复杂度方面仍有不足。
AI.method: 作者首先综述道路面元素提取与建图的基准数据集（涵盖俯视到透视、大范围到局部、粗粒度到细粒度）及相关方法；随后构建并标注 WHU-Road3D，整合移动激光扫描点云、全景图像、车辆轨迹、矢量化标注和点级实例标注，覆盖 15 类道路面元素。
AI.result: WHU-Road3D 覆盖约 100 km 中国高速公路与城市道路，提供多源异构数据和细粒度实例标注，被称为首个支持如此全面道路面元素建图的多模态数据集，并公开数据集与基准方法代码。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集可支撑实例分割、道路面全要素提取与建图等研究，同时可用于层次化道路拓扑推理、地图更新和街景生成，为智能交通与高精地图领域提供重要基准资源。

title: EvoMem: Self-Evolving Skills for Time-Aware Long Video Memory Agents
summary: Although memory-augmented architectures have expanded the ability of large vision-language models (LVLMs) to process long videos, existing retrieval processes still largely rely on global semantic matching and lack state-driven temporal control, often returning fragmented or redundant evidence and failing to maintain a coherent evidence chain. To address this challenge, we propose EvoMem, a time-aware long-video memory agent guided by self-evolving retrieval skills. EvoMem constructs a hierarchical time-indexed memory, where different types of evidence are aligned onto a unified video timeline; during retrieval, temporal cues from acquired evidence are further converted into explicit signals that constrain subsequent memory access. To address recurring procedural errors in long-video question answering, such as unclear retrieval targets, improper memory access paths, or premature stopping, EvoMem introduces retrieval skills to provide process-level guidance, enabling the agent to dynamically adjust retrieval content, memory operations, and target temporal ranges according to the current evidence state, while deciding when to stop. Furthermore, inspired by reinforcement learning, we formulate skill evolution as a reward-guided policy improvement process. Each candidate skill is treated as an external policy patch, and rewards are assigned according to answer-correctness state transitions on the validation set. In this way, effective skills are accepted and low-quality skills are rejected without updating model parameters. Experiments on four long-video question answering benchmarks show that EvoMem significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average accuracy of 60.1% and an average improvement of 8.6 percentage points over the previous best methods, demonstrating its effectiveness for long-video reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出EvoMem：一种面向长视频问答的时间感知记忆智能体，通过层次化时间索引记忆、状态驱动的时间线索检索以及可自进化的“检索技能”，缓解现有检索过程碎片化、冗余和早停等问题。在四个长视频问答基准上平均准确率达60.1%，较此前最佳方法提升8.6个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有大视觉语言模型在长视频理解中虽借助记忆增强结构扩展了处理能力，但检索多依赖全局语义匹配，缺少由当前证据状态驱动的时间控制，容易返回零散或重复证据，难以维持连贯证据链，并在长视频问答中出现检索目标不清、记忆访问路径不当、过早停止等过程性错误。
AI.method: EvoMem构建层次化时间索引记忆，将不同类型证据对齐到统一视频时间线；检索时把已获取证据中的时间线索转化为显式约束信号，用于控制后续记忆访问。为规范检索过程，引入“检索技能”作为过程级指导，使智能体能根据当前证据状态动态调整检索内容、记忆操作和目标时间范围，并决定何时停止。受强化学习启发，将技能演化建模为奖励引导的策略改进：每个候选技能视为外部策略补丁，在验证集上根据答案正确性状态转移分配奖励，从而接受有效技能、拒绝低质技能，且无需更新模型参数。
AI.result: 在四个长视频问答基准上的实验表明，EvoMem显著优于现有基线，平均准确率达到60.1%，相比先前最佳方法平均提升8.6个百分点，验证了其在长视频推理中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EvoMem通过时间对齐记忆、状态驱动检索和奖励引导的检索技能进化，将长视频问答中的记忆访问从简单全局检索提升为可控、连贯且可自改进的过程，在显著提升性能的同时避免模型参数更新，为长视频记忆增强推理提供了有效方案。

title: SpatialMem: Building Quantitative Spatial Reasoning Agents with Hierarchical Memory
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in qualitative spatial reasoning, but remain limited in quantitative spatial reasoning. Current work leverages the VLM agent to invoke external vision tools to perform computation. However, these methods usually bind each functional requirement to a single predefined vision specialist, implicitly resulting in fixed and rigid tool pipelines. In practice, addressing diverse spatial scenarios and tasks demands a broader diversity in pipeline orchestration and vision specialist selection to achieve robust spatial reasoning. However, such diversity leads to a combinatorial execution space, making it challenging for the agent to orchestrate the optimal pipelines and specialists for different scenarios. In this work, we propose SpatialMem, a memory framework that enables a VLM agent to accumulate tool-use experience and leverage that memory to orchestrate vision specialists to solve the spatial reasoning problem. SpatialMem builds a two-level memory structure, with task memory capturing tool orchestration and scene memory capturing tool selection. It further introduces a dual-state trajectory optimization process to preserve successful tool experiences and refine suboptimal ones. Moreover, existing spatial reasoning benchmarks suffer from quality issues and limited coverage of scene types and tasks. To address these gap, we propose MetricBench, a benchmark covering both indoor and outdoor scenes and three quantitative spatial reasoning tasks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on MetricBench, Q-Spatial, and SpatilRGPT-Bench, outperforming best VLM baselines by 32% on MetricBench. Additionally, the memory design yields a 9.1% absolute gain over a memory-free agent on MetricBench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 SpatialMem 记忆框架，帮助视觉语言模型智能体利用历史工具使用经验灵活编排视觉专家与工具链，以完成定量空间推理；同时提出 MetricBench 基准。实验显示该方法在多个空间推理基准上取得领先性能，记忆机制带来显著增益。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在定性空间推理上表现较好，但定量空间推理仍受限。已有方法通常将每个功能需求绑定到单一预定义视觉专家，形成固定、僵化的工具流程；而真实空间场景和任务多样，需要更灵活的工具编排与专家选择，这会带来组合式执行空间，使智能体难以稳定找到最优方案。
AI.method: 提出 SpatialMem：通过记忆框架让 VLM 智能体积累并使用工具使用经验。其核心包括两级记忆结构：任务记忆捕获工具编排模式，场景记忆捕获工具选择偏好；并引入双状态轨迹优化过程，保留成功工具经验，同时改进次优轨迹。另提出 MetricBench，覆盖室内外场景和三类定量空间推理任务。
AI.result: SpatialMem 在 MetricBench、Q-Spatial 和 SpatialRGPT-Bench 上取得最先进的结果。在 MetricBench 上，相比最佳 VLM 基线提升 32%；仅记忆设计相比无记忆智能体带来 9.1% 的绝对性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将可积累的工具经验与两级记忆机制用于 VLM 智能体，能够有效缓解定量空间推理中工具流程僵化和编排困难的问题；同时，新基准的提出有助于更充分地评估模型在多样场景下的定量空间推理能力。

title: AGSR: Aperture-Guided Super-Resolution for Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis, but Gaussian rasterization attenuates fine-scale scene structure through the projected covariance of each primitive. We show that contracting these projected covariances at inference time can mitigate the effective bandwidth limitation induced by finite Gaussian footprints, motivating a multi-aperture rendering framework for super-resolution. Based on this insight, we propose AGSR (Aperture-Guided Super-Resolution), a lightweight inference-time framework that progressively fuses multi-aperture renderings using uncertainty-guided feature aggregation and geometric conditioning from transmittance and depth cues. AGSR operates as a plug-in enhancement for pre-trained 3DGS models. Experiments on the Mip-NeRF 360 benchmark show that AGSR outperforms lightweight image-space super-resolution baselines, with gains increasing as the underlying Gaussian representation deteriorates. The results provide evidence that covariance contraction exposes bandwidth-sensitive structural cues attenuated by native Gaussian rasterization. AGSR achieves these improvements while maintaining real-time performance with up to 139k parameters.
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Multimedia Signal Processing (MMSP 2026). Recipient of the Best Paper Award

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AGSR，一种面向预训练 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）的轻量级推理时超分辨率插件框架。其核心思想是在推理时收缩高斯基元的投影协方差，生成“多孔径”渲染结果，并利用不确定性引导特征聚合与透射/深度几何线索进行融合，从而恢复被原生高斯光栅化削弱的高频结构细节，同时保持实时性能。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 虽然支持实时新视角合成，但其每个高斯基元具有有限的投影协方差/足迹，在光栅化过程中会对原始场景中的精细结构和高频细节造成平均化或衰减，形成一种类似有效带宽受限的问题。作者观察到，若在推理时主动收缩这些投影协方差，可以使不同尺度/“孔径”下的渲染结果暴露出被原生 3DGS 渲染抑制的结构线索，因此可据此构建一种无需重新训练即可增强细节的多孔径渲染与融合框架。
AI.method: 论文提出 AGSR（Aperture-Guided Super-Resolution），作为一个轻量级、可插件化接入预训练 3DGS 模型的推理时超分辨率框架。主要流程包括：1）对已训练 3DGS 模型的高斯基元投影协方差进行不同程度的收缩，生成多组“多孔径”渲染结果；2）将这些渲染视为不同尺度/置信度的观测，利用不确定性引导的特征聚合逐层或逐步融合；3）引入透射率与深度等几何线索作为条件，指导细节增强与跨孔径信息选择；4）整个机制作为推理时增强模块运行，不依赖重新训练底层 3DGS，且保持实时能力。
AI.result: 在 Mip-NeRF 360 基准上的实验表明，AGSR 优于轻量级图像超分辨率基线方法。并且，当底层高斯表示质量越差、细节衰减越明显时，AGSR 带来的增益越大。该方法在参数规模仅最多约 139k 的情况下仍能实现明显性能提升，并保持实时渲染性能。
AI.conclusion: 收缩高斯投影协方差能够暴露并恢复被原生 3DGS 光栅化削弱的带宽敏感型结构细节。基于此，AGSR 提供了一种无需重训、轻量可插拔的多孔径渲染融合方案，可作为 3DGS 超分辨率增强模块，在实时约束下改善细节重建质量。

title: Point Dynamics as Proxy for Robotic World Models
summary: Robotic world models predict future video frames from the current observation and a sequence of robot actions. While recent models follow the given actions closely, manipulated objects often collapse or move inconsistently with the action. We attribute this to the conditioning: an action, or a rendering of the robot, specifies where the robot goes but not how the scene responds, leaving a single video model to infer the interaction dynamics implicitly while also rendering appearance. We therefore separate dynamics prediction from visual rendering, with 3D point dynamics as the proxy between them. Specifically, we lift the first frame into 3D points, simulate how they respond to the robot's motion with a learned point dynamics model, and render the simulated points back into pixel-aligned videos that any video model can read. In controlled experiments on the DROID dataset with two video renderers of different architectures, this point dynamics proxy reduces object motion error by 8.6% and 6.2% without degrading image quality, and by 8.1% on a real bimanual robot. Moreover, the video follows the simulation: more accurate dynamics yield more accurate object motion, and editing the points steers the video. This suggests that advances in dynamics modeling can translate into more faithful robotic world models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在机器人世界模型中解耦动力学预测与视觉渲染，以3D点动力学作为中间代理：将首帧提升为3D点，用学习到的点动力学模型预测其在机器人动作下的响应，再将模拟结果渲染回像素对齐的视频。该方法在DROID数据集和真实双臂机器人上降低了物体运动误差，并表明更准确的动力学可提升视频对交互过程的忠实度。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人世界模型虽然能较好跟随输入动作或机器人渲染图像，但被操作物体常出现塌陷、漂移或与动作不一致的运动。作者认为原因在于“条件化方式不足”：动作或机器人视觉表征主要描述机器人自身如何运动，却没有显式表达场景如何响应动作，导致单个视频模型必须同时隐含推断交互动力学和渲染外观，容易出现物体动力学不一致。
AI.method: 提出分离动力学建模与视频渲染：1）将观测首帧提升为3D点表示；2）用学习到的点动力学模型根据机器人动作模拟这些3D点的运动与交互响应；3）将模拟后的点云/点轨迹渲染为像素对齐的视频帧，使任意视频模型可继续生成外观；4）在DROID数据集上用两种不同架构的视频渲染器验证，并进一步在真实双臂机器人上测试。同时通过编辑模拟点轨迹来考察其对生成视频的引导能力。
AI.result: 在DROID数据集的受控实验中，引入点动力学代理后，两种视频渲染器下的物体运动误差分别降低8.6%和6.2%，且不损害图像质量；在真实双臂机器人实验中也使物体运动误差降低8.1%。此外，动力学预测越准确，生成视频中的物体运动也越准确；编辑模拟点可以引导视频结果，说明3D点动力学成为可控、可编辑且能提升世界模型忠实度的中间表示。
AI.conclusion: 在机器人世界模型中，将“场景如何响应动作”的动力学预测从外观渲染中显式分离，并使用3D点动力学作为代理，可显著改善物体运动一致性和可控性。该结果支持：动力学建模的进展可以直接转化为更忠实、更可控的机器人世界模型。

title: MorphTwin: Enriching Deformable Material Responses from Videos for Morphable and Interactive Physical Twins
summary: Reconstructing interactive physical twins from video requires accurately capturing how objects deform while maintaining efficient simulation. We observe that reproducing motion in a video does not guarantee correct responses to new forces when the physical representation restricts how an object can deform. In spring-based twins, coupling between volume and shape responses creates such a limitation. We present MorphTwin, which enriches local deformation modes to capture and independently control these responses while retaining standard spring forces and explicit simulation. To support interpretable material editing and transfer, we use offline calibration to map shared relative response changes to stiffness updates on each reconstructed graph. Under identical inverse settings on synthetic scenes, MorphTwin reduces the mean absolute error of Poisson's ratio by 75.8% and the mean relative error of Young's modulus by 22.1% compared to PhysTwin. We introduce an egocentric stereo and RGB-D benchmark covering interactions with objects of varying stiffness. Real-world experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy and up to 14.4% lower future tracking error than PhysTwin at interactive speeds.

AI.tldr: MorphTwin是一种从视频重建可交互物理孪生体的方法，通过丰富局部形变模式来独立控制体积与形状响应，在保持标准弹簧力和显式仿真的同时提升材料参数重建与未来跟踪精度。
AI.motivation: 交互式物理孪生重建需要准确捕捉物体形变并保持高效仿真。传统弹簧基模型中体积响应与形状响应存在耦合，限制了物体可能的形变方式；即使能复现视频中的运动，也不代表在新受力下具有正确物理响应，因此需要更灵活的局部形变表示以改善物理参数估计和交互预测能力。
AI.method: 提出MorphTwin，在标准弹簧力和显式仿真框架内增强局部形变模式，使体积响应和形状响应可以被分别捕捉和控制。为支持可解释的材料编辑与迁移，采用离线标定，将共享的相对响应变化映射到每个重建图上的刚度更新。评估包括合成场景中的逆问题设置，以及覆盖不同刚度物体交互的第一人称立体视觉与RGB-D基准测试。
AI.result: 在相同逆问题设置下，相比PhysTwin，MorphTwin将泊松比平均绝对误差降低75.8%，杨氏模量平均相对误差降低22.1%。真实世界实验表明其重建精度更高，并在交互速度下未来跟踪误差相比PhysTwin最多降低14.4%。
AI.conclusion: MorphTwin通过解耦体积与形状形变响应，在保留高效显式仿真的同时显著提升了从视频重建交互式物理孪生体的参数准确性、泛化性和可编辑性，为可解释材料建模与物理预测提供了更有效的框架。

title: Multi-View Transformer with Geometry-Guided Multi-Modal ControlNet for 3D Virtual Try-On
summary: Editing a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) capture of a person so that they wear a new garment requires every rendered view to agree on the same garment details. Existing 3D virtual try-on (VTON) pipelines, however, edit training views largely independently and fuse them with hand-designed heuristics such as manually chosen reference views and fixed attention-blending weights. The resulting inconsistencies are baked into the 3D representation and surface as texture drift, blurred prints, and implausible geometry in novel views. We present GS-VTON-MVT, a three-stage framework that combines implicit and explicit 3D reasoning for consistent 3DGS try-on. (i) A multi-view inpainting transformer jointly edits a set of training views with full cross-view self-attention, so that cross-view correspondence is learned rather than imposed. (ii) A geometry-guided multi-modal ControlNet conditions the diffusion editor on the garment image together with depth and surface normals rendered from the current 3DGS state, supplying explicit structure where visual evidence is weakest. (iii) A pose-adaptive persona-aware attention replaces the fixed blending weight between current-view and reference-view features with weights derived from camera-pose proximity. On the 3D-VTONBench benchmark, GS-VTON-MVT improves FID, KID, LPIPS-based cross-view consistency, and user preference over general-purpose 3D editors and prior 3D try-on methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 GS-VTON-MVT，一个面向 3D Gaussian Splatting 人物试衣的三阶段框架，通过多视角联合编辑、几何引导扩散编辑和姿态自适应注意力融合，解决已有 3D 虚拟试衣在 3DGS 表示中多视角纹理与几何不一致的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 虚拟试衣方法通常独立编辑训练视图，并依赖手工选择的参考视图或固定注意力融合权重。这样会把视图间不一致性“烘焙”进 3DGS 表示中，导致新视角出现纹理漂移、印花模糊和不合理几何形变。
AI.method: 方法包含三个阶段：首先，使用多视角修复 Transformer 联合编辑一组训练视图，通过完整跨视角自注意力学习视图间对应关系；其次，使用几何引导的多模态 ControlNet，将服装图像与由当前 3DGS 状态渲染的深度图和表面法线一起输入扩散编辑器，为视觉证据较弱区域提供显式结构约束；最后，引入姿态自适应 persona-aware attention，用相机姿态邻近性推导当前视图与参考视图特征的融合权重，替代固定权重。
AI.result: 在 3D-VTONBench 基准上，GS-VTON-MVT 相比通用 3D 编辑器和先前 3D 试衣方法，在 FID、KID、基于 LPIPS 的跨视角一致性和用户偏好方面均取得更好结果。
AI.conclusion: GS-VTON-MVT 将隐式跨视角学习与显式 3D 几何约束结合起来，使 3DGS 人物试衣在新视角下保持更一致的服装纹理和几何外观，提升了 3D 虚拟试衣的真实感与多视角稳定性。

title: Fixing the Twin, Not the Detector: Sim-to-Real Roadside LiDAR Detection from Digital-Twin Data
summary: Roadside LiDAR detectors are expensive to train on real labels, and digital twins promise to replace these labels, but a detector trained on a twin meets a different sensor, different objects and different annotation conventions on the real site. We describe the pipeline that placed first in the LUMPI track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge (IEEE BigData 2026 Cup, 0.5541 combined score) and fifth on its V2X-Real track (0.8102). Every detector is a CenterPoint model trained only on synthetic data, on a single 8 GB laptop GPU. Most of the gain came from correcting differences between the twin and the real site rather than from the detector. We align the twin's coordinates, point density and box convention with the test sensor, generate the pedestrians and riders that the twins lack, plus street clutter as unlabeled negatives, and rebuild twin objects at real size and real point density. A non-learned resampling to the per-cell point density of unlabeled real frames lifts LUMPI realism from 0.589 to 0.947, against 0.949 between real frames. Label-free post-processing then exploits what a fixed roadside sensor guarantees: static structures recur in every frame, and real objects have characteristic point statistics. Reporting the validation and test gain of each component side by side, we find that corrections of systematic sim-to-real differences transfer to the test set, typically keeping a quarter to three quarters of their validation gain, while choices that fit the few objects of a validation set do not.
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Accepted to the IEEE BigData 2026 Cup (UCF UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge); first place, LUMPI track. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向路侧LiDAR检测的Sim2Real流程，仅用合成数据训练CenterPoint，并通过系统性的数据与后处理对齐来缩小数字孪生与真实传感器之间的差距，在UrbanTwin挑战赛中取得优异成绩。
AI.motivation: 路侧LiDAR检测器依赖真实标注成本高，数字孪生可替代真实标签，但孪生数据在传感器特性、目标对象、点密度、坐标与标注约定等方面与真实场景存在差异，导致仅用合成数据训练的模型难以直接迁移到真实路侧场景。
AI.method: 作者构建以CenterPoint为基础的检测流程，仅使用合成数据在单卡8GB笔记本GPU上训练。核心在于多项Sim2Real校正：统一孪生数据与测试传感器的坐标、点密度和检测框约定；生成孪生中缺失的行人和骑行者；将街道杂物作为无标签负样本纳入训练；按真实尺寸和真实点密度重建孪生对象；并采用非学习式的逐格点密度重采样，使合成点云匹配无标签真实帧的点分布。最后利用固定路侧传感器特性进行无标签后处理，例如利用静态结构跨帧重复出现以及真实目标具有典型点统计特性来抑制误检或修正结果。
AI.result: 该方案获得UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge中LUMPI track第一名，综合得分0.5541，并在V2X-Real track获得第五名，得分0.8102。非学习点密度重采样显著提升了LUMPI真实性指标，从0.589提升至0.947，接近真实帧之间的0.949。作者发现，针对系统性Sim2Real差异的校正通常能迁移到测试集，保留验证集增益的四分之三到四分之一；而仅拟合少量验证集目标的选择则难以迁移。
AI.conclusion: 对于路侧LiDAR检测的Sim2Real问题，提升效果的主要来源不是检测模型本身，而是对孪生数据与真实传感器之间系统性差异的显式校正。通过坐标、密度、标注约定、目标类别和点统计层面的对齐，并结合无标签后处理，可以在不依赖真实标签的情况下取得强竞争力结果，同时组件级验证与测试增益对比也表明，应优先采用可泛化的系统性校正而非过拟合验证集的小技巧。

title: Streaming-AAA: Streaming AAA Game Video Generation at High Resolution, High Frame Rate, and Low Latency
summary: Controllable streaming video generation offers a promising route toward interactive game simulation, yet existing methods remain far from practical gameplay. They often fail to jointly achieve high visual fidelity, high frame rates, and low interaction latency, resulting in poor responsiveness and degraded user experience. We present Streaming-AAA, a new paradigm for controllable infinite generation of AAA-quality game videos. Our system generates 1080p gameplay videos at 43 FPS with 198 ms end-to-end latency interaction on merely NVIDIA A800 GPUs, while supporting long-horizon play without severe temporal degradation or collapse. Streaming-AAA is built upon three key designs. First, we redesign the VAE architecture for efficient high-resolution decoding, enabling real-time synthesis at 1080p. Second, we pretrain the diffusion model using diffusion forcing and significantly extend the temporal training horizon, allowing the model to capture long-term dependencies and maintain persistent memory. Third, we perform post-training distillation and memory compression to improve inference efficiency while retaining visual quality and temporal consistency. Experiments show that Streaming-AAA substantially improves visual fidelity, frame rate, latency, and long-term stability over prior controllable video generation approaches, enabling a significantly more playable experience for interactive AAA game video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Streaming-AAA，一种面向可交互 3A 游戏视频的可控流式生成范式，通过高效 VAE、扩散强制长时训练和蒸馏/记忆压缩，实现 1080p、43 FPS、198 ms 端到端延迟的长时间稳定生成。
AI.motivation: 现有可控流式视频生成方法难以同时满足高画质、高帧率和低交互延迟，导致交互响应差、用户体验不足，距离实用化游戏模拟仍有较大差距。
AI.method: 系统包含三项核心设计：重新设计 VAE 以支持高效高分辨率实时解码；采用扩散强制预训练并显著扩展时间训练范围，以增强长期依赖建模和持久记忆；通过后训练蒸馏和记忆压缩提升推理效率，同时保持视觉质量与时间一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明，Streaming-AAA 在视觉保真度、帧率、交互延迟和长期稳定性方面显著优于现有可控视频生成方法，可在仅使用 NVIDIA A800 GPU 的条件下生成 1080p、43 FPS、198 ms 延迟的游戏视频，并支持长时间游玩而避免严重时间退化或崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为可交互 3A 质量游戏视频生成提供了更实用的流式生成范式，显著提升了实时性与长期一致性，推动生成式游戏模拟向可游玩体验迈进。

title: PaveSplat: Resolution-Robust Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting with Residually Corrected Surface-Aligned Covariances
summary: We present PaveSplat, a feed-forward Gaussian splatting method that adds a learned residual to the analytic surface-aligned covariance, keeping surfels paving the visible surface across rendering resolutions. Pixel-aligned feed-forward Gaussian splatting predicts one primitive per pixel from a few images in a single pass, and its rendering quality depends on how well these primitives cover the surface. Recent surfel-based methods compute the surface-aligned covariance analytically from predicted depth. However, this covariance has no way to correct the surfel orientation where the depth-derived frame is ill-posed. The surfels then cover the surface loosely; at the training resolution each surfel's one-pixel minimum footprint covers the gaps, but they show up as holes when the same prediction is re-rendered at a higher resolution. To address this, we keep the analytic covariance as an initialization, with its axes aligned to the surface tangents, and add an identity-initialized unit-quaternion residual that reorients a surfel only where this improves rendering, turning surfels that the analytic frame mis-aims back onto the surface. On RealEstate10K, PaveSplat achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS among single-Gaussian-per-pixel methods at every scale (1x-8x). The native-resolution gain is small; the benefit appears when the same prediction is rendered at higher display resolutions without re-running the network. On zero-shot DL3DV, it leads PSNR within this group at every scale and ranks first or second on SSIM/LPIPS. A coverage-hole analysis shows fewer uncovered pixels than both baselines under high-resolution re-rendering.

AI.tldr: PaveSplat 提出一种前馈高斯泼溅方法，在由深度解析得到的表面对齐协方差基础上学习残差四元数，修正 surfel 朝向，使单像素高斯在更高分辨率重渲染时仍紧密覆盖可见表面。
AI.motivation: 像素对齐的前馈高斯泼溅通常每个像素预测一个 primitive，其渲染质量取决于这些 primitive 对表面的覆盖程度。现有 surfel 方法直接从预测深度解析地构造表面对齐协方差，但当深度导出的局部坐标系不适定时，无法修正 surfel 朝向，导致表面覆盖松散；在训练分辨率下可能不明显，但在更高分辨率重渲染同一预测结果时会出现空洞。
AI.method: 该方法保留解析表面对齐协方差作为初始化，使其主轴与表面切向对齐，并额外引入一个以单位四元数恒等变换初始化的可学习残差旋转。该残差只在能够改善渲染效果时对 surfel 进行重新朝向，从而将分析框架错误定位的 surfel 拉回表面。整体仍属于单次前馈、每像素单高斯的框架。
AI.result: 在 RealEstate10K 上，PaveSplat 在 1x 到 8x 各个渲染尺度上，于每像素单高斯方法中取得最佳 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS。原生分辨率下提升有限，优势主要体现在同一预测结果无需重新运行网络、仅在更高分辨率下重渲染时。在零样本 DL3DV 上，它在所有尺度上取得该组方法中最高的 PSNR，并在 SSIM/LPIPS 上排名第一或第二。覆盖空洞分析显示，其高分辨率重渲染下未覆盖像素数量少于两种基线。
AI.conclusion: 在解析表面对齐协方差上加入可学习残差四元数，能够以低侵入方式修正深度不适定区域的 surfel 朝向，从而增强前馈高斯泼溅在高分辨率重渲染下的表面覆盖稳定性和视觉质量。

title: Less Than Meets the Eye: Action-Set Identifiability and Principled Abstention for 3D Physical Geometry
summary: A corridor, its mirror reflection, and its image on a display can look identical, yet their physical surfaces lie at different depths. We test whether bounded camera motions distinguish these explanations. Intervene3D takes an image and an initial geometry estimate, predicts the view under each hypothesis and candidate motion, and selects a motion by maximin separability. It reports the mechanism and first physical surface only if the available motions separate the hypotheses still in contention. Otherwise it abstains. An adequacy test also rejects observations that no hypothesis explains. On a matched synthetic benchmark with exact landmarks, disabling abstention gives confident answers on 76.4% of unresolvable scenes. With abstention, none receives a confident answer under exact or noisy landmarks. At 100% accuracy on answered scenes, maximin selection answers 61.0% of scenes and summed selection 43.1%. The adequacy test lowers wrong answers on strongly curved mirror scenes from 56.8% to 12.4%. Real display experiments compare two hypotheses using one frozen depth-network estimate. The second image supplies photometric evidence and is never passed through the depth network. One executed motion reduces the pooled median surface error of twelve networks by 31.5%. These networks have larger error inside the annotated panel than outside on 33.4% of illusion-benchmark images. They place the first physical surface behind the glass on 36.9% of Mirror3D frames.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出Intervene3D，利用受限相机运动主动检验图像中“走廊、镜面反射和显示画面”等不同深度解释能否被区分；在无法区分时拒绝给出答案，从而减少单目深度/场景理解的幻觉性错误。
AI.motivation: 同一图像可能对应不同的物理表面和空间机制，例如真实走廊、镜子反射或屏幕显示看起来相似但深度不同。单目几何估计容易在这些视觉幻觉场景中产生错误，需要可验证的主动干预来区分竞争解释。
AI.method: 给定一张图像和初始几何估计，Intervene3D为每个假设和候选相机运动预测新视角图像，并通过maximin separability选择最能分离竞争假设的运动。只有在可用运动能将仍处于争议中的假设分开时才报告机制和第一物理表面，否则弃权。另设adequacy test，拒绝所有假设都无法解释的观测。
AI.result: 在匹配的合成基准上，若关闭弃权机制，系统会在76.4%的不可分辨场景中给出自信答案；启用弃权后，无论landmark精确或带噪，均不再对不可分辨场景给出自信答案。在已回答场景达到100%准确率时，maximin选择能回答61.0%的场景，summed选择为43.1%。在强弯曲镜面场景中，adequacy test将错误答案比例从56.8%降至12.4%。真实显示实验中，仅执行一次运动即可将12个深度网络的池化中位表面误差降低31.5%；这些网络在33.4%的幻觉基准图像上标注面板内部误差高于外部，在36.9%的Mirror3D帧上将第一物理表面错误放在玻璃后方。
AI.conclusion: 通过主动相机运动和假设检验，Intervene3D能在视觉深度歧义中提高可靠性，避免对不可分辨场景过度自信；方法可暴露并缓解深度模型在镜面、屏幕等幻觉场景中的系统性错误。

title: One-to-Many: Diverse and Bidirectional Image-to-Image Translation via Rectified Flow
summary: Many paired image-to-image translation tasks admit multiple valid target appearances, while training provides only one target per source. We propose One-to-Many Flow (O2MFlow), a latent-conditioned Rectified Flow (RF) model for one-to-many generation and backward translation (target$\rightarrow$source) within a single transport framework. Conditioning the RF dynamics on an appearance latent turns transport into a family of latent-indexed bijections: a fixed latent gives a mapping that is inverted by time-reversed integration, and sampled latents produce diverse outputs for the same input. We formalize reusable appearance variations as Shared Latent Transport and show that Kullback--Leibler (KL) regularization directly controls the source--latent distribution gap between training and generation. Across three benchmarks, O2MFlow offers dataset-dependent forward diversity--fidelity trade-offs and the lowest backward LPIPS-Dist among evaluated methods, with the lowest backward FID on two benchmarks.
comment: 12 pages, 13 figures, 4 tables. Includes supplementary material

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 One-to-Many Flow（O2MFlow），一种潜变量条件化的 Rectified Flow 模型，用于统一处理图像到图像翻译中的“一对多”正向生成与目标到源的反向翻译，并通过共享潜变量传输与 KL 正则化控制训练与生成阶段中源分布和潜变量分布之间的差异。
AI.motivation: 许多图像到图像翻译任务存在多个合理的目标图像外观，但训练数据通常只为每个源图像提供一个目标图像，导致模型难以充分学习一对多的映射关系。同时，现有方法往往难以在一个统一框架中同时支持多样化的正向翻译和高质量的反向翻译。因此，论文旨在构建一个能够同时处理一对多生成、反向重建以及潜变量分布控制的统一传输建模框架。
AI.method: 作者提出 O2MFlow，这是一种基于 Rectified Flow 的潜变量条件化生成模型。模型将运输过程条件化于一个外观潜变量，从而形成一族由潜变量索引的双射映射。给定固定潜变量时，模型学习一个可逆映射，并可通过时间反向积分实现目标到源的反向翻译；通过采样不同潜变量，则可以对同一输入生成多样化的目标图像。论文进一步提出“共享潜变量传输”（Shared Latent Transport）来形式化可复用的外观变化，并证明 KL 正则化可以直接控制训练与生成过程中源图像分布和潜变量分布之间的差距。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的实验表明，O2MFlow 在不同数据集上能够展现出多样化正向生成与保真度之间的权衡关系。在反向翻译方面，该方法取得了所有比较方法中最低的 backward LPIPS-Dist，并在两个基准上取得了最低的 backward FID，说明其在反向重建质量上具有明显优势。
AI.conclusion: O2MFlow 通过潜变量条件化 Rectified Flow 实现了正向一对多生成与反向翻译的统一建模。其核心思想是将外观变化显式编码为可复用潜变量，并利用共享潜变量传输框架和 KL 正则化缓解训练与生成之间的分布不匹配。实验结果支持该方法在保持生成多样性的同时提升反向翻译质量。

title: Domain-Aware Conformal Prediction for Trustworthy Spacecraft Pose Estimation under Sim-to-Real Shift
summary: Autonomous rendezvous and proximity operations require not only an accurate estimate of the pose of the target spacecraft, but also a reliable indication of when this estimate can be trusted. Conformal prediction provides such an indication with a formal guarantee, by producing pose uncertainty sets that contain the true pose with a specified probability. Such a guarantee, however, assumes that calibration and test data follow the same distribution, an assumption that is violated in orbital perception, where labelled calibration images are available only from synthetic renderings while operational images are real. In this work, we show on the SPEED+ dataset that conformal pose estimation calibrated on synthetic images loses its coverage guarantee on real images, and that many of the resulting failures are silent: the predicted pose set appears valid but excludes the true pose. To address this, we calibrate on synthetic images translated to the appearance of real images. Since translation alters appearance while preserving geometry, the synthetic pose labels remain valid and no labelled real images are required. Experiments with two translation models show that this calibration restores coverage above the specified level for miscoverage levels of 0.1 and above, and reduces silent failures from up to 43.5% to at most 3.3% of the test images, bringing conformal pose estimation a step closer to trustworthy deployment in space.

AI.tldr: 论文提出在合成图像上进行外观翻译以校准共形预测，使航天器姿态估计的不确定性集合在真实轨道图像上恢复可信覆盖率，并显著减少“静默失败”。
AI.motivation: 自主交会和近距离操作需要目标航天器姿态的高精度估计，还需要判断该估计何时可信。共形预测可提供具有形式保证的姿态不确定性集合，但其保证依赖校准数据与测试数据同分布；在轨道视觉感知中，带标签的校准图像通常来自合成渲染，而运行图像是真实图像，导致分布偏移，使共形预测覆盖率失效。
AI.method: 作者在SPEED+数据集上验证共形姿态估计在合成图像校准、真实图像测试时的覆盖率退化问题，并指出大量失败表现为静默失败：预测集合看似有效但不包含真实姿态。为解决该问题，方法不是要求真实带标签图像，而是先对合成图像进行图像翻译，将其外观转换为接近真实轨道图像的风格；由于外观翻译不改变几何结构，原始合成姿态标签仍然有效，因此可在翻译后的图像上进行共形校准。
AI.result: 实验使用两种图像翻译模型进行校准，结果表明该方法能够在误覆盖率0.1及以上的水平上恢复并超过指定覆盖率，同时将静默失败比例从最高43.5%降低到不超过3.3%。
AI.conclusion: 基于外观翻译的合成图像共形校准能够在缺乏真实带标签数据的条件下缓解合成到真实域移，使共形姿态估计的不确定性集合在真实图像上更可靠，为太空中的可信自主姿态估计与近距离操作部署提供了可行途径。

title: DfD-GS: Defocus Image Prior for Metric-Scale Single-View Depth Estimation and View Synthesis
summary: Recovering metric-scale geometry from observations at a single viewpoint remains fundamentally ill-posed, limiting the reliability of novel view synthesis. Recent methods rely on learned monocular depth priors, which provide strong structural estimates but can suffer from scale ambiguity and dataset-dependent biases. We propose DfD-GS, a feed-forward framework that predicts a metric-scale 3D Gaussian scene representation from a single-view all-in-focus--defocused image pair. The key idea is to exploit defocus blur as a physical metric depth cue. DfD-GS first estimates a defocus-based metric disparity map from the all-in-focus--defocused image pair and the corresponding defocus strength. This estimate is used to align and refine a monocular depth prior to metric scale. Visible and hidden 3D Gaussians are then predicted for occlusion-aware novel view synthesis. Experiments on synthetic-defocus datasets constructed from Booster and Middlebury show that DfD-GS outperforms single-image baselines in metric depth estimation and novel view synthesis. On WildRGB-D, DfD-GS achieves lower AbsRel and LPIPS but higher depth RMSE than the single-image baselines. Additional analyses show that DfD-GS maintains a more stable metric scale under field-of-view changes. Qualitative results on a real dataset show recovery of the main scene structure under optical defocus.

AI.tldr: DfD-GS 利用单视角清晰-离焦图像对中的离焦模糊作为物理度量深度线索，前馈预测度量尺度 3D 高斯场景，用于遮挡感知的深度估计与新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 单视角度量尺度几何恢复本质上是病态问题；已有单目深度先验虽能提供结构，但存在尺度歧义和数据集偏差，限制了新视角合成的可靠性。
AI.method: DfD-GS 从清晰-离焦图像对估计基于离焦的度量视差图，并利用该估计将单目深度先验对齐并细化到度量尺度，随后预测可见与隐藏 3D 高斯，实现遮挡感知的度量尺度 3D 高斯场景表示和新视角合成。
AI.result: 在 Booster 和 Middlebury 构建的离焦数据集上，DfD-GS 在度量深度估计和新视角合成上优于单图基线；在 WildRGB-D 上取得更低 AbsRel 和 LPIPS，但深度 RMSE 高于单图基线。分析表明其在视场变化下保持更稳定的度量尺度，并在真实离焦数据上恢复主要场景结构。
AI.conclusion: 离焦模糊可作为有效物理度量线索，使单视角 3D 高斯重建获得度量尺度并缓解单目先验的尺度不稳定问题，但整体深度误差仍受复杂场景或单目先验融合影响。

title: Frequency-Synchronized Boundary Coupling for Training-Free Multi-Prompt Long Video Generation
summary: Text-to-video generation has made remarkable progress with diffusion models and transformer-based video architectures, yet generating coherent long videos from evolving textual descriptions remains challenging. Training long-video models from scratch requires substantial computation and large-scale multi-event data, while training-free multi-prompt generation must activate new prompt semantics without breaking temporal continuity. We identify a frequency-agnostic boundary coupling problem in existing transition strategies: weak coupling causes abrupt changes, flicker, and background jumps, whereas overly strong or coarse coupling may over-preserve source semantics and produce ghosting or duplicated subjects around prompt boundaries. To address this problem, we propose FreqSync, a training-free framework that formulates prompt transitions as frequency-selective boundary coupling. FreqSync combines Frequency-Synchronized Source-Conditioned Attention (FS-SCA) with Residual-Clipped Spectral Stitching (RCSS), enabling adjacent segments to share stable low- and mid-frequency structure and motion cues while keeping high-frequency prompt-specific details target-dominant under explicit residual constraints. Extensive experiments show that FreqSync achieves state-of-the-art transition smoothness and prompt alignment while maintaining strong perceptual video quality, demonstrating its effectiveness for coherent multi-prompt long video generation.
