AI.tldr: 本文提出 Asuka-FM，一个可在单张消费级 GPU 上从头预训练的小型双流 DiT 文生图框架；通过去 AdaLN 的双流架构、稀疏-稠密残差融合的注意力稀疏化、形状稳定的纵横比归一化 RoPE 与轻量像素细化头，以约 206M 参数、约 160 GPU 小时、低于 55 美元的训练成本，在 256px/512px 开源基准上取得具有竞争力的 GenEval 和 DPG 结果，强调面向学术界可及性的效率帕累托最优。
AI.motivation: 当前前沿文生图基础模型高度依赖百亿参数级 Diffusion Transformer 与大规模预训练集群，显著提高了学术实验室的研究门槛。若在单张消费级 GPU 上从头训练 DiT，主要瓶颈包括：注意力序列带来的二次计算与显存压力；可变长宽比分桶导致 JIT 编译和图断点；冻结 VAE 在每步训练中的吞吐限制。作者希望证明通过系统级与架构级协同设计，小模型也能以较低成本获得可用的文生图基础能力。
AI.method: Asuka-FM 的核心方法包括四点：(i) 采用无 AdaLN 的双流 DiT 主干，降低参数规模并简化条件注入路径；(ii) 提出 SPRINT 结构化序列稀疏化，即 Sparse-Dense Residual Fusion，以减少注意力 FLOPs 并保留关键视觉信息；(iii) 使用连续长宽比归一化 RoPE 并配合移位方形裁剪训练，使张量形状固定，避免动态分桶导致的编译中断，同时支持零样本虚拟相机控制；(iv) 引入像素适应阶段，通过约 10M 参数的 Patch Detailer Head 在 v-prediction 下增强高频细节与像素级生成质量。
AI.result: 在未针对特定基准微调的开源评测中，Asuka-FM 在 256px 下达到 GenEval 0.588、DPG 78.96；在 512px 下达到 GenEval 0.609、DPG 78.51。作者认为其以约 206M 参数和约 160 GPU 小时、低于 55 美元的单卡预训练成本，建立了面向民主化基础模型的新效率帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明文生图小模型的可行性并不只取决于参数规模，还取决于注意力效率、训练形状稳定性、VAE/像素路径优化以及条件建模设计的协同。Asuka-FM 为资源受限环境下的 DiT 预训练提供了可复现的系统方案，但其结果仍主要反映小模型在开放域基准上的竞争力，距离大规模前沿模型在图像真实感、复杂语义组合与更高分辨率生成方面可能仍存在差距。

title: Risk-Controlled Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) models enable efficient test-time adaptation by leveraging expert demonstrations as additional context without updating model parameters. However, even when retrieved demonstrations are relevant to the current task, the VLA may fail to effectively utilize the retrieved information, ultimately leading to task failure. To address this challenge, we propose R2-VLA, a risk-controlled retrieval-augmented VLA framework that enables reliable test-time adaptation by satisfying a user-specified task success rate requirement with minimal expert assistance. Specifically, R2-VLA learns an uncertainty predictor that estimates the uncertainty of the VLA's predicted actions given the retrieved demonstrations, guiding when to act autonomously or request expert assistance. We further introduce a task-level risk-control procedure that calibrates the uncertainty threshold to satisfy a user-specified task-failure risk requirement. Moreover, R2-VLA continually incorporates expert corrections into its retrieval memory to improve future adaptation while preserving the prescribed task-level risk guarantee. Experiments across three VLA backbones and four LIBERO benchmark suites demonstrate that R2-VLA improves average task success by 9.2--11.2 percentage points, achieving the desired target with fewer expert requests. These results highlight the effectiveness of connecting the usefulness of retrieved demonstrations with task-level risk control to enable successful robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R2-VLA：一种风险控制型检索增强视觉-语言-动作模型，利用专家示范进行可靠测试时适配，并在满足用户指定任务成功率要求的同时尽量减少专家协助请求。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强VLA即使找到相关示范，也未必能有效利用检索到的信息，导致任务失败。因此需要一种机制，在模型不确定或可能失败时谨慎请求专家协助，并控制整体任务失败风险。
AI.method: R2-VLA训练一个不确定性预测器，根据检索到的示范估计VLA预测动作的不确定性，用于决定何时自主执行、何时请求专家协助。进一步引入任务级风险控制流程，校准不确定性阈值以满足用户设定的失败风险约束。同时，将专家纠正持续加入检索记忆，以改善后续适配，同时保持预设的任务级风险保证。
AI.result: 在三个VLA骨干和四个LIBERO基准套件上的实验表明，R2-VLA平均任务成功率提升9.2至11.2个百分点，并且以更少的专家请求达到目标性能。
AI.conclusion: 将检索示范的有效性与任务级风险控制相结合，可以提升机器人操作中测试时适配的可靠性，使检索增强VLA在低专家介入条件下仍能满足指定成功要求。

title: Fixing the Last Mile: Failure-Aware Image Restoration with Region-Specific Guidance
summary: Recent advances in image restoration have greatly improved global image fidelity, producing visually plausible results across most regions of an image. Nevertheless, even high-quality restorations often exhibit localized failures, including artifacts in semantically important regions such as faces and text, structural inconsistencies, and texture mismatches. Although these errors typically affect only a small portion of the image, they often dominate the overall perceptual quality of the result. In this work, we propose Failure-Aware Image Restoration (FAIR) to address the "last-mile" problem in image restoration. Rather than applying one uniform generative prior over the whole image, we condition a single-pass restoration model on both where local failures are likely to occur and what corrective guidance each region requires. This region-bound conditioning enables fine-grained and controllable restoration that improves semantic accuracy and stylistic consistency in critical regions while maintaining faithful, high-quality restoration elsewhere. Our method complements existing restoration pipelines by shifting the emphasis from global fidelity to local perceptual acceptability. Extensive experiments show that the proposed approach resolves common failure cases and improves perceptual quality, bridging the gap between technical accuracy and practical usability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Failure-Aware Image Restoration（FAIR），通过感知局部失败区域并为不同区域提供定向修复指导，解决图像恢复中“整体质量高但局部关键区域仍易出错”的最后一公里问题。
AI.motivation: 现有图像恢复方法虽能显著提升全局保真度和整体视觉质量，但在人脸、文字等语义关键区域仍常出现局部伪影、结构不一致和纹理错配等问题。这些错误影响范围小，却会明显主导人类感知质量，因此需要更细粒度的局部失败感知与修复机制。
AI.method: 作者提出FAIR框架，不同于对整幅图像施加统一生成先验，而是在单阶段恢复过程中同时条件化两个信息：一是局部失败可能发生的区域位置，二是每个区域所需的修正指导。该方法通过区域绑定条件实现细粒度、可控的图像恢复，从而增强关键区域的语义准确性和风格一致性，同时保持其他区域的忠实恢复。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，FAIR能够有效缓解常见局部失败案例，并提升恢复结果的感知质量，缩小技术准确性与实际可用性之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: FAIR将图像恢复的关注点从全局保真进一步拓展到局部感知可接受性，作为现有恢复流程的补充，可改善关键语义区域的修复质量，同时不牺牲整体恢复效果。

title: SHUSH: Emission-Aware Reward Design for Proactive Video Assistants
summary: Proactive video assistants must decide not only what to say, but also when to speak. Existing reinforcement-learning objectives can reward timely, correct responses without accounting for response volume, thereby encouraging unnecessary or repeated emissions. We identify this failure mode in MMDuet2, whose proactive area-under-the-curve (PAUC) reward promotes timely responses but does not price the number of emissions. We show analytically that this makes additional responses weakly penalized or effectively free, systematically encouraging over-emission. We then propose an emission-aware F1 reward for interval-valued annotations, using exclusive span--emission matching to price false emissions and missed spans. Under MMDuet2's training recipe, our policy on the visual subset of OmniPro replies 2.5x less often than MMDuet2 while raising timing F1 from 0.259 to 0.396 and content-aware F1 from 0.103 to 0.154; a more conservative variant cuts replies by 82.5% and raises precision from 0.161 to 0.418. On ProactiveVideoQA, the same reward adds replies where the baseline is nearly silent, and PAUC ranks a heavily over-emitting policy second despite near-last F1, because it is insensitive to response count. Our results indicate that proactive assistants should be trained and evaluated with objectives that price emissions.

AI.tldr: 论文指出主动式视频助手中仅奖励“及时正确回答”而忽略“发言次数”的强化学习目标会导致过度发射，并提出面向发射次数的F1奖励，在多项指标上显著提升时机与内容准确率，同时大幅减少不必要回复。
AI.motivation: 主动视频助手不仅需要决定说什么，还需要决定何时说。现有强化学习目标（如MMDuet2中的PAUC）奖励及时、正确的响应，但没有对响应数量进行约束或惩罚，导致系统可能通过重复或不必要的发射获得更高奖励。论文旨在识别并修正这一失败模式，使训练和评估目标能够真正衡量“发射是否必要”。
AI.method: 作者首先分析MMDuet2的PAUC奖励机制，指出其对额外响应的惩罚很弱甚至接近于零，因此系统性鼓励过度发射。随后提出一种适用于区间标注的发射感知F1奖励，采用互斥的span–emission匹配来惩罚错误发射并奖励命中区间。实验在OmniPro视觉子集和ProactiveVideoQA上进行，并在MMDuet2训练流程下比较响应频率、时机F1、内容感知F1、精确率及PAUC排序。
AI.result: 在OmniPro视觉子集上，新方法使策略回复频率降低至MMDuet2的2.5倍更少，同时将时机F1从0.259提升到0.396，内容感知F1从0.103提升到0.154；更保守变体可减少82.5%的回复，并将精确率从0.161提升至0.418。在ProactiveVideoQA上，该奖励能在基线几乎不发言时增加必要回复，而PAUC则会错误地将严重过度发射的策略排在第二位，尽管其F1接近末位。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，主动式视频助手的训练与评估目标必须对“发射数量”进行定价，否则奖励函数会偏向过度响应。发射感知F1奖励能同时提升回复的必要性和准确性，是比单纯强调及时性的PAUC更合理的优化与评估方向。

title: SGAR: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction via Sparse Geometry-Guided Attention
summary: Feed-forward models have been very successful in 3D reconstruction with ad hoc attention designs that relate all view patches densely. However, the cost of this dense global attention grows quadratically with the number of views, preventing the model from applying to larger-scale reconstruction settings. In this paper, we argue that most dense attention computations are unnecessary from a classical structure-from-motion perspective: 3D structures stem from geometrically matching regions in 2D. We bring this principle to learning-based feed-forward reconstruction with our Sparse Geometric Attention Reconstruction (SGAR) method. In SGAR, each patch token attends to only a small set of patch tokens from other views, chosen by a lightweight learned key selection module trained to predict cross-view 3D proximity of tokens. Thus, dense global attention is replaced by much more efficient geometric-similarity-guided sparse attention. SGAR is a general method that can be applied to different feed-forward models by fine-tuning. In our experiments, we show that SGAR is the fastest among both state-of-the-art dense and sparse methods and the most accurate sparse one. It runs up to 12-times faster than dense attention at 1,000 views with stable pose accuracy where existing sparse methods fail, and shows the best performance in reconstructing more complete geometries on the same time budget.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SGAR方法，用学习到的稀疏几何注意力替代3D重建前馈模型中的密集全局注意力，使模型在大规模多视图场景中显著加速并保持/提升精度。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈3D重建模型依赖密集的跨视图注意力，计算成本随视图数二次增长，难以扩展到大规模重建；但从经典结构运动恢复角度看，真正需要匹配的是具有几何对应关系的区域，因此大量密集注意力是冗余的。
AI.method: SGAR为每个patch token仅选择少量其他视图中的相关token进行注意力计算。选择机制由一个轻量学习模块完成，该模块预测跨视图token之间的3D邻近性，从而实现几何相似度引导的稀疏注意力。该方法具有通用性，可通过微调应用到不同前馈模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，SGAR在现有密集和稀疏方法中速度最快，也是精度最高的稀疏方法。在1000视图场景下，相比密集注意力最快可实现12倍加速，并在已有稀疏方法失效时仍保持稳定的位姿精度，同时在相同时间预算下重建更完整的几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入基于几何匹配的稀疏注意力，SGAR解决了前馈式3D重建中密集全局注意力带来的可扩展性瓶颈，为大规模多视图重建提供了更高效且更准确的方案。

title: Direct3D-V3: Latent-Free Diffusion Transformers in the Native Voxel Domain
summary: Native 3D generation has largely been built around latent diffusion, with recent advances concentrating on stronger variational autoencoders (VAE) and increasingly elaborate latent representations, from vecset and triplanes to structured sparse voxels. Despite their architectural differences, these methods all share the same premise: geometry is first compressed into a latent space and only then modeled by the generator. We take a different route and propose Direct3D-V3, a latent-free diffusion transformer (DiT) framework that discards the VAE altogether and operates in the native voxel domain, directly modeling raw SDF voxel grids during both training and sampling. To make this direct voxel formulation geometrically reliable, we introduce an implicit manifold regularization over neighboring voxels to suppress non-watertight surfaces, and convert predicted SDF grids into meshes via Marching Cubes so that rendered normal losses can supervise the model directly from its predicted SDF. To improve alignment between the conditioning image and generated geometry, Direct3D-V3 also predicts the camera parameters of the conditioning image as an auxiliary task, encouraging the DiT to learn the mapping from image observations to 3D shape. This latent-free design removes the reconstruction bottleneck, brings training under an objective in the native voxel domain, and yields meshes with substantially richer local detail. The predicted camera and native SDF voxel output further make Direct3D-V3 extensible to generative reconstruction, where diffusion is interleaved with normal-guided refinement to improve alignment with the observed view while the generative prior completes unseen regions. AI.tldr: Direct3D-V3 提出一种无潜空间的扩散 Transformer 框架，直接在原生体素域中建模原始 SDF 体素网格，以替代传统依赖 VAE 压缩的 3D 生成范式，并通过流形正则、法线监督和相机参数预测提升几何可靠性与图像-3D 对齐能力。
AI.motivation: 现有原生 3D 生成方法大多建立在潜空间扩散上，需要先将几何压缩到 VAE 潜空间再生成，容易受到潜空间重建瓶颈和潜表示设计限制。作者希望跳过 VAE 和潜空间压缩，在原始 SDF 体素网格上直接建模，以获得更可靠、更细粒度的几何生成能力。
AI.method: 提出 Direct3D-V3，一个无潜空间的 DiT 框架，在训练和采样阶段直接建模原始 SDF 体素网格。为增强几何可靠性，引入邻居体素上的隐式流形正则化以抑制非水密表面；通过 Marching Cubes 将预测 SDF 网格转换为 mesh，并利用渲染法线损失对预测 SDF 进行直接监督。同时，将条件图像对应相机参数预测作为辅助任务，促使模型学习从二维观测到三维形状的映射。进一步通过法线引导精修与扩散结合，扩展到生成式重建。
AI.result: 该无潜空间设计移除了 VAE 重建瓶颈，使训练直接基于原生体素域目标，从而生成具有更丰富局部细节的网格。预测相机参数和原生 SDF 体素输出还使方法能够扩展到生成式重建，在改善观测视角对齐的同时利用生成先验补全未观测区域。
AI.conclusion: Direct3D-V3 表明原生 3D 生成可以不依赖 VAE 潜空间，而直接在 SDF 体素域中进行扩散建模。通过流形正则、法线监督和相机预测等机制，该方法能够提升几何水密性、局部细节和图像-3D 对齐能力，为无潜空间 3D 生成与生成式重建提供了新路径。

title: Plan4D: Generative Plannable 4D Worlds
summary: Most world models for future prediction prioritize aestetic quality of generated videos, but offer only weak physical grounding and limited geometric consistency over time, due to the lack of explicit 4D modeling. In this paper, we introduce plan4d, a possible next milestone towards building a generative plannable 4D world model that predicts future RGB videos together with dense 4D geometry, including depth, cameras, point clouds, and scene flow from an observed scene context and text-specified actions. Since training data with paired actions and dense 4D annotations is inherently scarce, plan4d leverages the complementary priors of foundational video generators and 3D reconstructors. Specifically, we propose a model-stitching architecture that couples Depth Anything 3 with LongCat-Video and augments it with an auxiliary DPT head for scene-flow prediction. The resulting model allows us to plan and generate complex, long-horizon, and fine-grained actions in a dynamic 3D scenes, while substantially improving both visual fidelity and geometric accuracy of the generated future videos. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that plan4d achieves state-of-the-art performance in generative 4D modeling of environmental reactions. AI.tldr: plan4d 提出了一种可规划的 4D 世界模型，能够在给定场景上下文和文本动作条件下，同时预测未来 RGB 视频与稠密 4D 几何信息（深度、相机、点云、场景流），并通过融合视频生成先验与 3D 重建先验实现高质量、高几何一致性的未来预测。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型往往更关注生成视频的视觉美感，而缺乏显式 4D 建模，导致物理基础较弱、时间上的几何一致性有限。同时，带有动作与稠密 4D 标注的配对训练数据天然稀缺，限制了真正可规划、可模拟环境反应的 4D 世界模型发展。

AI.conclusion: plan4d 是迈向可生成、可规划的 4D 世界模型的重要一步，表明通过显式联合 RGB 外观与 4D 几何预测，并有效利用视频生成与 3D 重建先验，可以在缺乏配对 4D 动作标注的条件下增强世界模型的物理一致性与几何可规划能力。

title: Deterministic Temporal Embedding for Calcium Imaging Trace Extraction
summary: Reliable extraction of calcium-dependent fluorescence traces in calcium imaging sequences requires identifying pixels whose fluorescence intensity reflects the same underlying cellular activity. We present a deterministic temporal embedding framework that maps pixel-wise fluorescence traces to a low-dimensional representation in which temporally coherent sources form spatially coherent regions. Starting from a fuzzy-neighborhood graph and spectral initialization, we optimize a class-balanced cross-entropy objective using exact sparse attraction and a deterministic particle-mesh decomposition of the dense repulsive interaction with sparse edge compensation, avoiding stochastic negative sampling. The resulting latent representation is spatially decoded into reliable source supports for trace extraction without imposing an explicit cellular shape prior. Experiments on synthetic and in vivo two-photon calcium imaging data demonstrate robust recovery of irregular and spatially touching sources together with efficient deterministic embedding optimization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种确定性的时间嵌入框架，将钙成像序列中的逐像素荧光信号映射到低维表示，使时间上相干且具有空间一致性的像素在潜在空间中聚集，从而无需显式细胞形状先验即可可靠提取钙依赖荧光信号。
AI.motivation: 在钙成像中，可靠提取钙依赖荧光信号的关键难点在于识别那些荧光强度反映同一底层细胞活动的像素。许多像素可能因空间噪声、不规则形态、相邻细胞接触或重叠而产生混淆。传统方法通常需要显式细胞形状先验或随机负采样策略，这不仅可能限制对复杂和不规则细胞源的恢复，还会引入不确定性和计算低效问题。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个确定性时间嵌入框架：首先从模糊邻域图出发，并采用谱初始化；随后使用类别平衡的交叉熵目标函数进行优化。目标函数中包含稀疏的吸引项，用于强化同一时间活动源像素之间的相似性；同时通过确定性粒子网格分解处理稠密排斥相互作用，并辅以稀疏边补偿，从而避免传统嵌入优化中常见的随机负采样。最终得到的低维潜在表示通过空间解码转化为可靠的源支持区域，用于从钙成像序列中提取荧光信号。
AI.result: 在合成数据和活体双光子钙成像数据上的实验表明，该方法能够稳健恢复不规则形态以及空间上相互接触的源，并且能够高效地进行确定性嵌入优化。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了确定性时间嵌入可以在不施加显式细胞形状先验的情况下，实现钙成像中可靠像素分组与荧光信号提取。其通过类别平衡交叉熵、稀疏吸引以及粒子网格排斥分解等机制，在准确性、鲁棒性和可重复性方面优于依赖随机负采样或强形状约束的传统方案，为复杂钙成像数据中的源识别与信号提取提供了有效工具。

title: AURA: AUdio-dRiven streaming Avatar
summary: Current audio-driven video diffusion models can synthesize realistic talking-head videos but generally require dozens of diffusion denoising steps over multi-second video chunks, making them unsuitable for streaming applications such as voice assistants and virtual avatars, where low-latency and online causal generation are required properties. AURA generates video chunk by chunk with a rolling KV cache, requiring only the audio of the current chunk to start generating, rather than a multi-second audio look-ahead like bidirectional models. It comes in two sizes: AURA 1.3B streams 576p video in real time on a single GPU (20.7 fps for a 16 Hz playback rate), making it suited to interactive avatar applications, and AURA 5B streams 720p video at 9.7 fps. Our two-stage distillation pipeline first aligns the causal student with the teacher, by training it to match the teacher's trajectories with fewer diffusion steps and a chunk-wise sliding window causal attention mask, then applies Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) with backward simulation to close the remaining quality gap. On standard talking-head benchmarks, AURA 1.3B runs 23x faster than its own bidirectional teacher and reaches a quality comparable to TalkVerse at a lower resolution, and AURA 5B matches its TalkVerse teacher at 720p while running 17x faster. To support reproducibility and further research on streaming avatar generation, we release the weights of both models along with a dataset of 30K synthetic videos and their precomputed teacher trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AURA，一种面向实时流式说话头生成的因果式音频驱动视频扩散模型，通过块级生成、滚动 KV cache 和两阶段蒸馏实现低延迟、低显存/单卡可用的视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有音频驱动视频扩散模型通常依赖双向注意力和多秒音频输入，并需要大量去噪步骤，难以满足语音助手、虚拟头像等流式应用对低延迟、在线因果生成和实时交互的要求。

title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
summary: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions. We release a family of models that define a new Pareto frontier in terms of metric accuracy, sharpness, temporal consistency, and runtime. We release code and weights at this https URL
comment: Code and weights available at this https URL

AI.tldr: Depth Pro 2 提出一个单一可扩展网络，用于在图像和视频中估计全分辨率稠密米制深度，同时提升度量精度、边界锐度和时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有单目深度估计方法通常存在权衡：多帧方法更重视时序一致性，但边界锐度不足；单帧方法更擅长保留细节和锐利边界，但时序稳定性较差。该工作旨在克服这一一致性与锐度之间的长期矛盾。
AI.method: 方法上，作者训练一个可扩展的统一网络，使其能够同时处理图像和视频输入，并直接预测原生分辨率的深度图，而不是先估计低分辨率深度再进行上采样或后处理。该模型面向稠密、米制深度估计设计，并通过统一框架兼顾单帧细节质量与跨帧时序稳定性。
AI.result: Depth Pro 2 产生的深度图在度量准确性、边界锐度和时间一致性方面均优于先前方法。作者还发布了一系列模型，在精度、锐度、时序一致性和运行效率之间定义了新的帕累托前沿，并开放了代码与权重。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过单一网络统一图像与视频深度估计，缓解了单帧清晰度与多帧一致性之间的取舍问题，为稠密米制深度估计提供了更强的实用模型系列和开源基线。

title: ScaleWorld: High-Resolution World Generation through Shared Prediction and Refinement
summary: High-resolution generation enables video world models to render fine-grained scene structures and textures, but directly generating high-resolution video incurs substantial computational and memory costs. We present ScaleWorld, a causal video model that unifies low-resolution world prediction and high-resolution refinement within a single shared backbone. By refining its own predictions, ScaleWorld produces high-resolution world videos without requiring a separate refinement model. For each video chunk, the shared backbone first completes a low-resolution prediction and then performs one-step high-resolution refinement conditioned on that prediction. To support efficient streaming generation, we maintain separate causal states with a long low-resolution history for prediction and a short high-resolution history for refinement. To address task interference during distillation, we separate specialist optimization from capability consolidation and introduce task-asymmetric on-policy distillation (TA-OPD). This procedure transfers prediction and refinement behaviors from specialized teachers into a shared student through local velocity matching under their respective sampling and history policies. {Extensive experiments demonstrate that ScaleWorld achieves high-quality world generation with improved computational and memory efficiency.

AI.tldr: ScaleWorld 是一种统一低分辨率预测与高分辨率精修的因果视频世界模型，在共享骨干网络中通过“先低分预测、再一步高分精修”的方式生成高质量高分辨率视频，同时显著提升计算和显存效率。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率生成能让视频世界模型呈现更精细的场景结构和纹理，但直接生成高分辨率视频会带来巨大的计算和内存开销，因此需要一种既能保持生成质量又能降低推理成本的统一方案。
AI.method: ScaleWorld 使用单一共享骨干网络分别完成低分辨率世界预测与高分辨率精修。对每个视频块，模型先进行低分辨率预测，再以该预测为条件进行一次高分辨率精修。为支持流式生成，模型维护两套因果状态：用于预测的长低分辨率历史和用于精修的短高分辨率历史。为缓解蒸馏中的任务干扰，作者提出任务不对称在线蒸馏 TA-OPD，先独立优化教师专家，再将预测与精修能力整合到共享学生模型中，并通过各自采样和历史策略下的局部速度匹配进行蒸馏。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ScaleWorld 能够生成高质量的高分辨率世界视频，同时在计算成本和内存占用方面优于需要更高分辨率直接生成或额外精修模型的方法。
AI.conclusion: ScaleWorld 通过共享骨干上的预测—精修统一建模、分历史长度的因果状态设计以及 TA-OPD 蒸馏策略，实现了高质量高分辨率视频世界生成与高效流式推理之间的平衡，为可扩展的视频世界模型提供了有效方案。

title: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
summary: Videos reveal how the world changes, but rarely the actions that cause those changes. Latent action learning recovers such supervision from visual transitions, yet often learns the underlying dynamics largely from scratch. We ask whether a pretrained video generator can instead provide the prior for both inverse and forward dynamics. We introduce O$^{2}$LaF, built on a simple principle: one prior, two dynamics. We initialize both models from the same pretrained video DiT and adapt them to their distinct roles: a feed-forward transition encoder with learnable action queries for inverse dynamics, and a causal, action-conditioned video generator for forward dynamics. By controlling information access and optimizing both dynamics end-to-end through a compact bottleneck, O$^{2}$LaF learns transferable actions from unlabeled videos. Across navigation and robotic manipulation, O$^{2}$LaF sets a new state of the art in few-shot action probing and enables stronger zero-shot action transfer across visual contexts and embodiments. Beyond generative video priors, we further extend our framework to predictive representation priors such as V-JEPA2, achieving competitive performance. Our findings suggest a broader paradigm for latent-action learning: repurposing pretrained video models to discover transferable actions and predict their consequences.

AI.tldr: 论文提出O²LaF，用同一个预训练视频生成模型作为先验，联合学习潜在动作的逆向动力学和正向动力学，从而从无标注视频中恢复可迁移的动作表征。
AI.motivation: 视频能呈现世界如何变化，但通常不直接给出导致变化的动作。现有潜在动作学习方法虽能从视觉转移中学习动作监督，但动力学知识多依赖从零学习，难以充分利用预训练视频模型中已有的世界动态先验。
AI.method: 作者基于“一个先验、两种动力学”的原则构建O²LaF：从同一个预训练视频DiT初始化逆向动力学和正向动力学两个模型。逆向动力学模块是前馈式转移编码器，使用可学习动作查询从视觉转移中提取动作；正向动力学模块是动作条件化的因果视频生成器，用于预测动作带来的后续视觉状态。通过控制信息访问，并用一个紧凑瓶颈端到端优化两种动力学，模型能够在无动作标签的视频中学习可迁移的潜在动作。
AI.result: 在导航和机器人操作任务中，O²LaF在少样本动作探测上取得新的最先进结果，并能在不同视觉场景和不同本体之间实现更强的零样本动作迁移。将框架扩展到V-JEPA2等预测式表征先验时，也能获得有竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: 预训练视频模型可以作为潜在动作学习的强动力学先验，用于同时发现动作和预测动作后果。论文提示了一种新范式：复用大规模视频生成或预测表征模型，从无标注视频中学习可迁移的潜在动作。

title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers. Because capabilities such as rendering requested text or composing multiple objects are inherently prompt-dependent, a natural hypothesis is that improving them requires learning complex, input-dependent transformations. To isolate how much of these gains an input-independent shift explains, we probe each RL-tuned model with a deliberately simple parameterization: a fixed set of steering vectors added to the block outputs of the frozen base model. On SD3.5-M, these vectors hold 65x fewer parameters than the RL-tuned LoRA (0.29M against 18.8M). We fit them to match the velocity predictions of public RL-tuned checkpoints, with no reward in the objective. Although the vectors are identical for every prompt, token, and sampling seed, they recover 90.0-96.3% of the reward gains of six RL-tuned image models, and 89.8% and 111.9% on two RL-tuned video models. Initialized at zero and trained with online RL, the vectors alone exceed the reward gains of weight-based RL on text rendering (OCR) and human preference (PickScore) on SD3.5-M. A constant shift thus suffices for most of the gain of policy-gradient RL post-training: without new input-dependent transformations, it steers the pretrained generator toward what it can already compute.

AI.tldr: 论文发现，经过RL后训练的扩散模型在文本渲染、物体组合和人类偏好等指标上的提升，大部分可以被一组与输入无关的固定steering vectors解释或复现，说明RL增益主要来自对预训练模型的稳定方向性偏移，而非复杂的输入依赖变换。
AI.motivation: RL post-training能显著提升扩散Transformer的视觉质量、文本渲染和组合准确性。由于这些能力本身似乎高度依赖prompt，传统直觉认为模型必须学习到复杂的输入相关变换。论文希望检验：如果只使用最简单的参数化方式，即向冻结基础模型的block outputs添加固定向量，是否能解释RL带来的大部分收益，从而区分“真正学到新能力”和“只是偏移已有能力”。
AI.method: 作者将RL微调模型的能力迁移到一组固定steering vectors中：这些向量不随prompt、token和采样seed变化，仅作为基础冻结模型block outputs的加性偏移。对于SD3.5-M，向量仅0.29M参数，远小于RL LoRA的18.8M参数。作者先让向量匹配公开RL checkpoints的velocity predictions，不使用reward目标；进一步在online RL中从零初始化这些向量，并在图像和视频RL模型上评估其reward gain恢复率。
AI.result: 这组固定steering vectors能恢复六个RL后训练图像模型90.0%-96.3%的reward gains，并在两个RL后训练视频模型上达到89.8%和111.9%。在SD3.5-M上，从零初始化并用online RL训练这些向量，在文本渲染OCR指标和PickScore人类偏好指标上甚至超过基于权重更新的RL训练效果。
AI.conclusion: 策略梯度RL后训练的大部分收益并不必然依赖于新学习的复杂输入相关变换，而可以由一个常量偏移解释：它把预训练扩散模型推向其原本已经能够计算的结果区域。该结果对理解RL post-training的本质具有启示，即RL可能主要是在已有能力空间中执行稳定的方向性steering。

title: Posterior Matching Distillation
summary: Diffusion distillation accelerates image and video generation by compressing a pretrained teacher's iterative sampling process into a few network evaluations. Distribution-based methods achieve this by matching the student's output distribution to the teacher's. This matching is often driven by reverse-KL objectives, whose mode-seeking bias favors dominant teacher modes at the expense of diversity across samples. We introduce Posterior Matching Distillation (PMD), a new member of the distribution-based distillation family that combines mode-covering posterior sampling with any-step generation. At zero population loss, PMD recovers the teacher's full posterior of clean images at each trained noise level. Its stochastic student supports any-step sampling budgets within the trained timestep grid without further training. To learn these posteriors, PMD matches exponentially reweighted averages of student samples conditioned on a fixed noisy state to corresponding teacher posterior means. Under Gaussian corruption, exponentially tilted posterior mean is a single teacher evaluation at a shifted input. We prove that, matching tilted means over an open neighborhood uniquely identifies the full posterior. PMD thus supervises the entire conditional distribution through a family of mean constraints, without any auxiliary student-score network. Experiments on SDXL and FLUX.2 [klein] 4B demonstrate that PMD achieves the best FID among 4-step methods on both models, while maintaining competitive or leading performance across prompt-alignment and perceptual-quality metrics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出后验匹配蒸馏（Posterior Matching Distillation, PMD），通过匹配教师模型在不同噪声水平下的完整条件后验分布，而非仅依赖 reverse-KL 的 mode-seeking 目标，实现少步扩散模型生成。PMD 的随机学生模型可在已训练的 timestep 网格内进行任意步数采样，并在 SDXL 与 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B 上取得 4-step 方法中最优 FID。
AI.motivation: 现有分布匹配式扩散蒸馏常使用 reverse-KL 目标，其 mode-seeking 偏差倾向于保留教师分布中的主导模式，从而牺牲跨样本多样性。论文希望构建一种新的分布匹配蒸馏方法，在保持少步生成效率的同时，恢复教师模型对干净图像的完整后验分布，实现 mode-covering 与任意步数生成的统一。
AI.method: 作者提出 PMD，将学生模型对给定噪声状态下的样本进行指数重加权平均，并匹配教师模型在相应噪声水平下的后验均值。在高斯加噪假设下，指数倾斜后的后验均值可通过一次带输入偏移的教师评估得到。论文进一步证明，在一个开邻域上匹配倾斜均值能够唯一确定整个条件后验。因此，PMD 通过一组均值约束监督学生模型的全部条件分布，而无需额外的学生 score network。学生模型为随机采样器，可在已训练 timestep 网格内支持任意步数采样，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在 SDXL 和 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B 上的实验表明，PMD 在两种模型上均取得 4-step 方法中最优的 FID，同时在提示词对齐和感知质量指标上保持有竞争力或领先的性能。
AI.conclusion: PMD 将 mode-covering 的后验采样与任意步数生成结合，为扩散模型蒸馏提供了一种新的分布匹配范式。通过匹配指数倾斜后验均值，该方法能够在不依赖辅助 score network 的情况下监督完整条件后验，从而在少步图像生成中同时改善多样性与生成质量。

title: Inhabitant: An Agent Framework for Long-Horizon Human-Scene Interaction with Spatial Control and Quantitative Feedback
summary: Recent work on human-scene interaction (HSI) generation moves from single interactions to long-horizon interaction, where a language-model agent plans and executes a sequence of interactions in a 3D scene under one instruction. However, existing agents struggle in challenging everyday scenarios (e.g., picking up a toy and throwing it into a basket) because they lack spatial control over the motion and quantitative feedback on its execution, and they often fail to complete the interaction sequence. To address these gaps, we present Inhabitant, a training-free agent framework in which the agent specifies each motion through positions, paths and poses, measures how the executed interaction deviates from its intent, and revises the control specification accordingly. For an extensive evaluation in such scenarios, we build Inhabit, a benchmark of 75 household tasks in 31 furniture layouts of an apartment, in which every task chains one to three goals on movable objects and is carried out by the whole body, excluding fingers. On Inhabit, Inhabitant completes 98.7\% of the tasks with Claude Opus 5.5, and 93.3\% and 82.7\% with Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon, respectively. Ablations confirm that without spatial control the agent fails most tasks, and without quantitative feedback its motion becomes less precise. Code is available on the project page.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Inhabitant：一种免训练的人-场景长程交互生成代理框架，通过空间化运动控制与量化反馈闭环提升日常复杂交互任务的完成率，并构建 Inhabit 基准。
AI.motivation: 现有人类-场景交互生成方法多聚焦单一动作，而长程交互需要在同一指令下规划并执行多个连续动作。传统语言模型代理在诸如“拿起玩具并扔进篮子”等日常任务中容易失败，主要因为缺乏对运动的空间控制，以及缺少对执行偏差的量化反馈，导致交互序列难以完整执行。
AI.method: 提出 Inhabitant 代理框架：代理将每个交互动作显式指定为位置、路径和姿态；执行后度量实际交互与意图之间的偏差；根据偏差修正控制规格并重新规划，从而形成空间控制与量化反馈闭环。同时构建 Inhabit 基准，包含 75 个家庭任务、31 种家具布局，每个任务串联 1 到 3 个涉及可移动物体的目标，且要求全身执行但不包括手指。
AI.result: 在 Inhabit 基准上，Inhabitant 使用 Claude Opus 5.5 可完成 98.7% 的任务；使用 Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Gemini 4 Argon 分别完成 93.3% 和 82.7%。消融实验表明，缺少空间控制会使代理在大多数任务上失败；缺少量化反馈会降低运动精度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将显式空间运动控制与量化执行反馈结合，能显著提升语言模型代理在长程人-场景交互中的规划、执行和纠错能力，为复杂日常交互生成提供了有效框架与评测基准。

title: MAWAM: A Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation
summary: Every move in a robot team changes the world in which its teammates must act. Coordinated manipulation therefore calls for predicting the team's actions together with the physical future they jointly create. We introduce MAWAM, a multi-agent world-action model that jointly generates each robot's future views and executable action chunks in a single sample. Built from a pretrained single-robot world-action backbone, MAWAM jointly denoises all robots' action and future-view tokens through cross-agent attention, while preserving a separate control interface for each robot. MAWAM achieves the highest success on all three real-robot tasks (laundry-bag collection, bath-towel folding, and umbrella handover), with 67.8% mean success, 18.9 percentage points above MA-VLA trained on the same demonstrations and cameras. In simulation, MAWAM reaches 90.3% mean success on eight tasks with teams of up to four arms. Ablations show that cross-agent attention and team-stage future-video supervision both improve coordinated control: without attention, a four-arm relay falls from 95.0% to 39.0%, and without this supervision, Place Food falls from 78.0% to 47.0%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MAWAM，一种多智能体世界动作模型，使机器人团队能联合预测队友动作与共同演化后的物理未来，并同步生成每个机器人的未来视图和可执行动作，显著提升多机器人协作操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 在多机器人协作操纵中，每个机器人的动作都会改变其他机器人所处环境，因此协调控制不仅要求预测单个动作，还要求联合预测团队动作及其共同造成的未来物理状态。现有方法往往将动作预测与未来预测分离，难以充分建模团队交互和协作依赖。
AI.method: 作者提出MAWAM，该模型基于预训练的单机器人世界动作骨干扩展得到。MAWAM在统一采样过程中联合生成所有机器人的未来视图令牌和可执行动作块，通过跨智能体注意力对所有机器人的动作与未来视图进行联合去噪，同时保留每个机器人独立的控制接口。训练中还使用团队阶段未来视频监督，使模型学习协作过程中各阶段的未来变化。
AI.result: 在三项真实机器人任务中，MAWAM均取得最高成功率，平均成功率为67.8%，比使用相同示范和相机训练的MA-VLA高18.9个百分点。在仿真环境中，面向最多4个机械臂的多机器人任务，MAWAM在8个任务上达到90.3%平均成功率。消融实验显示，跨智能体注意力和团队阶段未来视频监督均显著有益：去掉注意力后，4臂接力任务成功率从95.0%降至39.0%；去掉未来视频监督后，Place Food任务成功率从78.0%降至47.0%。
AI.conclusion: MAWAM表明，在多机器人协作操纵中，联合建模团队动作与共同物理未来是提升协调能力的重要路径。通过跨智能体注意力和未来视图监督，模型能够在真实与仿真多机器人任务中实现更强、更稳健的协同控制。

title: GEMS: Generation and Experience Memory for Subgoal-Guided Long-Horizon World Model Planning
summary: Visual world models enable effective short-horizon goal-conditioned planning, such as reaching nearby targets and pushing objects over short distances, by predicting candidate action outcomes and comparing their representations with a goal representation. However, extending this approach to long-horizon tasks is challenging: prediction errors accumulate over extended rollouts, while latent-space similarity to distant goals provides limited guidance for ranking candidate outcomes. Existing methods address these limitations by introducing intermediate subgoals, either generated by learned models or selected from experience memory. Generated subgoals can contain hallucinations or be inaccurate in aspects such as object positions and timing. Memory-based approaches are constrained by experience coverage and may lack precise guidance for selecting appropriate intermediate states from stored observations. We introduce GEMS, which generates temporally structured subgoals to guide action search and state selection from Latent Experience Memory (LEM). A distance gate determines whether predicted outcomes are evaluated against the generated subgoal or the selected memory state. Experiments across six tasks and task suites spanning manipulation, navigation, and reaching demonstrate the effectiveness of GEMS for long-horizon planning. GEMS outperforms state-of-the-art world-model planning baselines across different manipulation settings, achieving success rates of 92.8% on Cube, 68.4% on Push-T, and 54.1% on Meta-World. It improves over the strongest evaluated baseline on these tasks by 24.0, 7.3, and 22.2 percentage points, respectively. These results demonstrate that generated subgoals and experience memory can jointly strengthen long-horizon planning with a frozen world model.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GEMS，通过生成具有时间结构的子目标并结合潜在经验记忆选择中间状态，缓解世界模型在长时域规划中的误差累积与目标引导不足问题。在操作、导航和到达任务上显著优于基线，其中 Cube、Push-T 和 Meta-World 成功率分别达到 92.8%、68.4% 和 54.1%。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型适合短时域目标条件规划，但扩展到长时域任务时面临两个核心困难：一是连续预测动作结果会产生累积误差，二是候选动作与远距离目标在潜在空间中的相似度往往难以有效区分优劣。现有方法通常引入中间子目标来分解任务，但由模型生成的子目标可能出现幻觉或在物体位置、时序等方面不准确；基于经验记忆的方法则受限于经验覆盖范围，且难以从历史观测中稳定选择合适中间状态。
AI.method: 提出 GEMS：首先由世界模型生成具有时间结构的子目标，用于指导动作搜索；同时利用潜在经验记忆（Latent Experience Memory, LEM）为不同距离或情境下的候选状态选择更合适的中间目标。方法中引入距离门控机制，根据候选预测结果与目标的距离关系，决定是采用生成子目标还是记忆中的经验状态进行评估，从而结合生成式规划与经验引导。该框架基于冻结的世界模型运行，无需重新训练世界模型本身。
AI.result: 在六个任务及任务套件上验证了 GEMS 的有效性，覆盖操作、导航和到达等长时域规划任务。相比最先进的世界模型规划基线，GEMS 在不同操作设置下取得更高成功率：Cube 为 92.8%，Push-T 为 68.4%，Meta-World 为 54.1%。相对于评估中最强的基线，三个任务分别提升 24.0、7.3 和 22.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 生成式子目标与经验记忆可以互补，共同提升冻结世界模型的长时域规划能力。GEMS 通过时间结构化的子目标生成、经验记忆选择以及距离门控机制，降低了长程预测误差和稀疏目标引导带来的影响，为基于世界模型的长时域智能体规划提供了有效方案。

title: Bridging vision-language reasoning and learned control for legged navigation in the wild
summary: Autonomous navigation in diverse real-world environments remains one of the greatest challenges in robotics. It demands both robust low-level motion control to handle diverse terrain and high-level reasoning to interpret environmental cues. We present ROAM (Robust Open-world Autonomous Mobility), a system that enables legged robots to perform kilometer-scale navigation in complex alpine and urban settings. ROAM combines the world knowledge of a Vision-Language Model (VLM), pre-trained on internet-scale data, with robust locomotion and local planning policies learned in simulation via reinforcement learning (RL). The VLM provides common-sense reasoning and semantic interpretation of the scene, assessing risks, interpreting signs, and producing semantic labels with associated navigation costs. An open-vocabulary segmentation module converts these labels into a dense, real-time risk map, which conditions two pre-trained RL policies responsible for agile locomotion and local navigation, effectively coupling high-level VLM reasoning with low-level physical control. Real-world experiments showed the system's ability to autonomously navigate a wide range of complex real-world environments. The robot completes kilometer-long hikes with minimal intervention, interprets signs to avoid danger, and evaluates its environment to identify safe areas on which to step. This work represents a step toward the reliable deployment of systems in unstructured environments. However, it also underscores the challenges that remain in VLM reliability and spatial reasoning, indicating that foundational models are a crucial component but not yet a complete solution for navigation in the wild.

AI.tldr: ROAM是一种面向腿足机器人的开放世界自主导航系统，将视觉-语言模型（VLM）的常识与语义理解能力与强化学习训练得到的运动控制和局部规划策略结合，实现复杂山地与城市环境中公里级自主导航。
AI.motivation: 真实世界中的自主导航要求机器人同时具备对复杂地形的鲁棒底层运动控制能力，以及对环境线索的高级推理和语义理解能力。现有方法在开放、非结构化场景中仍难以稳定完成长距离、安全、可解释的自主移动。
AI.method: 该方法由VLM、开放词汇分割模块和两个RL策略组成。VLM负责场景语义解释、风险判断、路标理解，并输出带导航代价的语义标签；开放词汇分割模块将这些标签转化为实时稠密风险地图；该风险地图用于条件化预训练的敏捷 locomotion 与局部导航策略，从而把高层语义推理与底层物理控制耦合起来。
AI.result: 真实机器人实验表明，ROAM能够在多种复杂实际环境中自主导航，完成公里级徒步，并在最少人工干预下识别危险区域、解读路标、评估可安全踩踏的区域。
AI.conclusion: ROAM证明了基础VLM与仿真RL运动策略结合在开放世界腿足机器人导航中的可行性，是向非结构化环境可靠部署迈出的一步。但实验也表明VLM在可靠性和空间推理方面仍存在不足，基础模型是重要组成部分，但尚不足以完全解决野外导航问题。

title: Stereo Visual Odometry with In-the-Loop Geometric Feed-Forward Models Towards Dense Metric Mapping
summary: We present a stereo visual odometry (SVO) framework that integrates geometric feed-forward models (GFMs) for dense depth prediction with factor-graph-based visual odometry to achieve accurate localisation and dense metric mapping. Our key idea is to exploit sparse but reliable metric geometry estimated from stereo and temporal multi-view observations to calibrate dense GFM predictions, while retaining the robustness and efficiency of model-based SVO. Rather than directly conditioning the GFM on potentially noisy stereo depth, optimised 3D landmarks are used to jointly estimate a scale-shift transformation over all keyframes within each local submap, yielding metrically consistent dense depth predictions. To balance accuracy and computational efficiency, we introduce a hierarchical factor-graph architecture. At the local level, sliding-window optimisation estimates high-frequency camera poses and multi-view-refined 3D landmarks. Dense predictions are generated only for selected keyframes and registered within each submap using SE(3) Generalised ICP. Consecutive submaps are further aligned in Sim(3) using their shared geometry, allowing residual scale inconsistencies to be corrected. These intra- and inter-submap constraints are incorporated into a global factor graph to produce a consistent trajectory and dense metric reconstruction. Extensive experiments on public and in-house datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive odometry accuracy against geometric and learning-based baselines while providing accurate dense metric reconstruction and improved robustness to failures in learned depth prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种立体视觉里程计框架，将几何前馈模型生成的稠密深度预测与因子图优化相结合，通过稀疏可靠的立体与多视图几何约束校准稠度与尺度，实现高精度局部定位和稠密度量建图。
AI.motivation: 学习式稠密深度模型虽具有效率与泛化优势，但其度量尺度和局部一致性易受误差影响；传统基于几何的立体视觉里程计则存在稠密重建受限等问题。因此需要在保持模型化方法鲁棒性与效率的同时，提升稠密度量重建的准确性与一致性。
AI.method: 该方法利用立体观测和时序多视图几何优化得到的稀疏三维路标点，而非直接用噪声较大的立体深度，对几何前馈模型进行尺度-偏移校准。框架采用分层因子图结构：局部滑动窗口内估计高频相机位姿并优化多视图三维路标点；仅对关键帧生成稠密深度，并通过SE(3) Generalized ICP在子地图内配准；相邻子地图间利用共享几何在Sim(3)空间对齐，修正残余尺度不一致。所有约束最终汇入全局因子图，联合优化轨迹与稠密度量重建。
AI.result: 在公开数据集和自建数据集上的实验表明，该框架在里程计精度上可与几何方法和学习方法基线相比，同时提供更准确的稠密度量重建，并增强了对学习型深度预测失效情况的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将稀疏几何估计作为可信约束来校准稠密前馈深度预测，并在分层因子图中联合优化位姿、路标、子地图与全局尺度，本文方法能够兼顾视觉里程计的精度、效率与稠密度量建图的一致性，为立体视觉中的鲁棒定位与重建提供了有效框架。

title: Trajectory-Calibrated Merging of Embodied Policies
summary: Robot foundation models are increasingly adapted into task specialists to expand their embodied capabilities. Yet these capabilities remain fragmented across separate policies, and existing model-merging methods do not reliably preserve them during closed-loop execution: parameter-space alignment provides only an indirect proxy for behavior, while regression may fail to preserve behavior at states not covered by its calibration inputs. We present Trajectory-Calibrated Regression (TCR), an execution-aware, gradient-free framework that consolidates robot specialists into a single policy. Across two complementary timescales, TCR collects calibration inputs from expert rollouts spanning different stages of task execution and from intermediate states within iterative action generation. To account for representation shifts introduced by merging, TCR recomputes each block's input through the already merged blocks. It then uses each expert's computation within the block to form module inputs and fits merged weights to match the experts' linear outputs. A two-pass calibration procedure further refines the merged policy using separate rollout caches while retaining the frozen specialists as teachers. The resulting model preserves the original inference graph and requires neither expert routing nor additional gradient training. On LIBERO, TCR merges four $\pi_{0.5}$ specialists and achieves 77.83% success across 1,200 evaluation episodes, outperforming FeatCal, RegMean, and direct weight averaging by 9.50, 24.17, and 33.00 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Trajectory-Calibrated Regression（TCR），一种无需梯度的执行感知模型合并框架，用于将多个机器人专家策略合并为单一策略，以提升闭环执行中的行为保持能力。
AI.motivation: 机器人基础模型常被适配为不同任务的专家策略，但这些能力分散在独立策略中，难以统一部署。现有模型合并方法在机器人闭环执行中不可靠：参数空间对齐只是行为的间接代理，而普通回归可能无法覆盖真实执行中遇到的状态，从而造成行为退化。
AI.method: TCR 在两个互补时间尺度上收集校准输入：一是来自专家 rollout 的不同任务阶段状态，二是迭代动作生成过程中的中间状态。为处理合并带来的表示偏移，TCR 先通过已合并模块重新计算每个 block 的输入，再利用各专家在该 block 中的计算构造模块输入，并拟合合并权重以匹配专家的线性输出。随后通过两遍校准流程，利用独立 rollout 缓存进一步优化合并策略，同时保留冻结专家作为教师。该方法保持原始推理图，不需要专家路由或额外梯度训练。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，TCR 将四个 π0.5 专家策略合并为单一策略，在 1,200 个评测 episode 中达到 77.83% 成功率。相比 FeatCal、RegMean 和直接权重平均，分别提升 9.50、24.17 和 33.00 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: TCR 表明，基于轨迹和闭环执行状态校准的回归式模型合并，比单纯依赖参数对齐或离线状态覆盖的方法更适合机器人策略整合。它能够在无需梯度训练和专家路由的情况下，将多个任务专家压缩为单一部署模型，并更稳定地保留原始专家能力。

title: CauSyncVLA: Causal Latent World Modeling for Asynchronous Robot Control
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies must react while visual inference is still running. Overlapping computation and execution reduces waiting, yet leaves perceptual memory stale and successive action chunks disconnected. We present CauSyncVLA, an asynchronous dual-system controller that aligns perceptual-memory prediction and trajectory correction with actual robot execution. Rather than forecasting pixels or physical states, a Causal Latent World Model predicts current perceptual memory from delayed visual anchors and executed state-action history, supervised through action-sensitive distillation to retain the frozen expert's control response. Conditioned on this updated memory, Predictive Flow Warm-Starting (PFWS) aligns the unexecuted action horizon for single-step flow correction without extra training. On LIBERO-10, CauSyncVLA reaches 93.8% success at 5.04$\times$ inference throughput, improving closed-loop robustness and robot motion smoothness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CauSyncVLA，一种用于视觉-语言-动作策略的异步双系统控制器，通过因果潜世界模型补偿延迟感知记忆，并以预测流热启动修正未执行动作轨迹，从而在减少等待时间的同时提升闭环鲁棒性和动作流畅性；在LIBERO-10上取得93.8%成功率，推理吞吐提升5.04倍。
AI.motivation: 在机器人操作中，视觉推理与动作执行往往需要重叠计算以降低延迟，但感知输入会因推理延迟而变得陈旧，连续动作片段也容易缺乏衔接。现有方法若只预测像素或物理状态，难以直接保持专家策略对动作变化的敏感响应，因此需要一种与机器人实际执行状态同步的感知记忆预测和轨迹校正机制。
AI.method: 作者提出CauSyncVLA异步双系统控制器，包含两个关键部分：第一，因果潜世界模型从延迟视觉锚点和已执行状态-动作历史中预测当前感知记忆，并通过动作敏感蒸馏保留冻结专家策略的控制响应；第二，基于更新后的感知记忆，预测流热启动对未执行动作区间进行对齐，实现单步流校正而无需额外训练。该方法将感知记忆预测与轨迹修正统一到实际执行过程中，使异步计算仍保持闭环一致性。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-10基准上，CauSyncVLA达到93.8%任务成功率，推理吞吐提升至5.04倍。实验表明该方法在降低计算等待的同时改善了闭环鲁棒性，并使机器人运动更加平滑。
AI.conclusion: CauSyncVLA通过将延迟视觉信息校正为当前感知记忆，并对未执行动作轨迹进行流式热启动修正，有效缓解了异步执行中感知陈旧与动作不连贯的问题。该方法无需额外训练专家策略即可提升吞吐与鲁棒性，表明对执行状态同步的感知-动作对齐是改进视觉-语言-动作机器人策略的有效方向。

title: Multiple-Camera Tracking of Rigid Objects
summary: In this paper we describe a method for tracking rigid objects using one or several cameras. The tracking process consists of aligning a 3-D model representation of an object with image contours by measuring and minimizing the image error between predicted model points and image contours. The tracker behaves like a visual servo loop where the internal and external camera parameters are updated at each new image acquisition. We study in detail the Jacobian matrix associated with this minimization process in the presence of both point-to-point and point-to-contour matches. We establish the minimal number of matches that are needed as well as the singular configurations leading to a rank-defficient Jacobian matrix. We find a mathematical link between the point-to-point and point-to-contour cases. Based on this link we show that the latter has the same kind of singularities than the former. Moreover, we study multiple camera configurations which optimize the robustness of the method in the presence of single-camera singularities, bad, noisy, or missing data. Extensive experiments done with a complex ship part and with up to three cameras validate the method. In particular we show that the tracker may well be used as a camera calibration procedure.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于相机图像轮廓与三维模型对齐的刚体目标跟踪方法，深入分析了点对点和点到轮廓匹配下的雅可比矩阵、最小匹配数与奇异构型，并通过多相机配置提升鲁棒性；实验表明该方法可用于跟踪和相机标定。
AI.motivation: 针对刚体目标视觉跟踪中模型预测点与图像轮廓误差最小化过程的可观测性、数值稳定性和奇异性问题，明确所需匹配数量与失败构型，并提高在噪声、数据缺失或单相机奇异情况下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 使用单个或多个相机，将三维模型投影到图像空间，并与图像轮廓对齐；通过测量并最小化预测模型点与轮廓之间的图像误差实现跟踪。将该过程建模为视觉伺服环，每次获取新图像时更新相机内参和外参。重点推导并分析点对点和点到轮廓匹配对应的雅可比矩阵，确定最小匹配数量、秩亏奇异构型，并建立两种匹配方式之间的数学联系；进一步研究多相机配置以优化鲁棒性。
AI.result: 建立了点到点和点到轮廓匹配之间的数学联系，证明后者具有与前者相同类型的奇异构型；给出了所需最小匹配数及导致雅可比矩阵秩亏的奇异情况；多相机配置可显著提升跟踪鲁棒性。复杂船体部件实验和最多三个相机的结果验证了方法有效性，并表明该跟踪器也可用作相机标定程序。
AI.conclusion: 基于三维模型与图像轮廓误差最小化的刚体目标跟踪方法具有清晰的几何与微分约束基础；通过分析雅可比矩阵、最小匹配条件和奇异构型，并引入多相机观测，可在复杂、噪声或缺失数据条件下实现稳健跟踪与自标定。

title: Learning What Actions Change: Action Effect Matching for Dynamics-Faithful World Models
summary: World models aim to predict environment dynamics under actions, enabling the prediction of action consequences without executing them in the real world. Yet despite producing increasingly realistic videos, current world models often fail to capture how small action changes affect future observations. This limits their use in tasks such as robotic policy evaluation and model-based planning, where nearly identical actions can lead to qualitatively different outcomes. To address this, we propose AFFECT, an auxiliary training objective for learning the distribution of visual changes induced by action perturbations. Specifically, we inject temporally correlated noise into the actions of a policy trained on task-agnostic human teleoperation. We then train the world model so that its generated videos respond to this noise as the recorded videos do, without requiring repeated executions from the same initial state. Across OGBench simulation and real-world DROID and ALOHA-2 setups, AFFECT makes world-model rollouts more faithful to real outcomes. On DROID, the Pearson correlation between policy success rates in the world model and on the real robot rises from 0.47 to 0.79, alongside up to 23% lower FVD. These gains carry over to planning, where selecting actions with AFFECT-trained world models improves task success by up to 8.3%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AFFECT，一种通过注入时间相关动作噪声来训练世界模型感知“微小动作扰动导致视觉差异”的辅助目标，显著提升机器人策略评估与模型规划中的预测保真度和成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型虽能生成逼真视频，却难以捕捉细微动作变化对未来观测的影响，限制了其在机器人策略评估、基于模型规划等需要区分近似动作不同后果的任务中的应用。
AI.method: AFFECT利用无任务人类遥操作数据中训练的策略，在其动作上注入具有时间相关性的噪声，并训练世界模型使其生成视频对噪声变化的响应与真实录像一致，从而在不要求同一初始状态重复执行的情况下学习动作扰动引起的视觉变化分布。
AI.result: 在OGBench仿真及真实DROID、ALOHA-2环境中，AFFECT使世界模型推演更贴近真实结果。DROID上，世界模型内策略成功率与真实机器人成功率的相关系数从0.47升至0.79，FVD最多降低23%；在规划中，使用AFFECT训练的世界模型选择动作可将任务成功率最多提升8.3%。
AI.conclusion: AFFECT通过显式建模动作扰动对视觉未来变化的影响，提高了世界模型对因果细微动作差异的敏感性，为机器人策略评估和基于模型的规划提供了更可靠的预测基础。

title: UniVEP: Unifying Velocity and Endpoint Prediction for Robot Manipulation
summary: Flow-matching robot policies usually use one prediction target throughout action generation, even though recovering actions from noise and polishing nearly clean actions bring different challenges. We systematically compare velocity prediction (V), endpoint prediction (X), and velocity-weighted endpoint prediction (X--V) across multiple robot policies, benchmarks, and inference budgets. On StarVLA and LiLa-WAM, X--V works best for few-step generation, while V gains more from iterative refinement. We further uncover their complementary strengths across noise levels: clean actions have concentrated covariance spectra, endpoint predictions stay more stable under high noise, and velocity predictions offer more accurate corrections near clean actions. Inspired by these findings, we introduce UniVEP, which learns both prediction targets together with consistency supervision and switches from endpoint recovery to velocity refinement as noise drops. Each step only needs one network run, and joint training also boosts single-step endpoint generation. Tests on simulated and real-world manipulation show better success rates and efficiency. On RoboTwin, UniVEP hits 61.36% success with one StarVLA run, beating the best single-target baseline at sixteen runs (59.96%). With LiLa-WAM, two runs outperform the best sixteen-step single-target baseline and cut inference latency by 77.1%.

AI.tldr: 本文发现流匹配机器人策略中不同噪声水平下速度预测与端点预测具有互补优势，并提出 UniVEP：通过一致性监督联合学习两种预测目标，并随噪声降低从端点恢复切换到速度精修，从而以更少推理步数取得更高成功率和更低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配机器人策略在动作生成过程中通常固定使用同一预测目标，但“从噪声中恢复动作”和“对接近干净的动作进行精细修正”面临不同挑战。作者希望系统比较不同预测目标在不同推理预算和噪声水平下的表现，并设计更高效的生成策略。
AI.method: 作者比较速度预测、端点预测以及速度加权端点预测在多种机器人策略、基准和推理预算下的表现，发现端点预测在高噪声下更稳定，速度预测在接近干净动作时修正更准确。基于此，提出 UniVEP，联合学习两种预测目标并施加一致性监督；推理时根据噪声水平从端点恢复切换到速度精修，每一步只需一次网络前向。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实操控任务中，UniVEP 提升了成功率并降低推理开销。在 RoboTwin 上，UniVEP 用一次 StarVLA 前向取得 61.36% 成功率，优于最佳单目标基线 16 次前向的 59.96%；使用 LiLa-WAM 时，2 次前向超过最佳 16 步单目标基线，推理延迟降低 77.1%。
AI.conclusion: 不同预测目标在动作生成的不同阶段具有互补性；通过联合训练和噪声阶段感知的预测切换，可以在不增加单次网络运行成本的情况下显著提升流匹配机器人策略的少步生成效率与任务性能。

title: A Practical Proprioceptive Data Collection Utility for the Unitree GO1
summary: The Unitree Go1 is a widely used platform for legged robotics research, yet collecting proprioceptive data from it is unnecessarily difficult: the Unitree SDK is sparsely documented, and ROS1 (Robot Operating System), the Go1's native middleware, is fully deprecated. We present an open-source graphical utility that enables researchers to reliably record proprioceptive data from the Go1, including joint states, IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) readings, foot force sensor data, and gyroscope measurements, without requiring ROS expertise. The tool provides a simple GUI (Graphical User Interface) for starting, stopping, and labeling recordings in real time. The contribution of this paper is the collection utility. We characterize the acquisition quality of 51 recordings collected with it, including the achieved sampling rate and repeated samples. As a secondary, deliberately modest check that the data is useful, we train a terrain classifier on it. The results are weak: a Temporal Convolutional Network reaches about 38% accuracy on held-out recordings across ten terrain classes (10% would be chance), and a window-level split that ignores recording boundaries inflates the same measurement to about 99%. We report this as a demonstration that the logged signals carry terrain information, not as a competitive classifier. The utility is designed to lower the barrier to collecting Go1 proprioceptive data without ROS.

AI.tldr: 该摘要提出一个面向 Unitree Go1 的开源图形化工具，用于在无需 ROS 专业知识的条件下稳定采集本体感觉数据，并通过采样质量分析和弱地形分类实验验证数据的可用性。
AI.motivation: Unitree Go1 是腿部机器人研究中的常用平台，但其本体感觉数据采集流程复杂：官方 SDK 文档不足，且其原生中间件 ROS1 已被弃用，导致研究人员在录制关节状态、IMU、足底力传感器和陀螺仪等数据时面临较高门槛。该工作旨在降低 Go1 数据采集难度。
AI.method: 作者开发并提供一个开源 GUI 工具，支持实时开始、停止和标注录制，用于从 Go1 采集本体感觉信号，包括关节状态、IMU 读数、足底力传感器数据和陀螺仪测量。为评估工具效果，作者对 51 次录制数据进行采集质量分析，例如采样率和重复样本情况。作为次要且刻意保守的数据可用性验证，作者基于这些日志训练地形分类器，使用 Temporal Convolutional Network 对十类地形进行识别，并比较按录制留出的划分方式与忽略录制边界的窗口级划分方式。
AI.result: 所采集的 51 次录制数据具有一定质量基础。地形分类结果显示，在按录制留出的设定下，TCN 在十类地形上的准确率约为 38%，高于随机基线 10%；但如果采用窗口级划分且忽略不同录制之间的边界，准确率被夸大至约 99%，说明存在数据泄漏或划分不当带来的乐观偏差。作者强调该结果仅用于说明日志信号包含地形相关信息，而非提出竞争性分类模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作的核心贡献是一个降低 Unitree Go1 本体感觉数据采集门槛的开源工具。实验表明该工具能够稳定采集包含地形信息的机器人信号，但地形分类器本身性能有限，主要作为数据可用性的辅助验证，而非完整的数据集或强算法贡献。

title: TacInno: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models the Contact Dynamics Beyond Vision and Action
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently been equipped with tactile sensing to perceive visually subtle contact events in contact-rich manipulation. However, adding tactile input yields inconsistent gains, and some visuo-tactile VLA models rely little on tactile input, because much of the tactile change, such as the gel deformation during gripper closure, is predictable from visual observations and executed actions. To address this problem, we introduce TacInno, which isolates the contact dynamics that vision and executed actions cannot explain, termed tactile innovation, and uses tactile innovation only as a training target. Specifically, the TacInno tokenizer, conditioned on visual observations and executed actions, compresses the future tactile change into a discrete code, and the policy, TacInno-VLA, learns to predict the code, adding no module for the code at deployment. TacInno-VLA achieves average success rates of 87.5% across six simulation tasks and 70.5% across four real-world tasks, outperforming the strongest visuo-tactile baseline by 10.7 and 9.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies validate the contributions of visual and action conditioning, multi-frame encoding, and auxiliary code prediction. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile innovation as a supervision signal for contact-rich manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TacInno，将“触觉创新”（即无法被视觉观测和已执行动作解释的触觉变化）作为训练监督信号，通过条件离散编码辅助 VLA 策略学习，在不需要部署额外模块的情况下显著提升接触密集型操作性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态视觉-语言-动作模型引入触觉后收益不稳定，部分模型对触觉利用不足，原因是许多触觉变化可由视觉信息和动作执行预测出来，真正关键的、难以预测的接触动态未被显式建模。
AI.method: 作者设计 TacInno tokenizer，以视觉观测和已执行动作作为条件，将未来触觉变化压缩为离散码；策略 TacInno-VLA 学习预测该离散码作为辅助监督目标。部署时不引入额外触觉码模块，仅依靠原有策略完成动作生成。消融实验进一步验证视觉-动作条件化、多帧编码和辅助码预测的作用。
AI.result: TacInno-VLA 在六个仿真任务上达到平均 87.5% 的成功率，在四个真实世界任务上达到 70.5%，分别优于最强视触觉基线 10.7 和 9.0 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将触觉创新作为监督信号能够有效引导 VLA 模型关注真正不可预测的接触动态，从而提升接触密集型操作性能，说明显式建模“残差触觉信息”比简单拼接多模态输入更具针对性。

title: Awaken-HI: Scaling Humanoid Intelligence with Whole-Body Human Experience
summary: A central goal of humanoid robotics is for robots to perform the everyday work people do in homes and workplaces. Existing egocentric video datasets cover many of these activities but provide little synchronized whole-body motion data for learning loco-manipulation at scale. We build Awaken-Human, which pairs approximately 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body human motion and covers more than 100 skills. Building on this, we also introduce Awaken-HI (Humanoid Intelligence), a vision-language-action model for humanoid loco-manipulation that jointly predicts original human motion and retargeted robot actions through a shared action expert. We show that loco-manipulation skills transfer more effectively from people to humanoids when human trajectories directly supervise the shared action expert. Increasing human pretraining data reduces held-out robot action prediction error according to an empirical scaling law and raises the mean success rate on downstream real-robot tasks. After full-corpus pretraining and T800 adaptation, Awaken-HI achieves a mean success rate of 93.75% across eight individual tasks and outperforms GR00T N1.7 and $\pi_{0.5}$ in both individual and long-horizon evaluations. The same policy generalizes to objects unseen during robot post-training and to new pairings of familiar objects and destinations.

AI.tldr: 论文构建大规模人形机器人第一视角视频与全身运动配对数据集 Awaken-Human，并提出视觉-语言-动作模型 Awaken-HI，用于人形机器人 loco-manipulation（移动操作）学习；通过共享 action expert 同时预测人类原始运动和机器人重定向动作，并在真实机器人任务上取得较高成功率与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人需要学习人类在家庭和职场中的日常全身移动操作技能，但现有第一视角视频数据集虽然覆盖广泛活动，却缺少大规模、同步的全身人体运动数据，难以直接支撑人形机器人 loco-manipulation 的技能学习与跨具身迁移。
AI.method: 作者构建 Awaken-Human 数据集，将约 5 万小时第一视角立体视频与同步全身人体运动配对，覆盖超过 100 项技能。在此基础上提出 Awaken-HI，一种用于人形机器人移动操作的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过共享 action expert 联合预测原始人类运动与重定向后的机器人动作，并用人类轨迹直接监督共享动作专家，以促进从人到机器人的技能迁移。
AI.result: 实验显示，人类轨迹对共享 action expert 的直接监督能更有效地将移动操作技能迁移到人形机器人；扩大人类预训练数据可按经验 scaling law 降低留出机器人动作预测误差，并提升真实机器人下游任务平均成功率。经过全量语料预训练和 T800 适配后，Awaken-HI 在 8 个独立任务上的平均成功率达到 93.75%，并在单任务与长时序评测中优于 GR00T N1.7 和 π0.5；该策略还能泛化到机器人后训练阶段未见过的物体，以及熟悉物体与目的地的新组合。
AI.conclusion: 同步大规模人类全身运动与第一视角视频数据，结合联合预测人类运动和机器人动作的共享 action expert，可显著提升人形机器人移动操作学习的性能、数据缩放效果与泛化能力，为从人类视频和运动数据到机器人策略的高效迁移提供了可行路径。

title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. The tasks form three views: Mind tests decisions based on past observations, Act tests precise and timely execution, and Mind2Act combines both in closed-loop tasks where action outcomes guide later decisions. Comparing the three views shows whether a system lacks a capability or fails to compose capabilities it already has. A diagnosis harness further attributes the failed episodes of three representative systems to Mind, Act, or their composition and summarizes each system in a profile card. Our evaluation of multimodal agents, vision-language-action models (VLAs), and world-action models (WAMs) shows that competence in a single view does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks. Even the strongest agent succeeds in 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes but in only 12.0% of Mind2Act episodes. The strongest agent retains task state but struggles with sustained contact, whereas end-to-end policies execute practiced motions but retain little task state. These findings point to composing reasoning and execution through environmental feedback as the main open problem.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Mind2Act World：一个用于诊断具身智能系统中“历史推理”“实时执行”以及“通过环境反馈进行组合能力”的仿真操作任务基准。实验表明，即使在单一能力视图上表现较强的系统，在需要闭环组合推理与执行的任务上成功率仍显著下降，说明当前主要瓶颈在于将推理与执行通过环境反馈稳定组合起来。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能基准通常把推理与执行混在同一条任务中评估，或者分别评估但不考察二者组合，因此难以判断失败究竟来自认知推理不足、物理执行不准，还是来自推理与执行之间缺乏有效闭环衔接。为了更准确地诊断具身智能系统的真实短板，需要一个能够分离并对照三种能力视图的基准。
AI.method: 论文构建 Mind2Act World，包含来自五个真实应用域的 30 个仿真操作任务；每个任务设置 3 个难度等级和 2 种场景设定（Clean 与 Random），共形成 180 个配置。任务被组织为三种视图：Mind 测试基于历史观察的决策能力；Act 测试精确且及时地执行物理动作的能力；Mind2Act 测试在闭环任务中将二者结合的能力，即根据动作结果影响后续决策。作者进一步设计诊断框架，将多模态智能体、视觉—语言—动作模型（VLA）和世界—动作模型（WAM）等代表系统的失败 episode 归因到 Mind、Act 或组合阶段，并为每个系统生成 profile card。
AI.result: 实验显示，单一视图上的能力并不能有效迁移到 Mind2Act 任务。最强智能体在 Mind 任务上的成功率为 52.7%，在 Act 任务上为 39.0%，但在需要组合二者闭环的 Mind2Act 任务上仅达到 12.0%。进一步诊断发现，智能体通常能较好保留任务状态，但在持续接触类操作中表现不佳；端到端策略能够执行训练过或熟悉化的动作，却难以保持任务状态记忆。
AI.conclusion: Mind2Act World 能够更细致地区分具身智能失败来源，并揭示当前系统的主要开放问题并非单纯推理或单纯执行，而是如何通过环境反馈把认知推理与物理执行可靠组合成闭环能力。该工作为评估、诊断和改进下一代具身智能系统提供了结构化基准。

title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
summary: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向前沿多模态语言机器人代理的动作级分析框架 AgentRoboCritic，通过“意图—动作—评判”的方式评估代理在直接低级控制中的成功与失败原因，并发布大规模动作标注数据集与开源批评模型。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人操作基准通常只报告整段任务的 episode-level 成功率，无法解释前沿语言代理具体如何成功、在哪些动作环节失败，也难以区分语义理解、动作规划、物理执行和错误恢复等能力。因此需要一种细粒度、可解释、面向失败模式的动作级评测方法。
AI.method: 论文在 12 个机器人操作基准上系统分析前沿代理直接输出低级数值动作的控制能力，并提出 AgentRoboCritic 框架：策略代理在执行每个动作时声明局部意图，由批评模型评估该动作相对于该意图的结果、有效性及失败模式，从而将评测从任务级成功率推进到动作级归因。
AI.result: 研究发现前沿代理在直接机器人控制中具备闭环局部恢复、跨场景语义接地和较强零样本操作能力，但仍受限于抓取、对齐等物理执行瓶颈，且不同失败模式上的恢复能力不均。论文还在 400 个动作的人工标注基准上验证批评器，并开源包含 12,844 个标注动作的数据集；微调后的 Muse-Glimmer-30B 在失败模式识别准确率上由 32.58% 提升至 74.24%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为评估语言代理驱动的直接机器人控制提供了更细粒度和可解释的分析工具，揭示了当前模型在语义规划与物理执行之间的能力差距，并通过公开数据集和开源批评模型降低了动作级错误诊断成本，有助于推动更可靠、可解释的具身智能代理研究。
